records.title: Director, Quality
records.description:
**Job Description:**
Saab's Aeronautics Business is seeking a highly engaged, motivated and experienced
**Director of Quality**
to develop and lead a world-class aerospace quality organization.
 
 
The ideal candidate possesses strong leadership skills, the ability to identify process improvement opportunities and significant experience in developing and executing integrated strategies in manufacturing operations. They bring strong analytical, strategic, and relationship-building capabilities, along with a proven track record of developing next-level quality leaders. This position will be based in West Lafayette, IN.
 
 
**Responsibilities will include:**

* Employee management and engagement and compliance to relevant standards/requirements.
* Work collaboratively with Program Management, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Production to maximize efficiencies, achieve objectives, and improve overall safety and product quality in the business.
* Develop a strong relationship with Saab’s Global Aeronautics Business Area team and continually develop and improve global and local processes.
* Manage transfer of technology programs for products moving from Sweden to the US.
* Ensure proper staffing to effectively perform all responsibilities. This includes having the right skill mix to cover all areas of responsibility in global operations.
* Keep management and others informed of significant issues or developments.
* Support other departments/functions as needed to ensure operational efficiencies.
* Develop quality team via internal and external educational and experiential opportunities.
* Provide costing data to support proposal efforts.
* Resolve external quality issues. This may include direct government and/or customer contact, interaction with the program management team, or others close to the issue to resolve and drive permanent corrective actions.
* Work with peers in the management team to establish quality improvement strategies and plans.
* Ensure internal audits of existing processes are being performed and changing/evaluating as necessary to continually meet/exceed customer expectations.
* Perform formal root cause analysis on product/process related issues.
* Utilize risk assessment tools (e.g., PFMEAs) to identify actions to reduce risks.
* Lead key improvement projects, providing leadership in developing practical solutions to complex problems.
* Improve processes using Kaizen, process mapping, 6s, or other lean tools.
* Identify trends and process variations for future improvement initiatives.
* Ensure compliance across all areas of responsibility.

**Compensation Range:**
$165,700 - $223,800
 
 
The compensation range provided is a general guideline. When extending an offer, Saab, Inc. considers factors including (but not limited to) the role and associated responsibilities, location, and market and business considerations, as well as the candidate's work experience, key skills, and education/training.
 
 
**Skills and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Quality or related discipline is required. Master’s degree is a plus.
* 10+ years of progressive experience in Aerospace or Defense.
* 5+ years in a Quality management role in Aerospace or Defense.
* Lean training and experience / certification a plus.
* A proven track record of implementing improvements.
* Experience with customer (USG) interaction and problem resolution.
* Strong analytical, prioritizing, interpersonal, problem-solving, presentation, budgeting, project management skills.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Experience in AS9100 Quality Systems in an Aerospace or Defense company.
* Ability to develop and maintain collaborative relationships with peers and colleagues across the organization, as well as internal and external clients.
* Ability to form partnerships with foreign national partners in order to maximize results.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team to achieve strategic goals.
* Experience with the development and production of aerospace systems required.

**Citizenship Requirements:**
Must be a U.S. citizen. Applicants selected may be subject to a government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information.
 
 
**Drug-Free Workplaces:**
Saab is a federal government contractor and adheres to policies and programs necessary for sustaining drug-free workplaces. As a condition of employment, candidates will be required to pass a pre-employment drug screen.
 
 
**Benefits:**
Saab provides an excellent working environment offering professional growth opportunities, competitive wages, work-life balance, a business casual atmosphere and comprehensive benefits.
 
 
Highlights include:
 
 

* Medical, vision, and dental insurance for employees and dependents
* Generous paid time off, including 8 designated holidays
* 401(k) with employer contributions
* Tuition assistance and student loan assistance
* Wellness and employee assistance resources
* Employee stock purchase opportunities
* Short-term and long-term disability coverage

**About Us:**
Saab is a leading defense and security company with an enduring purpose, to help nations keep their people and society safe. Empowered by its 28,000 talented people, Saab constantly pushes the boundaries of technology to create a safer and more sustainable world. In the U.S., Saab delivers advanced technology and systems, supporting the U.S. Armed Forces and the Federal Aviation Administration, as well as international and commercial partners. Headquartered in Syracuse, New York, the company has business units and local employees in ten U.S. locations.
 
 
Saab is a company where we see diversity as an asset and offer unlimited opportunities for advancing in your career. We are also a company that respects each person’s needs and encourage employees to lead a balanced, rewarding life beyond work. Saab values diversity and is an Affirmative Action employer for protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. Saab is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, all qualified individuals are encouraged to apply and will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity, age, veteran, disability status, or any other federal, state, or locally protected category.

records.title: Director of Quality & Regulatory Compliance
records.description:
**Business Unit:**
Miltope Corporation

**Location:**
Hope Hull, AL

This position is an exempt salaried role that normally works a 9/80 work schedule. Non-duty hours work may be required based on business needs.

**Who YOU are and what YOU can become:**

You are a high-performing strategist with a commitment to excellence, attention to detail, and a knack for identifying areas of improvement. You are looking for a role that serves a noble purpose: supporting our nation's warfighters.

**Who WE are and where WE are going:**

At ST Engineering North America Government, Miltope Corporation, we apply technology and innovation to solve real-world problems and improve lives. Our dedication to excellence has earned us a reputation for quality and trust as a global technology, defense, and engineering group. Our diverse portfolio spans aerospace, smart city, defense, and public security.

**What YOU will do:**

Miltope Corporation is seeking an experienced aerospace quality and regulatory compliance executive to lead the company's Quality organization and ensure continued compliance with applicable Department of War, Federal Aviation Administration (FAA), European Union Aviation Safety Agency (EASA), and customer requirements.

This position is responsible for the development, implementation, oversight, and continuous improvement of quality management systems supporting, but not limited to:

* FAA Part 21 Production Approval operations.
* FAA Part 145 Certified Repair Station operations.
* EASA Part 145 Approved Maintenance Organization operations.

The Director of Quality & Regulatory Compliance will serve as the senior independent authority for quality assurance, regulatory compliance, and quality system effectiveness across production and repair station operations.

Reporting directly to the CEO/President, this individual will work closely with executive leadership, Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, Supply Chain, and Repair Station management to ensure regulatory requirements are implemented, monitored, and maintained.

The successful candidate must establish an effective quality culture while possessing the technical knowledge and operational experience necessary to engage directly in regulatory matters, audits, investigations, and corrective actions.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Regulatory Compliance and Quality System Leadership**

* Maintain responsibility for quality management system effectiveness and compliance supporting FAA Part 21 and FAA/EASA Part 145 operations.
* Ensure compliance with applicable FAA regulations, including 14 CFR Parts 21, 43, and 145, and EASA Part-145 requirements.
* Maintain and oversee Quality Manuals, Repair Station Manuals, Quality Control Manuals, and associated procedures.
* Ensure regulatory requirements, approved procedures, and customer-specific quality requirements are communicated and implemented.
* Monitor regulatory changes and evaluate their impact on operations, procedures, and approvals.
* Serve as the primary Quality representative in regulatory compliance matters and coordinate with designated Accountable Managers and regulatory authorities.
* Ensure organizational responsibilities, delegated authorities, and quality reporting relationships are clearly defined.

**FAA and EASA Regulatory Oversight**

* Oversee FAA Production Approval compliance, including organizational controls, production conformity, quality assurance, and product traceability.
* Oversee FAA Part 145 Repair Station quality control activities, ensuring compliance with applicable manuals and Operations Specifications.
* Ensure EASA Part-145 compliance monitoring requirements are implemented and maintained.
* Ensure the designated EASA Compliance Monitoring Manager has the independence, authority, resources, and organizational access necessary to perform assigned responsibilities.
* Coordinate regulatory inspections, audits, surveillance activities, and responses to FAA and EASA findings.
* Maintain effective relationships with FAA, EASA, and other regulatory authorities.
* Ensure timely notification, investigation, and resolution of reportable quality and regulatory issues.

**Quality Assurance and Continuous Improvement**

* Maintain an effective internal audit program covering production, repair station operations, suppliers, and supporting business functions.
* Ensure timely identification, documentation, investigation, and resolution of nonconformances and audit findings.
* Maintain an effective corrective and preventive action (CAPA) process, including root cause analysis and verification of effectiveness.
* Monitor quality performance metrics, identify adverse trends, and drive improvement initiatives.
* Ensure controls for material acceptance, inspection, product conformity, nonconforming material, configuration management, calibration, and quality records.
* Oversee supplier quality management, including qualification, monitoring, and corrective actions.
* Drive a culture of quality, accountability, continuous improvement, and regulatory compliance.

**Organizational Leadership and Executive Accountability**

* Report directly to the CEO/President on regulatory compliance, quality performance, significant risks, and corrective actions.
* Maintain independence from Manufacturing, Operations, and Repair Station production functions when performing quality oversight and compliance monitoring.
* Escalate significant quality and regulatory compliance concerns directly to executive leadership.
* Establish appropriate quality-related authority, including initiating product or maintenance holds and preventing release or return to service when requirements have not been satisfied, consistent with approved procedures and delegated authority.
* Partner with functional leaders to implement and sustain corrective actions.
* Lead, develop, and mentor the Quality organization to ensure technical competency, staffing, and succession planning.
* Provide executive management with objective assessments of quality system effectiveness and regulatory compliance.

**Required Qualifications and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality Management, Aviation, or a related technical discipline preferred. Equivalent education and relevant aerospace industry experience will be considered.
* Minimum of 8–10 years of progressive experience in defense or aerospace quality assurance, regulatory compliance, manufacturing quality, or aviation maintenance quality.
* Minimum of 5 years of leadership experience managing a quality organization or regulatory compliance function.
* Demonstrated experience within an FAA-regulated aerospace manufacturing organization holding a Part 21 Production Approval.
* Direct experience with FAA Part 145 Repair Station quality systems and regulatory requirements.
* Working knowledge of EASA Part-145 requirements, including compliance monitoring and organizational independence.
* Experience managing regulatory audits, responding to findings, and coordinating corrective actions with FAA, EASA, and customer representatives.
* Strong knowledge of aerospace quality management systems, including AS9100, AS9110, or equivalent standards.
* Experience with root cause analysis, CAPA systems, supplier quality, and continuous improvement.
* Ability to interpret regulatory requirements and translate them into practical procedures and controls.
* Excellent leadership, communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to communicate effectively with executive leadership, regulatory authorities, customers, and employees at all levels.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience overseeing multiple regulatory approvals or certifications within a single organization.
* Experience with aerospace manufacturing and component repair/maintenance operations.
* Experience serving as or directly supporting a Part 21 Accountable Manager, FAA Part 145 Accountable Manager, or EASA Compliance Monitoring Manager.
* Experience with AS9100/AS9110 certification audits and aerospace customer audits.
* Experience implementing and maintaining risk-based quality systems and safety management processes.
* Experience managing quality organizations across multiple facilities or operating locations.

**Leadership Attributes**

* Independence, integrity, and willingness to address difficult quality and regulatory issues.
* Ability to influence executive leadership and operational management.
* Strong technical judgment and understanding of aviation product safety and airworthiness.
* Proactive approach to identifying risks and preventing compliance issues.
* Ability to balance regulatory requirements with practical business and operational considerations.
* Hands-on leadership style and willingness to engage in the details.

**Measures of Success**

* Sustained compliance with FAA Part 21 and FAA/EASA Part 145 requirements.
* Successful completion of regulatory, customer, and third-party audits.
* Timely and effective resolution of audit findings and corrective actions.
* Effective quality system performance and reduction of recurring nonconformances.
* Strong organizational understanding of quality responsibilities and regulatory requirements.
* An independent, empowered Quality organization that supports business performance while protecting product conformity, airworthiness, and regulatory compliance.

**Please contact:**
Human Resources at hr@miltope.com

It takes diverse talent to solve real-world problems. ST Engineering/Miltope Corporation is deeply committed to building a workplace community where inclusion is valued and everyone feels welcomed. We are proud to consider all qualified applicants for employment. Miltope is an equal opportunity employer.

Miltope Corporation is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities in the employment application process. To request an accommodation, please contact Human Resources.

records.title: Quality Director
records.description:
**Lead Quality Strategy & Division Performance**
Own and advance the division’s quality strategy across the full product lifecycle—product safety, laboratory operations, manufacturing processes, customer support, and compliance. This role ensures quality is built into how products are developed, produced, tested, supported, and governed, with clear standards that protect both customers and the business.
 
 
Direct a high-performing technical and quality team by setting expectations, coaching talent, and strengthening technical capability. Drive continuous improvement by analyzing trends, preventing repeat issues, and improving product performance and operational effectiveness.
 
 
Collaborate across functions to resolve customer quality concerns, manage investigations, and implement corrective and preventive actions. Lead efforts to strengthen supplier performance through clear requirements, effective feedback loops, and performance monitoring.
 
 
**What You’ll Bring**

* Deep quality and compliance knowledge spanning operations, lab/testing, and customer-facing processes
* Strong problem-solving and investigation skills, with a focus on root cause and sustainable fixes
* Proven leadership capability to develop teams and improve technical performance
* Experience partnering with suppliers and enforcing quality expectations
* Comfort managing risk and driving measurable improvement in product and operational outcomes

records.description:
**Description**
**Built**
**on**
**Experience.**
**Built**
**for**
**Skill.**
**Built**
**for You.**
Keel was formed by bringing together three industry leaders combining generations of hands-on expertise in steel fabrication, shipbuilding, aerospace, and defense manufacturing.
 
 
That means when you join Keel, you’re joining a team backed by decades of proven craftsmanship and real-world results.
 
 
We build ships, defense systems, aerospace components, and heavy steel structures that serve critical missions — and we do it with pride.
 
 
**Your Mission**
The Director of Quality provides strategic leadership, technical oversight, and compliance governance for multiple heavy fabrication plants producing structural weldments, assemblies, and machined components for the Nuclear Navy. This role ensures full alignment with ISO 9001, NAVSEA, and customer specific requirements.
 
 
**Explore The Depth Of The Role**

* Provide strategic leadership for quality operations across three South Carolina fabrication facilities supporting U.S. Navy shipbuilding and defense manufacturing programs.
* Ensure all products meet contractual, technical, regulatory, NAVSEA, and quality requirements while driving continuous improvement in customer satisfaction and product performance.
* Lead the development, implementation, and continual improvement of the Quality Management System (QMS) to ensure compliance with customer, industry, and regulatory requirements.
* Serve as the primary quality interface for customers, government representatives, auditors, and regulatory agencies, leading quality reviews, audits, corrective actions, and performance discussions.
* Direct all quality assurance, quality control, inspection, test, dimensional verification, NDT, welding quality, and supplier quality activities across the region.
* Establish and monitor quality performance metrics including First-Time Quality (FTQ), Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ), defect escapes, rework, audit findings, and inspection cycle time.
* Lead root cause analysis, corrective action, and continuous improvement initiatives to eliminate recurring nonconformances and improve manufacturing performance.
* Drive operational excellence through improved inspection efficiency, resource utilization, process standardization, and deployment of risk-based quality methodologies.
* Partner with Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Program Management teams to proactively prevent defects and improve overall manufacturing effectiveness.
* Build and sustain a culture where quality, compliance, workmanship excellence, and customer focus are integrated into daily operations at all levels of the organization.
* Recruit, develop, coach, and lead Quality Managers, Engineers, Supervisors, Auditors, and Inspectors while building organizational capability and succession plans.
* Other related duties as assigned.

**Requirements**
**Mission Readiness:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, or related technical discipline; Master's Degree preferred.
* 12+ years of progressive quality leadership experience in shipbuilding, defense, defense manufacturing, heavy fabrication, aerospace, or similar industries.
* Demonstrated experience leading multi-site quality organizations.
* Root cause analysis and corrective action applied to nonconformances and recurring defects
* Quality auditing, including internal, supplier, and customer audit planning, execution, and follow-up
* Data analysis and reporting using quality metrics, dashboards, and tools such as Excel, Power BI, and ERP/QMS software
* Contract and technical document review, including drawings, specifications, work instructions, and inspection plans
* Executive-level presentation and negotiation skills for customer meetings, corrective action reviews, and dispute resolution
* Quality Management Systems: AS9100, ISO 9001, Navy QA requirements, nonconformance management, and CAPA
* Welding and NDT Oversight: Weld procedures, inspection methods, and material traceability in accordance with NAVSEA requirements
* Supplier Quality: Qualifying, auditing, and developing suppliers; preventing counterfeit or nonconforming material
* Regulatory and Contract Compliance: Government source inspection, DCMA surveillance, and audit readiness
* Continuous Improvement and Leadership: Lean, Six Sigma, root cause analysis, and developing quality talent
* Track and report cost of quality (prevention, appraisal, internal and external failure) and drive reductions in rework and scrap
* Support program pricing, proposals, and forecasts with accurate quality labor and resource estimates
* Evaluate the cost, schedule, and risk impact of quality decisions, such as rework, repair, and corrective action investments

**Travel Requirements**
Between facilities as needed
 
 
**Physical Requirements**

* May be required to stand, walk, sit, reach/pull/push with hands and arms, climb or balance, stoop or kneel regularly.
* May lift or carry 50lbs. Weights exceeding 50lbs will require mechanical means to maneuver.

* Uphold Safety and Quality Standards
* Embody Team Spirit
* Relentless Customer Focus
* Convey Integrity, Trust, and Professionalism
* Execute with Excellence and Velocity

**What Keel Will Build For You**

* Comprehensive Benefit Package
* Competitive Pay
* 401(k) Match
* HSA/FSA
* Paid Holidays
* Paid Time Off
* Internal Referral Bonus Opportunities
* Shift Differentials
* Overtime Potential
* Paid on the Job Training
* Certification Sponsorship Opportunities
* Committed to Individual Career Growth
* We Do Fun Things, Plus More!

records.title: Director of Quality
records.description:
**Director of Quality**

**Location:**
Springhill, TN or St. Louis, MO

**Position:**
Full-Time | Department Leadership Team

**Company Overview**

Our client is an established, growing manufacturing company specializing in custom-engineered components and solutions. With multiple manufacturing locations, the organization is committed to operational excellence, exceptional customer service, and continuous improvement.

**Position Overview**

We are seeking an experienced, results-driven Director of Quality to lead and oversee all aspects of quality management across a multi-location manufacturing organization.

This position serves as the company's senior quality leader, with overall responsibility for developing and executing the corporate quality strategy, maintaining the existing ISO 9001-certified Quality Management System, and leading the company's strategic initiative to achieve IATF 16949 certification.

The Director of Quality will provide leadership, direction, and professional development to all Quality Department personnel, including Quality Engineers, Quality Technicians, and future plant-level Quality Leaders.

The ideal candidate will have extensive manufacturing quality experience, strong leadership capabilities, and a proven track record of developing quality systems, improving operational performance, and building high-performing teams.

**Duties & Responsibilities**

**Quality Leadership & Management**

* Provide company-wide leadership and oversight of all quality-related activities across the organization's manufacturing operations.
* Lead, mentor, develop, and manage the corporate Quality Department, including Quality Engineers, Quality Technicians, and future plant-level Quality Leaders.
* Establish and execute the company's quality strategy, objectives, policies, and performance standards.
* Foster a proactive culture of quality, accountability, problem-solving, and continuous improvement throughout the organization.
* Partner with Operations, Engineering, Sales, Supply Chain, and executive leadership to ensure quality objectives align with business and customer requirements.
* Develop organizational capabilities, staffing plans, and employee training programs to support current operations and future growth.

**Quality Management Systems & Certification**

* Maintain and continuously improve the company's existing ISO 9001-certified Quality Management System, ensuring ongoing compliance, audit readiness, and successful maintenance of current certification.
* Develop and manage a comprehensive IATF 16949 certification roadmap, including gap assessments, implementation milestones, resource requirements, training, internal audits, and certification readiness.
* Ensure the company's Quality Management System (QMS) is enhanced to satisfy IATF 16949 requirements and applicable customer-specific quality standards.
* Lead and execute the company's strategic initiative to achieve IATF 16949 certification within established timelines.
* Lead the development, implementation, standardization, and continuous improvement of quality systems and processes across all manufacturing locations.
* Oversee internal, external, customer, and certification audits, ensuring ongoing compliance and successful certification.
* Serve as, or provide leadership to, the company's Lead Auditor and internal audit teams.
* Ensure effective management of corrective and preventive actions, nonconformances, documentation, calibration, and quality records.
* Lead management reviews and ensure ongoing QMS effectiveness and organizational accountability.

**Quality Performance & Continuous Improvement**

* Establish, monitor, and drive improvements in company-wide Quality KPIs, including customer complaints, internal and external PPM, cost of poor quality, scrap, rework, and corrective action effectiveness.
* Develop and implement quality improvement initiatives designed to reduce defects, improve manufacturing performance, and strengthen customer satisfaction.
* Lead complex problem-solving and root cause investigations using methodologies such as 8D, 5-Why, Fishbone/Ishikawa Diagrams, FMEA, and statistical analysis.
* Utilize data-driven decision-making, statistical process control (SPC), and other quality tools to proactively identify risks and improvement opportunities.
* Collaborate with Operations and Engineering to establish effective process controls, inspection standards, and preventive quality measures.
* Oversee product nonconformance management, containment, material disposition, and corrective action activities.

**Customer & Supplier Quality**

* Serve as the senior quality representative for key customer relationships, audits, escalations, and quality-related concerns.
* Ensure timely, professional resolution of customer complaints and implementation of sustainable corrective actions.
* Manage the Production Part Approval Process (PPAP), working closely with internal Quality and Business Development teams to ensure timely completion of customer approvals and achievement of new business launch schedules.
* Oversee Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP) activities and ensure compliance with customer-specific quality requirements.
* Partner with Supply Chain and Purchasing to establish supplier quality expectations, manage supplier performance, and resolve supplier-related quality issues.
* Support new customer onboarding, new product launches, and manufacturing process changes to ensure quality requirements are achieved.
* Build strong relationships with customers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders to continuously improve quality performance.

**Strategic & Operational Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute long-term quality improvement plans aligned with the organization's growth objectives.
* Establish standardized quality processes, reporting, and best practices across all manufacturing locations.
* Support business expansion, new manufacturing capabilities, and potential acquisitions through quality system assessments and integration.
* Evaluate and recommend investments in inspection equipment, measurement technology, automation, and quality management systems.
* Prepare and present quality performance reports, improvement plans, certification progress, and key initiatives to executive leadership.
* Promote a safe work environment and ensure quality-related activities support company safety standards.
* Perform other quality-related leadership responsibilities as required.

**Experience & Education Requirements**

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality Management, Manufacturing, or a related technical field, or an equivalent combination of education and significant manufacturing quality leadership experience.
* Minimum of 8–10 years of progressive experience in manufacturing quality, including at least 3–5 years in a quality management or leadership position.
* Demonstrated experience leading and developing Quality Engineers, Quality Technicians, and/or plant-level quality personnel.
* Strong working knowledge of ISO 9001 and IATF 16949 Quality Management Systems, implementation, auditing, and compliance requirements.
* Demonstrated experience implementing or maintaining ISO 9001-certified Quality Management Systems.
* Experience supporting or leading IATF 16949 implementation, certification preparation, or certification audits.
* Lead Auditor experience with ISO 9001 or IATF 16949.
* Proven success improving quality performance, reducing defects, managing customer complaints, and implementing effective corrective actions.
* Strong knowledge of APQP, PPAP, FMEA, SPC, MSA, 8D, and root cause analysis methodologies.
* Experience managing customer and third-party quality audits.
* Excellent leadership, communication, organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, ERP/MRP systems, and quality-related software.
* Ability and willingness to travel between manufacturing locations and customer or supplier facilities as necessary.
* Must be physically based in the Nashville, TN, or St. Louis, MO, metropolitan area.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Previous experience successfully leading an organization through IATF 16949 certification.
* Experience in automotive manufacturing, converting, or the production of engineered components and materials.
* Experience overseeing quality functions across multiple manufacturing facilities.
* ASQ Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence (CMQ/OE), Certified Quality Engineer (CQE), or Certified Quality Auditor (CQA).
* Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification.
* Experience implementing quality systems in a growing, multi-location manufacturing organization.
* Experience with supplier development, new product launches, and quality system integration.
* Bilingual English/Spanish communication skills are a plus.

**Leadership & Personal Attributes**

**The successful candidate will demonstrate:**

* A strong sense of ownership, accountability, and personal integrity.
* A hands-on, proactive leadership style with the ability to develop and inspire teams.
* The ability to balance strategic leadership with practical, day-to-day problem-solving.
* Strong customer focus and a commitment to delivering exceptional quality.
* An analytical, data-driven mindset with a passion for continuous improvement.
* Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across all levels of the organization.
* A forward-thinking attitude, strong work ethic, and willingness to challenge existing processes to achieve better results.
* A commitment to operational excellence, customer satisfaction, and organizational success.

TTM Technologies, Inc. – Publicly Traded US Company, NASDAQ (TTMI) – Top-5 Global Printed Circuit Board Manufacturer
 
 
**About TTM**
TTM Technologies, Inc. is a leading global manufacturer of technology products, including mission systems, radio frequency (“RF”) components, RF microwave/microelectronic assemblies, and technologically advanced printed circuit boards (“PCB”s). TTM stands for time-to-market, representing how TTM's time-critical, one-stop design, engineering and manufacturing services enable customers to reduce the time required to develop new products and bring them to market.
 
 
Additional information can be found at www.ttm.com
 
 
**Scope:**
The Director of Quality reports to the GM with a strong dotted line to the Director of IE Quality. This position has full accountability for the establishment, implementation, maintenance, and continual improvement of the Quality Management System (QMS) in accordance with AS9100 and customer /industry specific requirements. This role provides strategic and operational quality leadership across all aspects of the business from design to new product introduction and customer interface through to manufacturing, supply chain, and post-delivery support within a highly regulated aerospace and defense electronics manufacturing environment.
 
 
**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Own, maintain, and continually improve the AS9100D (IA9100)-compliant QMS across all business functions, ensuring customer and industry specific requirements are addressed. Ensure the QMS is maintained in accordance with all changes in standards and regulations.
* Maintain chemical processing compliance in accordance with NADCAP.
* Act as the central point for all audits, ensuring all audit findings are addressed with robust corrective actions and appropriate timescales.
* Co-ordinate resolution to customer issues across multiple functions, including applicable design, program management, process engineering and supply chain. Ensure appropriate communication of sensitive customer issues to senior leadership.
* Responsible for identifying and driving Quality KPI’s in accordance with business objectives.
* Lead continuous improvement activities and act as site champion for corporate continuous improvement initiatives, drive scrap, yield metrics and RMA metrics whilst developing a pipeline of core tool SME’s
* Drive Quality team strength using talent assessment to provide career development, focusing on core quality tools, industry requirements such as IPC/IA9100/IA9145/NACAP and data analytics.
* Drive supplier quality to reduce the impact of supply chain on manufacturing quality and lead times. Develop suppliers using an APQP approach to continually improve their process capability and compliance whilst reducing cost.
* As a member of the site senior management team, participate and engage with all functions to drive a people centric quality culture
* Maintain the necessary communications and effective relationships with other company functions required to support the operation.
* Supports business development proposals and engineering efforts by providing technical and production resources necessary.
* Key member of site Technical Review Board (TRB).
* Develops and maintains an effective operations organization through the selection, training, development, compensation and motivation of all personnel assigned to the operations organization. Recommends and approves organizational structures and staffing requirements in support of company business objectives.
* Complies with laws, company policy and procedures including but not limited to Equal Opportunity Employment, Affirmative Action, Business Ethics, EPA, OSHA and other federal, state and local regulatory agencies.
* Perform special assignments as needed.

**Education and Experience:**

* BS in engineering, science or related fields
* Minimum 10 years of experience in microelectronics / PCB manufacturing
* Minimum of 5 years senior leadership responsibility in a Quality Leadership function
* IPC certification and knowledge of relevant requirements
* AS9100/ISO9001/NADCAP experience with IATF TS16949 experience an advantage
* Certified Six Sigma Black Belt certified an advantage.
* Currently hold or ability to obtain a secret security clearance.

**Essential Knowledge and Skills:**

* Strong leadership and communication skills. Able to define goals and inspire the organization to achieve them. Provides clear, frequent direction to subordinates, and support functions, in support of quality goals.
* Able to maintain personal effectiveness and tolerate stress while handling multiple priorities in a fast-paced production environment.
* Demonstrated leadership skills with the ability to motivate team members to achieve optimal results. Leverages each member’s strengths and provides recognition of accomplishments to maximize overall results.
* High-performance team building. Uses appropriate methods and a flexible interpersonal style to help build a cohesive team. Ability to effectively manage conflict and create “win / win” outcomes for people and the business.
* Proactively identifies execution risks and applies risk management tools and techniques to mitigate.

**Export/ITAR Statement:**
Must comply with TTM Export Control Policies and Procedures and all applicable laws including ITAR, EAR and OFAC. b) Reinforce to all employees the commitment of TTM management to abide by all US Export laws and regulations. c) Understand and follow authorization procedures for bringing foreign visitors into facilities (VAL). d) Support Export Compliance Officers and others in their efforts to ensure compliance with the Corporate Export policies through implementation and enforcement of these procedures, provide training to all facilities and departments and support periodic audits as required. e) Provide feedback to Corporate Export Compliance Office for continuous improvement of procedures and overall Export Compliance program.
 
 
**Total Rewards Information**
*At TTM you will be joining a team that spans across nearly 20 facilities in North America that are bringing game-changing electronics to the market. As a teammate we are dedicated to providing opportunities that help you excel and reach your potential, so join us in our commitment to excellence and be part of the team that is Building the Future.*
*Listed below are some of the many benefits that TTM offers our teammates. Benefits are available on the first of the month following date of hire based on plan eligibility.*
**Wellness**

* Medical, Dental, Vision, including Telehealth support
* Company paid Life, AD&D, Short-Term Disability and Long-Term Disability Insurance
* Option of Health Savings Account (HSA) with company contribution, or Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
* Wellness Incentive Programs with company deposits into HSA Account
* Critical Care, Accident, and Hospital Indemnity options in addition to Legal Insurance and Pet Insurance
* PTO Program (15 days, annual accrual)
* 8 Company Holidays with an additional 2 floating holidays
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

**Financial**

* 401(k) match program with immediate vesting
* Annual Bonus Program
* Referral Bonuses
* Annual compensation review

***Development***

* Professional development and training opportunities
* Cross training opportunities
* Tuition reimbursement for courses related to TTM’s business – up to $12,000 per year
* Annual performance reviews

***Compensation and Benefits:***
TTM offers a variety of health and well-being benefit programs. Benefit options include medical, dental, vision, 401k, flexible spending and health savings accounts, accident benefits, life insurance, disability benefits, paid vacation & holidays. Benefits are available on the 1st of the month following date of hire. For some positions, only PTO and holiday benefits are offered.
 
 
Compensation ranges for roles at TTM Technologies varies depending on a wide array of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At TTM Technologies, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on each individual set of circumstances. A reasonable estimate of the current range is:
 
 
$138,028 - $242,738
 
 
Additional compensation: An annual or quarterly company bonus may apply based on position assignment. Positions hired for alternative shift may be eligible for a shift premium based on the assigned shift and location.
 
 
***Export Statement:***
Must comply with TTM Export Control Policies and Procedures and all applicable laws including ITAR, EAR and OFAC including but not limited to: a) being able to identify ITAR product on the manufacturing floor and understand that access to these products and related technical data is restricted to only US Citizens and US Permanent Residents; b) recognition of Foreign Person visitors by badge differentiation; c) understand and follow authorization procedures for bringing foreign visitors into facilities (VAL); d) understand the Export and ITAR requirements for shipments leaving the US; e) manage vendor approvals for ITAR manufacturing and services.
 
 
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, citizenship, disability or protected veteran status.

records.description:
**About Us**
As a global manufacturer of complex aircraft engine components, Pursuit Aerospace is founded on a commitment to relentless, continuous, operational improvement and extraordinary customer service. We pride ourselves on competitive cost structure, exceptional on-time delivery, and industry-leading quality.
 
 
Pursuit Aerospace has cultivated long-term relationships with our customers around the world through respect, teamwork, technology, and trust. We are driven to develop industry leading process innovations and manufacturing techniques on behalf of our customers. Our exceptional quality is driven by a deep investment in and the daily practice of continually improving our people, processes, and products.
 
 
**About The Opportunity**
The Quality Director reports directly to the Vice President of Operations for the division and supports sites within the division. The Quality Director duties include providing onsite support, guidance, leadership, to multiple sites within the division and champions the Company’s culture of quality and is responsible for the design and achievement of goals with respect to quality of products, services and processes for the whole of Pursuit Aerospace. In addition, ensures compliance with all regulations and provides leadership and structure to all aspects of the Quality and Quality Assurance functions across all sites. Develop, implement, manage, and continuously improve quality control systems designed to ensure accurate production of aerospace components consistent with established standards, customer specifications. Responsible for leading internal and external audits and ensuring compliance to the Quality Management System. Use Kaizen and single piece flow principles to ensure quality compliance at every process step. In addition to leading Quality at the Machining division level the Director.
 
 
**Location:**
Remote within the U.S, with travel up to 50%, including international
 
 
**Responsibilities**

* Identify and/or lead kaizen to continuously improve delivered product quality.
* Support site quality management at sites with any escalations internally or from customers.
* Drive quality to become a proactive internal function, addressing quality at the source.
* Partner closely with Site GMs, Site Quality Managers, and Division Leadership team.
* Mature site problem solving efforts.
* Led efforts to support AS9100 global certification.
* AS9100 Lead auditor training.
* Support escape investigations at sites.
* Formulate, document, and maintain quality control standards and on-going quality control objectives.
* Effectively communicate & present information to all levels of the organization – shop floor, direct reports, and management.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, or related technical discipline
* 10+ years of quality experience in a manufacturing environment
* 5+ years of direct leadership/supervisory experience including multi-site leadership
* Must be authorized to work in the U.S. on a full-time basis without sponsorship now or in the future. The Company cannot offer employment to visa holders who require employer sponsorship in the future or who cannot work now on a full-time basis.
* Must be able to perform work subject to ITAR/EAR regulations.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* ASQ certification or equivalent quality credential
* Working knowledge of AS9100 and NADCAP special processes
* Strong command of GD&T advanced metrology tools, and data analytics/SPC tracking inside ERP systems.
* Experience aerospace manufacturing environment
* Background in inspection planning, process controls, nonconformance management, and corrective action
* Experience with developing/documenting procedures.
* Excellent presentation, written, verbal and communication skills with the ability to interact and work with Employees and customers at all levels of the organization.
* Detail-oriented, organized, and capable of managing multiple priorities in a dynamic, matrixed environment.
* Computer proficiency (Microsoft Excel, Word Outlook, PowerPoint, and internet applications)

**Working Conditions**

* Must be able to have prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
* Must be able to frequently sit, stand and walk.
* Must be able to lift and carry up to 15 pounds.
* Personal protective equipment (e.g., safety glasses and safety shoes) is required on the shop floor
* Occasional weekend and evening work may be required to accommodate priorities, deadlines, and schedules.

**About Us**
As a global manufacturer of complex aircraft engine components, Pursuit Aerospace is founded on a commitment to relentless, continuous, operational improvement and extraordinary customer service. We pride ourselves on competitive cost structure, exceptional on-time delivery, and industry-leading quality.
 
 
Pursuit Aerospace has cultivated long-term relationships with our customers around the world through respect, teamwork, technology, and trust. We are driven to develop industry leading process innovations and manufacturing techniques on behalf of our customers. Our exceptional quality is driven by a deep investment in and the daily practice of continually improving our people, processes, and products.
 
 
**About The Opportunity**
The Quality Director reports directly to the Vice President of Operations for the division and supports sites within the division. The Quality Director duties include providing onsite support, guidance, leadership, to multiple sites within the division and champions the Company’s culture of quality and is responsible for the design and achievement of goals with respect to quality of products, services and processes for the whole of Pursuit Aerospace. In addition, ensures compliance with all regulations and provides leadership and structure to all aspects of the Quality and Quality Assurance functions across all sites. Develop, implement, manage, and continuously improve quality control systems designed to ensure accurate production of aerospace components consistent with established standards, customer specifications. Responsible for leading internal and external audits and ensuring compliance to the Quality Management System. Use Kaizen and single piece flow principles to ensure quality compliance at every process step. In addition to leading Quality at the Machining division level the Director.
 
 
**Location:**
Remote within the U.S, with travel up to 50%, including international
 
 
**Responsibilities**

* Identify and/or lead kaizen to continuously improve delivered product quality.
* Support site quality management at sites with any escalations internally or from customers.
* Drive quality to become a proactive internal function, addressing quality at the source.
* Partner closely with Site GMs, Site Quality Managers, and Division Leadership team.
* Mature site problem solving efforts.
* Led efforts to support AS9100 global certification.
* AS9100 Lead auditor training.
* Support escape investigations at sites.
* Formulate, document, and maintain quality control standards and on-going quality control objectives.
* Effectively communicate & present information to all levels of the organization – shop floor, direct reports, and management.
* Use and train in the following quality tools – root cause analysis and problem solving, FMEA, control plans, PPAP, APQP, System audits, SPC.
* Read, analyze, and interpret common scientific and technical journals, financial reports, and legal documents.
* Working knowledge and development of quality systems and requirements and how they relate to business (i.e. AS9100, NADCAP).
* Identify and/or lead initiatives to improve Quality system compliance.
* Effective leadership skills and ability to influence department and peers, as well as be a team player.
* Provides leadership, coaching, and direction to quality team, and will be responsible for the selection, motivation and oversight of the team for the achievement of the company goals.
* Assure all Quality staff are properly trained with the necessary equipment to yield consistent results.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, or related technical discipline
* 10+ years of quality experience in a manufacturing environment
* 5+ years of direct leadership/supervisory experience including multi-site leadership
* Must be authorized to work in the U.S. on a full-time basis without sponsorship now or in the future. The Company cannot offer employment to visa holders who require employer sponsorship in the future or who cannot work now on a full-time basis.
* Must be able to perform work subject to ITAR/EAR regulations.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* ASQ certification or equivalent quality credential
* Working knowledge of AS9100 and NADCAP special processes
* Strong command of GD&T advanced metrology tools, and data analytics/SPC tracking inside ERP systems.
* Experience aerospace manufacturing environment
* Background in inspection planning, process controls, nonconformance management, and corrective action
* Experience with developing/documenting procedures.
* Excellent presentation, written, verbal and communication skills with the ability to interact and work with Employees and customers at all levels of the organization.
* Detail-oriented, organized, and capable of managing multiple priorities in a dynamic, matrixed environment.
* Computer proficiency (Microsoft Excel, Word Outlook, PowerPoint, and internet applications)

**Working Conditions**

* Must be able to have prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
* Must be able to frequently sit, stand and walk.
* Must be able to lift and carry up to 15 pounds.
* Personal protective equipment (e.g., safety glasses and safety shoes) is required on the shop floor
* Occasional weekend and evening work may be required to accommodate priorities, deadlines, and schedules.

The specific programs and options available to an employee may vary depending on date of hire, schedule type, and the applicability of collective bargaining agreements, among other things.
 
 
Actual compensation may vary based on geographic location, skills, experience, and other job-related factors.

records.description:
**Director, Quality Assurance**

**Onsite in Warren, NJ**

**Full-Time**

**Job Summary:**

The Director of Quality Assurance is a leadership role, responsible for all aspects of the Quality Systems, Clinical Quality and Manufacturing Quality for the organization. The Director of Quality Assurance will work with their direct managerial reports, as well as Executive Leadership, to ensure a continued state of compliance while promoting a strong quality culture across the organization for all products, spanning early phase development to commercialization.

This position will be expected to work in a highly collaborative, cross functional team environment, and provide expert knowledge to risk identification/mitigation, strategy and execution.

**Responsibilities:**

* Oversee all aspects of Quality Systems, Clinical Quality and Manufacturing Quality to assure compliance with FDA, EU, ANVISA, TGA and other international GMP requirements for all products manufactured at company (e.g., 21 CFR Part 210 + 211, EU GMP Volume 4 Part 1).
* Provide strategic direction and leadership to ensure effectiveness of Quality Systems (e.g., CAPA, Change Management, Event Management, Supplier Quality, Internal Audit, Document Management, Risk Management, Record Review and Product Disposition, Training, Field Alert/Recall, etc.)
* Will have 6 direct reports.
* Lead and ensure execution of quality strategy for all development and manufacturing activities associated with all products manufactured by company, including external GMP contract manufacture operations or laboratories for drug substance and drug product.
* Primary contact for all inspection interactions with all domestic and ex-US regulatory authorities.
* Provide direction for escalated quality issues as they arise, determining the need for, and structuring communication for, further escalation to the Executive team and/or external parties.
* Lead strategic quality to quality relationships with business partners, suppliers, external CMOs and third-party testing laboratories.
* Ensure the company is upholding to Quality/Technical Agreements with business partners and suppliers.
* Provides input to all functions to ensure clinical trial activities are conducted in compliance with GCP regulations and internal requirements.
* Actively participate in the Site Leadership Team to drive continuous improvement activities and initiatives throughout company
* Analyze, report and present metrics where applicable to show health of system(s).
* Lead GxP inspection strategies across all auditable areas to ensure the company is in an audit-ready status at all times.
* Manage overall coaching, training, development and succession planning for the function.
* Set, manage and monitor budget for Quality Assurance, in conjunction with finance.

**Qualifications:**

* Minimum of Bachelor’s degree required. Advanced degree in chemistry, engineering, biochemistry, or related science field desirable.
* Minimum 7+ years of related work experience working in a regulated GxP industry in pharmaceutical manufacturing operation setting or service-oriented laboratory.
* Demonstrated ability to direct a function, oversee projects and teams. Minimum of 2 years overseeing direct reports.
* Minimum of 2+ years working in a managerial role with direct reports.
* Strong skillset in problem solving, strategic thinking, critical reasoning and decision making.
* Strong interpersonal skills and verbal/written communication skills.
* Excellent computer skills required (e.g., Microsoft Word, Excel, Access, PowerPoint, Visio).
* Strong project management skills, strong organizational skills to maintain a high level of productivity, innovation, and priority-setting to complete assignments on time and on budget.
* Strong business acumen surrounding pharmaceutical manufacturing.
* Some travel required.

records.description:
About the job

**JOB TITLE:**
Director of Quality Assurance

**REPORTS TO:**
Senior VP of Operations

**DEPARTMENT:**
Operations

**LOCATION:**
Columbus, OH

**WAGE:**
Salaried, Exempt

**WORK HOURS:**
Full-time, Variable

**TRAVEL:**
Frequent, 40–60%

**Job Summary**

The Director of Quality Assurance is responsible for providing strategic leadership and direction for all quality assurance, quality control, and quality systems functions across Plaskolite’s global operations. This role ensures the company’s products consistently meet or exceed internal standards, customer expectations and applicable regulatory requirements.

The Director of QA oversees the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of Plaskolite’s Quality Management System (QMS) to drive standardization, process capability, and operational excellence. This position works closely with Manufacturing, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Commercial teams to strengthen quality performance, enhance customer satisfaction, and promote a proactive culture of quality — aligned with the
**“One Plaskolite”**
vision of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.

This position requires diligence, the ability to work in a fast-paced manufacturing environment, and a strong commitment to safety, teamwork, and quality—reflecting Plaskolite’s core values of
**Integrity and Improvement.**

**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**

* Provide strategic leadership and oversight of all quality assurance and control activities across Plaskolite’s manufacturing sites and business units.
* Develop and implement the company’s Quality Management System (QMS) to ensure compliance with ISO, customer, and regulatory requirements.
* Lead and mentor Quality Managers, Supervisors, and Engineers, building a high-performing team that supports operational excellence and continuous improvement.
* Facilitate the publishing and communication of company-wide quality objectives, key performance indicators (KPIs), and metrics to measure and improve performance based on the input of Process Owners.
* Drive standardization of quality systems, processes, and documentation across all facilities to ensure consistency and compliance.
* Serve as the company’s primary liaison with major customers regarding quality performance, audits, and improvement initiatives.
* Collaborate with Sales, Customer Service and MFG sites, to address customer-specific quality requirements, audits, and documentation needs.
* Coordinate with manufacturing sites, the resolution of critical quality issues and customer complaints through data-driven root cause analysis (RCA) and effective corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
* Partner with Supply Chain and Procurement teams to ensure suppliers meet Plaskolite’s standards for quality, delivery, and reliability.
* Partner with Product Development and Engineering to integrate quality and reliability requirements into new products, material and manufacturing processes.
* Lead quality review meetings, providing executive-level insights on performance, risk, and continuous improvement opportunities.
* Support Drive continuous improvement initiatives using Lean, Six Sigma, and statistical process control (SPC) methodologies to improve process efficiency and product quality.
* Evaluate and recommend innovative technologies, testing methods, and data analytics tools to enhance quality monitoring and reporting capabilities.
* Manage Corporate Quality budget, staffing, and resource allocation to ensure effective support for operational and strategic objectives.
* Represent the Quality function in cross-functional executive meetings, business reviews, and strategic planning sessions.
* Ensure that all quality functions and personnel adhere to company safety policies, environmental regulations, and ethical business practices.
* Build and maintain a culture of accountability, continuous learning, and operational excellence within the Quality organization.
* All other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**

**Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Quality, Operation, or Manufacturing Management, Chemistry, Polymer Science or related technical fields.
* 10–15+ years in quality, manufacturing, or operational excellence roles.
* 5–8+ years managing teams and managers

**Skills and Competencies:**

* Professional Certifications (highly valued, not required):
* ASQ Certified Quality Manager (CQM/OE)
* ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE)
* Six Sigma Black Belt or Master Black Belt
* ISO 9001 / IATF 16949 / ISO 14001 Lead Auditor
* Lean Manufacturing certifications
* Strategic quality planning and deployment
* Risk management and failure mode analysis (FMEA)
* Customer-facing leadership during escalations
* Change management and culture transformation
* Data-driven decision-making
* Effective communication with executives and external stakeholders

**AVAILABLE BENEFITS:**

* Sign-On Bonus
* Health Insurance 401(k) and Employer Contribution
* Paid time off
* Paid Holidays
* Dental Insurance
* Vision Insurance
* Life Insurance
* Employee discount program
* Tuition reimbursement
* Voluntary Life Insurance

**About Plaskolite**

PLASKOLITE is a global leader in manufacturing of engineering thermoplastics, including Acrylic, Polycarbonate, ABS, Olefin and PETG Sheet, Extruded Profiles and PMMA Polymers. Founded in 1950, by Donald Dunn and family, PLASKOLITE has a reputation for providing the highest quality products in the industry. Our innovative thermoplastic solutions are used in a wide variety of applications, including glazing, safety shields, lighting, signs and point-of-purchase displays. Headquartered in Columbus, Ohio, with manufacturing facilities throughout North America and Europe, Plaskolite delivers superior thermoplastic sheet, profiles, and polymers to the world thru long-lasting customer relationships and hands-on customer service.

***PLASKOLITE is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to qualified individuals with disabilities. If requested, the Company will provide reasonable accommodation to otherwise qualified individuals where appropriate to allow the ++individual to perform the essential functions of the job, so long as doing so does not create an undue hardship on the business.***

**Additional Job Application Terms**

This job is part of LinkedIn’s Full-Service Hiring beta program. Eligibility is limited to candidates located in and performing services in the United States, excluding those based in Alaska, Hawaii, Nevada, South Carolina, or West Virginia.

We’re committed to making our hiring process as smooth and timely as possible, and we understand that waiting to hear back can add to the anticipation. If you’re a potential fit, our team will reach out within two weeks to progress you to the next stage. If you don’t hear from us in that time, we encourage you to explore other opportunities with our team in the future, and we wish you the very best in your job search.

records.title: Director of Quality and Regulation
records.description:
Northwest Partners is seeking an experienced Director of Quality & Regulatory Compliance to lead a Quality organization within the aerospace and defense industry. This is a senior leadership opportunity for an experienced quality professional with a strong background in aerospace manufacturing, aviation maintenance, and regulatory compliance. The successful candidate will be responsible for overseeing quality management systems, ensuring compliance with FAA and EASA regulations, and driving continuous improvement across production and repair station operations. Reporting directly to executive leadership, this individual will play a key role in maintaining regulatory approvals, strengthening quality standards, managing audits, and building a culture of accountability, product safety, and operational excellence.

**What You Will Do**

• Lead and oversee the Quality organization and quality management systems across aerospace manufacturing and repair station operations.

• Ensure compliance with FAA regulations, including 14 CFR Parts 21, 43, and 145, as well as applicable EASA Part-145 requirements.

• Oversee FAA Part 21 Production Approval and FAA/EASA Part 145 Repair Station compliance.

• Maintain and continuously improve Quality Manuals, Repair Station Manuals, Quality Control Manuals, and associated procedures.

• Lead regulatory inspections, internal audits, customer audits, and responses to FAA and EASA findings.

• Develop and manage corrective and preventive action (CAPA) processes, including root cause analysis and resolution of non-conformances.

• Monitor quality performance metrics, identify risks, and drive continuous improvement initiatives.

• Oversee supplier quality management, product conformity, material acceptance, inspection, and quality records.

• Work closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, Supply Chain, and executive leadership to maintain quality standards.

• Lead, develop, and mentor the Quality team while maintaining independent oversight of quality and regulatory compliance.

• Provide regular updates to executive leadership on compliance, quality performance, risks, and corrective actions.

**What You Will Bring**

• 8–10+ years of progressive experience in aerospace or defense quality assurance, regulatory compliance, manufacturing quality, or aviation maintenance quality.

• 5+ years of leadership experience managing a Quality organization or regulatory compliance function.

• Demonstrated experience within an FAA-regulated aerospace manufacturing environment holding a Part 21 Production Approval.

• Direct experience with FAA Part 145 Repair Station quality systems and regulatory requirements.

• Working knowledge of EASA Part-145 requirements, including compliance monitoring and organizational independence.

• Strong understanding of aerospace quality management systems, including AS9100, AS9110, or equivalent standards.

• Experience managing regulatory audits, responding to findings, and coordinating corrective actions with FAA, EASA, and customers.

• Strong knowledge of root cause analysis, CAPA, supplier quality, and continuous improvement processes.

• Ability to interpret regulatory requirements and translate them into practical procedures and controls.

• Excellent leadership, communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality Management, Aviation, or a related technical discipline preferred. Equivalent education and relevant aerospace industry experience will be considered.

Disclaimer: All candidates will be asked to briefly show a government-issued ID on video during the first interview. This step protects the integrity of the hiring process, given the rise in applicant impersonation and employment fraud.

**Benefits Include:**

Comprehensive benefits available to full time employees

**About Northwest Partners**

Northwest Partners is an equal opportunity employer. At Northwest Partners we are dedicated to moving at the speed of innovation. We work with clients across the globe to provide exceptional knowledge, talent, and resources. As a trusted partner, we merge the client's vision with our expertise to deliver powerful results. Northwest Partners is known for building and managing elite teams in technology across diverse industries. Our mission is to empower every talent and every client to achieve more.

records.title: Director of Quality
records.description:
Job Type

Full-time

Description

**About the Role:**

**As Director of Quality, you’ll lead Helix’s quality department and drive the development of systems, practices, and people to ensure product excellence, regulatory compliance, and customer satisfaction. You’ll hire, train, and manage the team, own the quality system, and make it clear who is responsible for quality at every step.**

**You’ll report directly to the Chief Executive Officer, partner closely with Engineering, Operations, and our customers to build a proactive, scalable, and right-sized quality system that enables growth.**

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Strategic Leadership & Systems Development**

* Develop and continuously improve a scalable Quality Management System aligned with AS9100 and customer requirements
* Lead departmental strategy, structure, and capital planning to support business growth
* Serve as ISO/AS Management Representative

**Team Leadership & Development**

* Lead and mentor a team of 5+ quality engineers, inspectors, and technicians
* Develop people and build team capabilities in metrology, inspection, and quality engineering
* Foster a culture of collaboration and real-time problem-solving on the shop floor

**Customer & Compliance Management**

* Lead customer and supplier audits; own response and resolution of corrective actions
* Ensure documentation, compliance, and audit readiness
* Build trusted relationships with key customers and act as the face of Quality

**Quality Engineering & Continuous Improvement**

* Partner with operators to implement in-process quality at the machine (not just post-process inspection)
* Drive root cause analysis, SPC implementation, and corrective actions to reduce scrap and improve first-pass yield
* Support new product introductions and ensure proper gauges, fixtures, and inspection plans are in place

**Internal Inspection & Production Support**

* Oversee first-piece, in-process, and final inspection plans
* Continuously simplify and optimize inspection methods to reduce bottlenecks without sacrificing quality

**What Success Looks Like**

* Promoting Operational Excellence by initiating and helping implement continuous improvement objectives.
* Maintaining a robust QMS system and compliance to AS9100 and ISO 9001 standards.
* Leading the company during customer audits and independent audits towards successful (re)certification.
* Lowering scrap and increasing first pass yield.
* Cross functional collaboration with Production and Engineering to help build quality into the process.
* Implementing solid Corrective Actions to reduce RMAs and DMRs.
* Establishing best practices for the Quality department and the organization as a whole

**Who You Are**

* A pragmatic quality leader who blends systems thinking with real-world shop floor experience
* Confident navigating between big-picture strategy and hands-on process improvement
* A builder of systems and people, able to lead a team and train on complex equipment
* Comfortable in a customer-facing role and able to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Committed to continuous improvement, collaboration, and delivering value across departments

**Qualifications:**

**Must-Haves**

* 10+ years in manufacturing quality, preferably in machining-based environments
* Strong knowledge of AS9100 and ISO 9001 standards
* Experience leading customer and regulatory audits
* Proven people management skills
* Working knowledge of metrology, CMM, GD&T, and SPC tools
* Experience balancing compliance with operational efficiency

**Nice-to-Haves**

* Mechanical or technical degree
* Experience supporting New Product Development (NPD)
* Six Sigma, Lean, or ASQ certifications (CQE, CQA, CQM)
* Familiarity with vision systems, statistical software (e.g., Minitab), and automation of inspection processes

**About the Company:**

**Helix Linear Technologies designs and manufactures high-precision motion control systems for industries where performance matters most, like aerospace, medical devices, and industrial automation. We’re in a phase of strategic growth, investing in R&D, advanced equipment, and new product lines, including aerospace-grade ball screws.**

**Our clean, climate-controlled facility is built for precision, focus, and continuous improvement. At Helix, you’ll join a team that values ownership, technical excellence, and curiosity.**

**We offer competitive compensation, comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits, a retirement savings plan with company match, and paid time off and company holidays.**

**Helix Linear Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Due to U.S. export control laws, applicants must be U.S. persons (U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident).**

records.title: Quality Technical Director
records.description:
Own the division’s quality strategy end-to-end, ensuring product safety, laboratory operations, manufacturing processes, customer support, and compliance work together to protect quality and meet regulatory expectations.
 
 
**Key Responsibilities**

* Set technical and quality direction, translating business goals into practical standards, processes, and performance measures across the value chain.
* Build and lead a high-performing quality organization, coaching teams in root-cause problem solving, risk management, and documentation discipline.
* Strengthen supplier quality through performance reviews, issue containment expectations, and clear escalation paths.
* Lead investigation and resolution of customer quality issues, coordinating internal stakeholders to deliver effective corrective and preventive actions.
* Drive continuous improvement to enhance product performance and operational effectiveness, identifying systemic gaps and verifying outcomes.

**What You Bring**
Deep experience in quality systems and product safety, strong technical leadership, and a pragmatic approach to compliance and cross-functional execution—able to turn complex investigations into durable improvements.
