records.title: Director of Quality Assurance & CI
records.description:
**Lead the Transformation. Build a Culture of Excellence. Deliver Results That Last.**
The Director of Quality Assurance & Continuous Improvement provides strategic leadership for the company's quality and continuous improvement functions, ensuring products, processes, and services consistently meet the highest standards of quality, reliability, and customer satisfaction. This role is responsible for developing, implementing, and continuously improving the Quality Management System (QMS) while driving a culture of operational excellence across the organization. Leading enterprise-wide Lean initiatives, Kaizen events, root cause analysis, and structured continuous improvement programs, this position delivers measurable improvements in quality, productivity, cost, and operational performance. Working closely with executive leadership and cross-functional teams, the Director establishes quality strategies, drives compliance with customer and regulatory requirements, and champions sustainable improvements that support the company's strategic growth objectives.
 
 
**What Success Looks Like**

* Lead the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of the company's Quality Management System (QMS), ensuring compliance with customer, regulatory, and industry standards, including ISO certifications.
* Establish enterprise-wide quality strategies, policies, and governance while serving as the executive leader for quality-related decisions impacting customers, operations, and suppliers.
* Drive a culture of operational excellence by leading Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, and structured continuous improvement initiatives across all business functions.
* Develop and execute strategic cost reduction initiatives that improve productivity, eliminate waste, reduce the Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ), and enhance overall operational performance.
* Partner cross-functionally with Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, Finance, Sales, and executive leadership to identify, prioritize, and deliver sustainable business improvements.
* Champion the voice of the customer by leveraging customer feedback, warranty data, and field performance to improve product quality, reliability, and customer satisfaction.
* Lead enterprise-wide root cause analysis and corrective action processes to resolve quality issues, prevent recurrence, and strengthen operational performance.
* Oversee internal and external audit programs, ensuring compliance with quality, safety, environmental, and regulatory requirements while proactively managing organizational risk.
* Build, mentor, and develop a high-performing Quality and Continuous Improvement organization while coaching leaders throughout the business to embed a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
* Establish, monitor, and report key performance indicators (KPIs) that measure quality, delivery, cost savings, productivity, customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement performance.
* Translate strategic business objectives into measurable quality and operational improvement initiatives that deliver sustainable financial and operational results.
* Build trusted relationships across the organization and with external stakeholders, influencing decision-making and driving alignment to achieve the company's strategic objectives.

**Qualifications That Shine**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field required; Master's degree or other advanced degree preferred.
* 15+ years of progressive quality leadership experience, including 10+ years leading people and 5+ years leading corporate or multi-site quality organizations.
* Proven success developing and leading Quality Management Systems (QMS) within a manufacturing environment, including ISO implementation, certification, and ongoing compliance.
* Professional certifications such as ASQ Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence (CMQ/OE), Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt, and Lean certification are strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated success leading Lean transformation, Kaizen events, and enterprise-wide continuous improvement initiatives that deliver measurable business results.
* Strong knowledge of quality systems, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), statistical process control (SPC), and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Proven ability to influence executive leadership and build collaborative partnerships across operations, engineering, supply chain, finance, and commercial teams.
* Exceptional communication, presentation, and organizational skills with the ability to translate strategy into execution and drive organizational change.
* Strategic, data-driven leader with a track record of improving quality, operational performance, customer satisfaction, and financial results through operational excellence initiatives.

**Why You’ll Love Working Here**

* You’ll Be Empowered – You’ll have autonomy in your role, supported by a team that trusts your judgment
* You’ll Grow With Us – We invest in your training, development, and long-term career path
* You’ll Be Rewarded – Competitive pay, performance incentives, 401(k) with profit sharing, and great benefits
* You’ll Make a Real Impact – Your work supports businesses across North America and shapes the future of finishing technology
* You’ll Join a Great Team – We’re growing fast, we value collaboration, and are committed to your success

**Transparent Rewards**
At GFS, we recognize the dedication behind every role and ensure that our compensation reflects both your impact and our shared success.
 
 
**Pay Range:**
$124,518 – $156,746 per year, based on your experience, skills, and qualifications.
 
 
**Bonus Eligibility:**
This position is eligible for an annual individual incentive based on company performance. Maximum bonus amounts may vary depending on role.
 
 
**Benefits:**
Eligible for standard company benefits, including health, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) retirement plan with company match, paid time off, and other employee programs. More detailed information is available at 2026 GFS Benefits .
 
 
Actual compensation will be determined by factors including experience, education, certifications, skill level, and market conditions. For remote or hybrid positions, the listed pay range applies to applicants in the specified location.
 
 
**About GFS**
Global Finishing Solutions is the leading manufacturer of paint booths and finishing systems serving automotive, aerospace, industrial manufacturing, marine, military, rail, trucking, and wood finishing markets. We specialize in building custom solutions that meet each customer’s unique needs—and we do it with a team that thrives on collaboration and innovation because we're different.
 
 
What makes us different is our unwavering commitment to our core values of family, respect, partnership, improvement, and integrity. We are a family-oriented organization that still values the little things, creating a workplace where you can thrive, fairness guides every decision, and collaboration drives shared success. Small town in spirit but big-hearted in impact, here you’re not just joining a company—you’re joining a team that grows together, celebrates together, and builds lasting value together. That’s the difference. Join us.
 
 
Apply now at www.gfscareers.us
 
 
🌐 About GFS
 
 
📹 Watch Us in Action
 
 
🔗 Connect on LinkedIn
 
 
**Equal Opportunity Employer**
**GFS is proud to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants**
. We welcome candidates of all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, sex, age, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, or any other status protected by law. Employment offers are subject to successful completion of pre-employment drug screening and physicals, consistent with applicable laws.
 
 
Note to recruiters: GFS only works with agencies that have signed a contract with our HR team. Resumes sent directly to hiring managers without a prior agreement are considered unsolicited and the property of GFS. Placement fees will not be paid without a formal contract.

records.title: Director, Quality
records.description:
**Position Summary**
The Director, Quality is responsible for leading multiple manufacturing/service sites and/or corporate quality resources in the execution of the overall STERIS Quality System. This position is principally responsible for manufacturing/service site or functional quality system execution to drive product/service quality improvement and ensure compliance with, as appropriate, ISO 9001, ISO 13485, MDSAP, FDA QMSR CFR Part 820/211, EU MDR, and other applicable standards. Supporting the GI Reprocessing business, this role provides quality leadership for products, processes, and services that help healthcare providers safely clean, disinfect, and reprocess gastrointestinal endoscopes and related equipment. The Director will champion a culture of quality, compliance, and continuous improvement, helping ensure the delivery of safe, effective, and reliable solutions that support infection prevention, patient safety, and customer confidence. The Quality Director will lead teams of quality managers and engineers responsible for product and service quality, supplier quality, new product/service support, continuous improvement initiatives, and quality system execution. This leader will partner closely with Operations, Engineering, Regulatory Affairs, and Commercial teams to drive operational excellence, mitigate risk, support innovation, and enhance quality performance across the GI Reprocessing portfolio.
 
 
Preferred onsite location: Mentor, OH, with consideration for candidates based in Plymouth, MN or Conroe, TX.
 
 
**What You’ll Do As a Director Quality**

* The Director, Quality will have responsibility for the following: Leads manufacturing/service sites and/or corporate quality staff in the execution and continuous improvement of the STERIS Quality System. Operates with a focus on the following objectives:

+ Ensures site level compliance to appropriate ISO, FDA, and other applicable regulatory standards.
+ Drives strategies and methods to continuously improve capital, consumable and service product quality performance.
+ Establishes clear and consistent quality measurement systems in order to monitor and drive results.
+ Leads quality planning and the execution of assigned New Product/Service Development (NPD) projects to achieve targeted quality deliverable adherence.
+ Drives targeted supplier quality improvement efforts and oversees supplier evaluation, approval, and control for assigned manufacturing sites.
+ Assists in the continuous improvement and standardization of quality system procedures and monitor effectiveness.
+ Supports the reliability function by integrating design for reliability tools and techniques within the local projects.
+ Leads quality planning efforts through cross-functional teaming at a site level.

* Supports the New Product/Service Development process and projects to ensure projects attain cost, quality, and delivery objectives.
* Directs local staff on planning sequential and concurrent quality activities. Establish planning and monitoring tools and techniques.
* Provides Quality viewpoints and opinions in planning and specifying existing and future products.
* Assists in the development of the Quality budget. Helps to ensures resources are adequate to fully support the Quality System.
* Takes ownership of all local quality issues, projects, and development activities. Works closely with the site’s Senior Management Teams to provide strategic direction and development of the manufacturing sites product quality strategies and tactics.
* Manages and provide direction to a teams of quality professionals both at corporate and manufacturing sites, with responsibility for hiring, performance management, appropriate staffing, and deployment of resources.
* Assures that local sites maintain and improve operational and quality systems to remain in a state of compliance to appropriate ISO, FDA, and other applicable regulatory standards.
* Works closely with the regulatory function to ensure compliance to appropriate ISO and FDA standards; plans for and assists in the management of external audits.
* Leads manufacturing and service site quality teams to ensure alignment to operations, support of Lean efforts and drive quality improvement performance for products, services, and processes across the sites.
* This individual has autonomy to perform the duties of Person Responsible for Regulatory Compliance (PRRC) on behalf of STERIS legal manufacturing entities under the EU MDR. This individual shall suffer no disadvantage within the organization in relation to proper fulfilment of his or her duties in lieu of article 15 of the EU MDR.

**Required**
**The Experience, Skills, and Abilities Needed**

* Bachelor’s Degree (Engineering or related technical field)
* Minimum 10 years of experience with increased responsibility leading quality system and product quality improvement efforts. Exceptional leadership manifested through organizing and motivating teams toward their respective goals by employing hands-on management.
* Must fulfil the experience requirements listed in Article 15 of the EUMDR (PRRC).
* A solid quality foundation indicated by a demonstrated understanding of Lean/Six Sigma, quality system, and product/process improvement methodologies.
* Solid business acumen and proven ability to build and lead process and product improvement strategies and results.
* Strong expertise in analytical methods, quality systems, and continuous improvement methods.
* Excellent interpersonal, as well as verbal and written communication skills in order to develop and maintain rapport and effective internal and external relationships to support business success.
* The ability to work hard and deliver results under pressure, as well as the willingness to address and shift priorities in rapidly changing markets.

**Preferred**

* Advanced degree.
* Experience with statistical analysis software and Visio.
* Experience in medical device industry.

**Other**

* Excellent problem-solving skills.
* Focus on identification of potential issues and continuous improvement.
* Experience working on cross-functional teams and on own initiative.
* Demonstrated excellent organizational, oral, and written communications skills.
* Must have PC experience, as well as working familiarity of desktop applications including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.

**What STERIS Offers**
We value our employees and are committed to providing a comprehensive benefits package that supports your health, well-being, and financial future.
 
 
**Here Is a Brief Overview Of What We Offer**

* Market competitive pay
* Extensive paid time off and (9) added holidays
* Excellent healthcare, dental, and vision benefits
* Long/short term disability coverage
* 401(K) with company match
* Maternity and parental leave
* Additional add on benefits/discounts for programs such as pet insurance
* Tuition reimbursement and continued educational programs
* Excellent opportunities for advancement in a stable long-term career

Pay range for this opportunity is $144,500.00 - $187,000.00. This position is eligible for bonus participation.
 
 
Minimum pay rates offered will comply with county/city minimums, if higher than range listed. Pay rates are based on a number of factors, including but not limited to local labor market costs, years of relevant experience, education, professional certifications, foreign language fluency, etc.
 
 
STERIS offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits portfolio. Click here for a complete list of benefits: STERIS Benefits
 
 
Open until position is filled.
 
 
STERIS is a leading global provider of products and services that support patient care with an emphasis on infection prevention. WE HELP OUR CUSTOMERS CREATE A HEALTHIER AND SAFER WORLD by providing innovative healthcare and life sciences products and services around the globe. For more information, visit www.steris.com.
 
 
If you need assistance completing the application process, please call 1 (440) 392.7047. This contact information is for accommodation inquiries only and cannot be used to check application status.
 
 
STERIS is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity to ensure that persons are recruited, hired, trained, transferred and promoted in all job groups regardless of race, color, religion, age, disability, national origin, citizenship status, military or veteran status, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, and any other category protected by federal, state or local law. We are not only committed to this policy by our status as a federal government contractor, but also we are strongly bound by the principle of equal employment opportunity.
 
 
The full affirmative action program, absent the data metrics required by
 
 

* 60-741.44(k), shall be available to all employees and applicants for employment for inspection upon request. The program may be obtained at your location’s HR Office during normal business hours.

records.title: Director of Quality Assurance
records.description:
Elevate is committed to providing the highest quality commercial roofing, wall and lining systems to solve our customers’ challenges, grounded by a 45-year legacy of proven experience. Our mission is to deliver solutions that save time, perform reliably and protect our communities. We are devoted to building partnerships rooted in trust in reflection of our Elevate promise that Nobody Covers You Better™.
 
 
Elevate is part of the Amrize family of brands. Visit ElevateCommercialBP.com to learn more.
 
 
We’re seeking a Director of Quality Assurance who’s ready to be part of a people-first company offering best-in-class products, exceptional training, and deep industry pride—all built to help our partners and team succeed.
 
 
**About The Role**
The Quality Assurance Director strategically leads the development, implementation, and maintenance of comprehensive quality evaluation and control systems across the organization. This includes overseeing the design and analysis of inspection and testing processes, ensuring the precision and accuracy of products and equipment, driving root cause analysis for incidents, and establishing compliance with reliability standards and documentation requirements to uphold the highest levels of product quality and operational excellence
 
 
**What You'll Accomplish**

* Strategic Oversight - Overseeing and directing the overall operations of quality assurance within a company to ensure continuous improvement and compliance. This involves defining and promoting a quality mindset across the entire company.
* Quality Management System - Developing and implementing quality management systems to ensure product and service quality, and maintaining and improving quality standards, policies, and procedures.
* Compliance & Regulatory Oversight - Ensuring compliance with industry standards, regulations, and company policies, and coordinating with regulatory bodies and external auditors.
* Quality Control, Claim Mgmt, Supplier Quality - Overseeing quality control processes to ensure products meet quality standards, and conducting regular quality audits and inspections to identify and address quality issues.This also includes establishing and enforcing quality standards, testing materials and products, and developing raw material and in-process product inspection standards.
* Continuous Improvement - Leading continuous improvement initiatives to enhance product quality and operational efficiency, and implementing best practices to reduce defects and improve processes. This can involve applying tools such as CAPA, SPC charts, Root Cause Analysis, and FMEA, and leading Six Sigma or Lean initiatives.
* Leadership & Team Development - Leading and mentoring the quality assurance team, fostering a culture of high performance and professional development, and ensuring the team has the necessary skills and resources. Responsible for generating a culture of collaboration across the organization.
* Budget & Financial Management - Achieving financial objectives by preparing the quality assurance budget, scheduling expenditures, analyzing variances, and initiating corrective actions.
* Customer Experience - Gathering customer feedback through gemba and data collection on quality andperformance, ensuring products meet or exceed customer expectations, and implementing changes based on feedback
* Demonstrate a commitment to communicating, improving and adhering to health, safety and environmental policies in all work environments and areas.
* Promote a culture of safety and exhibit these behaviors.

**What We're Looking For**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality Mgmt, or related discipline from an accredited university or college.
* At least 8 y+ years of relevant quality, continuous improvement, manufacturing experience including at least 5 years management or direct/indirect leadership experience.
* 3+ years of QMS / ISO9001 or similar experience required.
* CMQ/QE, CQE, CQA are all preferred.
* Six Sigma certification preferred.

**Additional Requirements**

* Successful candidates must adhere to all safety protocols and proper use of Amrize approved Personal Protection Equipment ("PPE"), including but not limited to respirators.
* Employees that are required to wear respirators must be clean shaven where the respirator seal meets the face in order to pass the qualitative and quantitative fit tests.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary
* Retirement Savings: Choose from 401(k) pre-tax and/or Roth after-tax savings
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Medical, Dental, Disability and Life Insurance
* Holistic Health & Well-being programs
* Health Savings Accounts (HSAs) & Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs) for health and dependent care
* Vision and other Voluntary benefits and discounts
* Paid time off & paid holidays
* Paid Parental Leave (maternity & paternity)
* Educational Assistance Program

records.title: Director, Field Quality
records.description:
Our purpose,
*Refresh the world and make a difference*
, is uniquely us, and part of our vision includes making a positive difference in people's lives, communities, and our planet by doing business the right way.
 
 
The Director, Field Quality plays a critical role within the North America Operating Unit Supply Chain QSE organization. This position is responsible for driving the consistent execution of quality and food safety programs across company-owned and co-manufacturing operations within assigned regions. The role ensures facilities maintain audit readiness, comply with internal and external regulatory requirements, and fosters a culture of continuous improvement. By providing technical expertise and leadership, this role enables operational excellence and ensures our products meet the highest standards of quality and safety
 
 
**What You’ll Do For Us**

* Provide leadership and technical guidance for quality programs across assigned regions.
* Ensure facilities comply with internal standards, regulatory requirements, and maintain audit readiness.
* Implement and maintain foundational quality systems, including adherence to the TCCC and NAOU Quality requirements.
* Monitor regional quality metrics, consumer complaint data, and operational trends to identify and mitigate risks proactively.
* Lead root cause analysis and corrective action planning for quality system failures and IMCR events within assigned regions.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to troubleshoot issues and support commercialization processes for new products and packages.
* Deliver quality training programs to build plant-level expertise and ensure consistent execution of standards.
* Champion digital tools and data-driven approaches to enhance quality performance and operational efficiency.

**Requirements & Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Science, Engineering, or related technical field.
* HACCP/PCQI Certification required.
* 8+ years of experience in quality and food safety within FMCG (Fast-Moving Consumer Goods) or pharmaceutical sectors.
* Experience implementing quality assurance, quality control, and management system programs (e.g., HACCP, GFSI, ISO9000/22000, SPC).
* Strong problem-solving skills and experience with root cause analysis.
* Familiarity with digital quality and compliance systems (e.g., EtQ, SAP, SPC/InfinityQS).
* Excellent communication skills (written, verbal, and presentation).
* Exposure to lean/six sigma tools and methodologies preferred.
* Ability to travel 50–75% within North America.

**Skills**
Regulatory & Food Safety Knowledge, Cross-Functional Collaboration, Technical Leadership, Continuous Improvement Mindset, Quality Systems Management
 
 
**What We Can Do For You**
 
 

* Innovative Technology:  We utilize and lead the market with our large supply chain network and state-of-art technology we use each day.
* Exposure to World Class Leaders: Availability to global technology leaders that will expand your network and exposure you to emerging technologies and techniques.
* Agile Work Environment: We embrace agile with management that believes in removing barriers, so you are empowered to experiment, iterate, and innovate.

records.description:
RELOCATION ASSISTANCE: Relocation assistance may be available
 
 
CLEARANCE REQUIRED FOR START: Yes
 
 
CLEARANCE TYPE: Secret
 
 
TRAVEL: Yes, 10% of the Time
 
 
**Description**
At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.
 
 
Northrop Grumman’s Defense Systems is looking for a
**Director Mission Assurance 1**
to lead the Quality and Mission Assurance organization for the Strategic Deterrent Systems Division. This leadership role is located in
**Roy, Utah**
. This role requires strong leadership, communication, and organizational skills to lead in a dynamic engineering and production environment. There is significant responsibility and visibility with executive leadership and the broad customer organization.
 
 
**What You'll Get To Do**

* Defines and monitors mission assurance program specifications and processes to ensure mission success of programs.
* Performs or assures quality, risk management, safety, reliability and maintainability of program achievements, subcontractors, and suppliers in accordance with contractual requirements.
* Assesses program performance and risks and determines resources to ensure mission assurance.
* Ensures the on-time delivery of high-quality products and services that meet all contractual requirements and business objectives.
* Drives the continuous improvement of people (to include training & development), products, processes, systems and services through the application of world class manufacturing to include innovative technologies, lean principles, six-sigma projects, and common best practices.
* Develops, maintains, and ensures compliance with mission assurance programs, policies, processes, procedures and that the performance and quality of products/processes conform to established standards, specifications and agency guidelines.
* Provides expertise and guidance in interpreting policies, regulatory and/or governmental regulations, and agency guidelines to assure compliance.
* Provides leadership that fosters an inclusive, motivated and engaged work culture.
* Supports the development phase of programs by assuring engineering products and processes conform to internal and customer requirements.
* Works directly with operating entities such as engineering and manufacturing to ensure that inspections, process control analyses and audits are conducted on a continuing basis to enforce requirements and compliance.
* Ensures the Quality/Mission Assurance, Manufacturing, and Engineering processes are consistent with industry capability maturity models and QMS standards (AS9100).
* Provides direct oversight in all efforts related to factory accountability and foreign object elimination practices.
* Reviews trend metrics and analyze misses in order to implement the appropriate improvements to improve performance.
* Standardizes and facilitate root cause / corrective action efforts to resolve quality issues.

As a full-time employee of Northrop Grumman Defense Systems, you are eligible for our robust benefits package including:
 
 

* Medical, Dental & Vision coverage
* 401k
* Educational Assistance
* Life Insurance
* Employee Assistance Programs & Work/Life Solutions
* Paid Time Off
* Health & Wellness Resources
* Employee Discounts

This position’s standard work schedule is a 9/80. The 9/80 schedule allows employees who work a nine-hour day Monday through Thursday to take every other Friday off. This role may offer a competitive relocation assistance package.
 
 
**You’ll Bring These Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree and 10+ years of related technical experience or a Masters with 8 years of experience
* Demonstrated experience developing, communicating and instituting new processes for an organization
* Experience managing people
* 5 years of experience in Quality Assurance or Mission Assurance specific roles
* 5 years of experience in metric development for process health and performance monitoring large programs/projects
* Leadership experience in both EMD and Production programs
* Active US Government Secret Clearance adjudicated in the last 6 years with ability to obtain SAP and Top-Secret Clearance

**These Qualifications Would Be Nice To Have**

* 10 years Executive Leadership experience, preferably within the Aerospace and Defense industry
* NG QMS familiarity
* ISO 9001 and AS9100 familiarity
* MS or MBA degree highly preferred
* Active Top Secret Clearance

Primary Level Salary Range: $182,500.00 - $273,500.00
 
 
The above salary range represents a general guideline; however, Northrop Grumman considers a number of factors when determining base salary offers such as the scope and responsibilities of the position and the candidate's experience, education, skills and current market conditions.
 
 
Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay. Annual bonuses are designed to reward individual contributions as well as allow employees to share in company results. Employees in Vice President or Director positions may be eligible for Long Term Incentives. In addition, Northrop Grumman provides a variety of benefits including health insurance coverage, life and disability insurance, savings plan, Company paid holidays and paid time off (PTO) for vacation and/or personal business.
 
 
The application period for the job is estimated to be 20 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates.
 
 
Northrop Grumman is an Equal Opportunity Employer, making decisions without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, or any other protected class. For our complete EEO and pay transparency statement, please visit http://www.northropgrumman.com/EEO. U.S. Citizenship is required for all positions with a government clearance and certain other restricted positions.

records.title: Director of Quality Assurance
records.description:
**About CAMP Systems:**
At CAMP Systems, we are the trusted leader in aircraft compliance and health management, proudly serving the global business aviation industry. With over 20,000 aircraft and 33,000 engines supported on our cutting-edge platforms, and partnerships with more than 1,300 maintenance facilities and parts suppliers worldwide, we’re shaping the future of aviation technology. Since our founding in 1968, we’ve grown to a dynamic team of 1,600+ employees across 14 locations globally—all united by a passion for innovation and excellence.

**Our Mission & Vision:**
We connect the aviation industry through smart technology to make flight safer and more efficient, driving the future of aviation with intelligence and exceptional customer experiences.

**Our Values & Excellence Mindset:**
We are customer obsessed, trust-driven, owners of our work, stronger together, constantly curious, and boldly innovative.

**What You Will Experience in This Role:**

The Director - Quality Assurance drives quality across CAMP's Aircraft Health Management business and provides quality oversight for data and process quality concerns. The role owns the QMS, the internal audit program, and the full quality escape lifecycle, and serves as CAMP's quality voice with OEMs, regulators, and key customers. The right candidate combines deep aviation maintenance knowledge with a disciplined, data-driven approach to compliance and continuous improvement.

This is a high-visibility leadership role reporting to the Vice President, Aviation Health Management Operations. The Director partners with senior leaders across a global organization and will build on an established quality program: strengthening the QMS, deepening OEM and customer confidence, and scaling quality practices as AHM grows.

**Responsibilities:**

**Strategy & Leadership**

* Own and lead quality strategy across the full Aircraft Health Management organization, spanning maintenance tracking and engine health monitoring services, aligned with CAMP's business objectives.
* Serve as the escalation point for quality complaints from customer-facing, maintenance compliance, engine health monitoring, flight scheduling, and inventory functions.
* Partner with senior management and departmental leaders to embed quality methodologies across the organization and lead the associated change management.
* Own the quality budget, resource plan, and tooling (QMS, audit, and corrective action platforms), and build the succession pipeline for the quality team.

**Quality Management System & Certification**

* Own the Quality Management System (QMS) and quality SOPs, driving continuous improvement and ensuring processes meet strict regulatory and OEM requirements.
* Maintain ISO 9001 (or higher) certification for the engine health monitoring business, serving as external certification audit lead and ensuring ongoing audit readiness.
* Lead QMS management review with executive leadership, setting risk-based quality objectives and ensuring consistent QMS implementation (document control, competency records, data integrity) across all AHM locations in North America, Europe, and India.

**Audit & Compliance**

* Own the internal audit program end to end, including audit planning, execution, reporting, and the selection, training, and management of internal auditors.
* Host and manage OEM, customer, and third-party audits, driving findings to timely closure.

**Quality Escapes & Corrective Action**

* Manage all quality escapes from intake through investigation, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive action, and verification of effectiveness, with clear accountability to customers and OEM partners.
* Define and report corrective action performance metrics (e.g., escape rate, time to containment, on-time closure, recurrence) with clear thresholds and escalation paths.

**OEM & Customer Engagement**

* Facilitate and chair weekly, monthly, and quarterly strategic OEM meetings covering quality trends, KPI compliance, and corrective action status.
* Serve as primary quality liaison to OEM partners, regulatory bodies, and high-profile customers and large fleet operators under significant OEM contracts.
* Facilitate weekly, monthly, and quarterly quality reviews with senior management and functional leaders, translating escape, audit, and customer feedback data into trends and strategic quality initiatives.

**Continuous Improvement & Team Leadership**

* Lead process improvement using Lean Six Sigma methods, mentoring teams and driving measurable reductions in escapes, rework, and risk.
* Maintain an executive quality scorecard (customer feedback, escapes, audit results, corrective action performance) to drive data-based decisions.
* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of four, setting priorities and fostering a culture of excellence, accountability, and collaboration.
* Partner with AHM operations, training, and product leaders to ensure analyst competency, training effectiveness, and quality readiness for new products, processes, and teams.

**You have:**

* Bachelor's degree in Aerospace, Engineering, Quality Management, or a related field; advanced degree a plus.
* Minimum of 10 years of proven leadership experience in the aviation or aerospace sector, with senior quality assurance experience preferred.
* Strong working knowledge of aviation maintenance and its regulatory requirements (FAA, EASA, and OEM requirements). Hands-on aviation maintenance experience may offset formal credentials.
* Experience managing quality escapes, investigations, root cause analysis, and corrective action programs.
* Experience owning or managing a QMS in a regulated environment, with working knowledge of ISO 9001 (AS9100 familiarity a plus).
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn quality data into executive-level metrics, insights, and recommendations.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills, with the ability to build relationships with OEMs, customers, and leaders at all levels of the organization.
* Strategic thinking with a strong focus on results and the ability to manage complex projects and initiatives.
* Ability to lead across a multi-site, multi-region team; willingness to travel to CAMP offices, OEM, and customer sites as needed.

**Nice to have:**

* Certified ISO 9001 Internal/External Auditor (or equivalent lead auditor certification) with hands-on audit experience.
* Six Sigma Black Belt, with demonstrated process improvement results.
* Quality manager certification (e.g., ASQ CQM) or Certified Quality Auditor (CQA) is a bonus.
* Experience working with large OEM contracts and high-profile customers or large fleet operators.
* Experience in aircraft maintenance tracking, engine trend monitoring, or other SaaS/data-driven service environments.

**Why Work at CAMP?**

Join a culture where your ideas matter, your impact is real, and your growth is supported. Be part of a team reimagining the future of aviation.

CAMP is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer - vets/disabled

CAMP is committed to providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. To request reasonable accommodation, please contact hr@campsystems.com.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status EEO.

Equal Opportunity Employer
 
 
This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws.
 
For further information, please review the Know Your Rights notice from the Department of Labor.

records.description:
***Title: Director of Quality, Regulatory and Improvement***

**Job Summary:**

This senior leadership role leads the quality departments for all Deringer-Ney locations globally. The Director implements best practices and metrics to coordinate all teams under a unified Quality Management System and is responsible for ensuring that the company's products, services, and manufacturing processes comply with strict government laws, industry standards, and internal quality systems. The role plans, coordinates, and directs the activities of the quality assurance and compliance programs to ensure the production of consistent, reliable products that meet or exceed established standards, and leads the continuous improvement team to support, train, and execute the DNIOS system.

***Supervisory Responsibilities:***
*Yes*

**Duties/Responsibilities:**

* Manage all quality departments by formulating, developing, and overseeing global goals, objectives, policies, procedures, systems, and outcomes pertaining to quality controls, assessments, and audits.
* Quality Management Systems (QMS): Build, maintain, and continuously improve QMS frameworks (such as ISO 13485 and ISO 9001).
* Develop a high-performance team by acquiring, developing, training, coaching, cultivating, and managing talented Quality Control personnel.
* Maintain and improve the quality system through routine system audits and corrective actions, and ensure that corrective actions, whether internal or external, are handled in a timely manner.
* Risk & Lifecycle Management: Oversee design controls, validation packages, complaint handling, and post-market surveillance (such as Automotive Reporting).
* Manage and maintain quality inspection and product release programs for raw materials, work in process (WIP), and finished goods.
* Regulatory Compliance & Filings: Lead product submissions and act as the primary liaison during agency audits.
* Disseminate quality awareness, adherence, and developments to global stakeholders by scheduling and performing regional quality audits and by ensuring that ISO systems are managed and maintained.
* Serve as an active member of the DNI Leadership Team, sharing the function's progress toward its goals while setting, and driving toward, an aspirational vision for a best-in-class quality department.
* Create a Cost of Poor Quality metric for the organization and set specific goals to improve quality performance across the company.
* Lead the development of the Annual Strategic Planning (P.D.C.A.) Cycle to include the Improvement Process.
* Lead the organization in attaining key metrics based on Balanced Scorecard (BSC) Objectives. Understand the department's key performance indicators and leading and lagging indicators, and contribute to achieving these goals, both individually and as a team.
* With the CIP Team, perform systematic audits designed to confirm that process standards are being utilized and met (BSC One-Page Reports).
* Interact with and make recommendations and presentations to the Executive Leadership Group via standardized checks: weekly, monthly, quarterly, and year-end. Maintain the PDCA Cycle while focusing on BSC Objectives.

**Required Skills/Abilities:**

* Strong background in ISO 9000 system management, including training and auditing.
* Strong background in ISO 13485 system management and thorough knowledge of FDA requirements and other international standards that regulate the medical device industry.
* Knowledge of automated inspection equipment, including vision systems and coordinate measuring devices.
* Adept at delegating and managing multiple tasks with various levels of priority.
* Excellent communication skills; must be able to present ideas, results, and requirements effectively throughout the organization and to the customer on a timely basis.
* Expert skill set in applied statistics, reliability, design of experiments, MSA, GR&R, and project management.
* Fluency with various software packages commonly used in project management, database, SPC, word processing, and data acquisition.
* Analytical, problem-solving, project management, facilitation, and decision-making skills are essential.
* Strong leadership skills with the ability to motivate, coach, resolve conflict, and promote teamwork.
* Ability to see and hear the facts from several viewpoints while promoting success through interactive problem solving and teamwork.

**Experience & Education Requirements:**

* Technical degree (BS, BSE, or BSME) with a minimum of 10 years' experience in quality engineering or quality management.
* Strong preference for relevant industry experience in a metals or electrical connectors company or similar.
* 10+ years of progressive experience in Quality Assurance, Quality Control, or Regulatory Affairs within a regulated field such as medical devices, automotive, or defense.
* Preferred certifications: Regulatory Affairs Certification (RAC), Certified Quality Auditor (CQA), or Certified Quality Engineer (CQE).
* Demonstrated project management skills in the areas of process control, SPC, automotive PPAP submission, and statistical analysis.
* Lean Green Belt or Black Belt certification, Six Sigma, and DMAIC process experience.
* Actively continuing training through courses and seminars.

***Physical Requirements:***

* Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
* Must be able to lift 15 pounds at times.
* Must be able to access and navigate each department at the organization’s facilities.
* Travel to other locations as required.

records.description:
**Job Description**
**Benefits:**
ABM offers a comprehensive benefits package. For information about ABM’s benefits, visit ABM Employee Benefits | Staff & Management
 
 
**Position Summary:**
The Director of Quality Management – APS is responsible for establishing, leading, and continuously improving the enterprise quality management program across all APS services. This role ensures service excellence, regulatory compliance, and customer satisfaction through standardized processes, performance measurement, and continuous improvement.
 
 
This leader partners with enterprise functions and operational stakeholders to document, standardize, and scale quality-of-service delivery across current and future APS sites. Responsibilities include developing quality frameworks, policies, playbooks, training programs, and performance reporting while driving actionable improvements aligned with APS Operating System, company initiatives and industry best practices.
 
 
To design, implement, and sustain a comprehensive quality management system that enhances efficiency, performance, and consistency across APS services while ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, APS Operating System, ABM standards, and client commitments. The role promotes a culture of continuous improvement and leverages technology and data to support operational excellence and client retention.
 
 
**Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute an enterprise quality strategy aligned with APS Operating System, and ABM business objectives.
* Design, implement, and maintain a comprehensive quality management program, including standards, governance, measurement frameworks, training, audits, and reporting.
* Establish and enforce quality control standards across all APS service lines.
* Lead audits and assessments and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Ensure compliance with regulatory, safety, environmental, and industry standards (e.g., OSHA, ISO, APPA).
* Analyze performance data to identify trends, risks, and improvement opportunities.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to implement process improvements that enhance efficiency, quality, and cost performance.
* Collaborate with Client Experience and operational leaders to drive consistency and improve customer satisfaction.
* Develop KPIs and reporting to provide insights to senior leadership.
* Build training programs and foster a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
* Support special projectsand additional responsibilities as assigned.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Project Management, Facility Management, or related discipline, or equivalent experience.
* Master’s degree and/or relevant certifications (e.g., Six Sigma Black Belt, ISO) preferred.
* 8–10 years of quality management experience, including at least 5 years in a leadership role.
* Strong knowledge of quality assurance methodologies, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.
* Experience with enterprise systems supporting the built environment (CMMS, BAS, BMS, IWMS).
* Proficiency in data analysis and quality management tools.
* Familiarity with emerging technologies such as IoT, AI, VR, and smart building solutions.
* Excellent communication skills and ability to lead change in a matrixed environment.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and collaboration tools.
* Ability to handle confidential information with discretion.
* Ability to travel up to 60%.

**About Us**
ABM (NYSE: ABM) is one of the world’s largest providers of integrated facility, engineering, and infrastructure solutions. Every day, our over 100,000 team members deliver essential services that make spaces cleaner, safer, and efficient, enhancing the overall occupant experience.
 
 
ABM serves a wide range of market sectors including commercial real estate, aviation, education, mission critical, and manufacturing and distribution. With over $8 billion in annual revenue and a blue-chip client base, ABM delivers innovative technologies and sustainable solutions that enhance facilities and empower clients to achieve their goals. Committed to creating smarter, more connected spaces, ABM is investing in the future to meet evolving challenges and build a healthier, thriving world. ABM: Driving possibility, together.
 
 
ABM is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer that does not discriminate on the basis of any trait or characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law, including disability and protected veteran status. ABM is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to individuals with disabilities. If you have a disability and need assistance in completing the employment application, please call 888-328-8606. We will provide you with assistance and make a determination on your request for reasonable accommodation on a case-by-case basis.
 
 
ABM participates in the U.S. Department of Homeland Security E-Verify program. E-Verify is an internet-based system used to electronically confirm employment eligibility.
 
 
ABM is a military-friendly company proudly employing thousands of men and women who have served in the U.S. military. With ABM, you’ll have access to a world-class training program and ample opportunities to use the skills you developed while serving our country. Whether you’re looking for a frontline or professional position, you can find post-military career opportunities across ABM.
 
 
ABM directs all applicants to apply at www.abm.com/careers . ABM does not accept unsolicited resumes or submissions outside of this portal. Applicants should submit their application by clicking Apply Now.
 
 
For more information, visit www.abm.com

records.title: VP, Global Product & Quality Excellence
records.description:
**Description**
The Opportunity
 
 
Power Integrations is seeking an exceptional executive to redefine quality as a strategic competitive advantage. This leader will transform quality from a functional discipline into an enterprise capability that accelerates innovation, strengthens customer confidence, improves product reliability and enables profitable growth. As a fabless semiconductor company, the role spans the entire product lifecycle—from architecture through field performance—while driving excellence across external wafer fabrication, assembly and test partners.
 
 
Mission
 
 
Build a world-class Product & Quality Excellence organization that embeds quality into every engineering decision, every supplier relationship and every customer experience.
 
 
Executive Mandate
 
 

* Create an enterprise-wide Quality First culture where quality is designed into products rather than inspected into them.
* Own end-to-end product quality, reliability engineering, supplier quality, customer quality and quality systems.
* Partner with Engineering to strengthen Design for Quality, verification, failure analysis and reliability methodologies.
* Lead quality across outsourced manufacturing partners, ensuring robust process controls, change management and continuous improvement.
* Establish executive quality governance, enterprise KPIs and Board-level reporting.

First-Year Transformation Priorities
 
 
**First 90 Days:**
Assess product quality, reliability, supplier performance, customer escalations, organizational capability and quality systems. Build executive alignment and establish the transformation roadmap.
 
 
**90–180 Days:**
Launch Design for Quality, supplier excellence and customer quality initiatives. Implement enterprise dashboards, governance and standardized quality reviews.
 
 
**180–365 Days:**
Deliver measurable improvements in field reliability, manufacturing quality, supplier performance, customer satisfaction and organizational quality maturity while building a sustainable culture of continuous improvement.
 
 
Measures of Success
 
 

* Reduced field failures and customer returns
* Improved product reliability and qualification effectiveness
* Higher supplier quality and manufacturing yields
* Reduced Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ)
* Faster root cause analysis and corrective actions
* Improved customer satisfaction and strategic account confidence
* Enterprise adoption of a Quality First mindset

Ideal Executive Profile
 
 

* 20+ years of semiconductor industry leadership with significant experience in analog, mixed-signal or power semiconductors.
* Executive leadership in product quality, reliability engineering, supplier quality and customer quality.
* Experience operating within a fabless semiconductor model using external manufacturing partners.
* Demonstrated success leading enterprise transformation and influencing executive leadership and Boards.
* Technical depth combined with strategic business acumen and exceptional leadership.

Leadership Competencies
 
 

* Enterprise leadership and systems thinking
* Strategic quality transformation
* Engineering partnership and technical credibility
* Customer obsession
* Data-driven decision making
* Global influence without authority
* Talent development and succession planning
* Executive communication and Board presence

Power Integrations is committed to building teams that drive innovation and therefore review a range of factors when determining compensation.
 
 
Power Integrations also offers to our eligible employees a comprehensive total rewards package that includes equity, medical benefits, ESPP, 401K, tuition reimbursement and time off programs. For additional benefits, please visit
**https://www.power.com/company/our-sustainability-priorities/people-our-engine-innovation**
.

records.title: Vice President of Quality
records.description:
**Vice President Quality**

**Global Product Distribution Quality**

**The Opportunity**

Our client is a leading global medical technology company looking to appoint a hands-on VP Global Product Distribution Quality. Reporting directly to the SVP of Corporate Quality, you will be responsible for developing and implementing business strategies to effectively manage all global product distribution quality. In this role, you will lead the global product distribution quality organization and processes, holding quality management accountability for all captive and outsourced distribution centres across every entity worldwide.

This is a genuine turnaround and organizational design mandate, rather than a caretaker or step-up role. You will step in to stabilize day-to-day operations, manage significant FDA and global regulatory scrutiny, and reshape the commercial quality infrastructure into a world-class function. For a seasoned executive who enjoys building progressive systems at scale, there is a clear path to expanded enterprise responsibility within 6 to 20 months.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Global Distribution Governance:**
 Own quality management systems/compliance performance across captive/3PL distribution centres globally - alongside full P&L, budget, and headcount accountability for the function.
* **Turnaround & Future-State Design:**
 Audit current teams, workflows, and systems to close compliance gaps, restructuring the global commercial quality organization into a streamlined, best-in-class model.
* **FDA & Global Regulatory Execution:**

records.title: Vice President Quality Control
records.description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Vice President, Quality Control based in the United States.**
The Vice President, Quality Control will provide strategic leadership for a global laboratory network supporting clinical development and commercial manufacturing programs. Reporting to the Chief Quality Officer, this executive will define and implement an enterprise-wide Quality Control strategy, ensuring scientific excellence, regulatory compliance, reliable data, and timely product release. The role oversees a broad range of laboratory operations across multiple sites and product modalities, while driving standardization, digital transformation, and operational performance. Working closely with senior executives, strategic clients, and regulatory authorities, the successful candidate will influence investment decisions, strengthen inspection readiness, and protect continuity of supply. This is an opportunity to shape a high-performing global organization and make a meaningful contribution to product quality and patient safety.
 
 
Accountabilities
 
 

* Define and execute the global Quality Control strategy, operating model, and multi-year roadmap across sites, product modalities, and development stages. Establish consistent enterprise standards, governance structures, and decision-making responsibilities while accommodating justified site-specific requirements.
* Provide executive oversight of end-to-end Quality Control operations, including analytical, biochemical, biological, microbiological, raw-material, in-process, release, and stability testing, as well as environmental and utility monitoring. Ensure laboratory capacity, priorities, and execution support program milestones, product disposition, client commitments, and uninterrupted supply.
* Govern the analytical method lifecycle from early development through transfer, qualification, validation, comparability, continued performance verification, and retirement. Ensure testing strategies and specifications evolve appropriately throughout clinical development, process performance qualification, product launch, and commercial supply.
* Establish global expectations for current good manufacturing practice, applicable good laboratory practice principles, data governance and integrity, laboratory investigations, out-of-specification and out-of-trend management, corrective and preventive action effectiveness, change control, and audit readiness. Lead enterprise-level regulatory inspection strategies and responses to critical client audits.
* Drive the global laboratory digital and technology roadmap, including laboratory information management systems, electronic laboratory notebooks, laboratory execution systems, chromatography data systems, automation, advanced analytics, and instrument connectivity. Sponsor validated technology deployment, master-data governance, cybersecurity, and adoption to improve accuracy, efficiency, and cycle times.
* Lead enterprise capacity planning, capital investment prioritization, make-versus-buy decisions, laboratory footprint strategy, and oversight of external testing partners. Align resources and contingency plans with demand forecasts, technology transfers, new product introductions, and network resilience requirements.
* Establish enterprise performance metrics and management reviews covering testing and release timelines, lead times, invalid results, out-of-specification and out-of-trend rates, investigation cycle times, corrective and preventive action effectiveness, stability execution, method performance, cost, and productivity. Promote risk-based decision-making, Lean practices, and cross-site learning.
* Act as the senior Quality Control representative for strategic clients, regulatory authorities, and executive governance. Translate complex technical and compliance risks into clear business implications, negotiate scientifically sound solutions, and ensure commitments are realistic and consistently delivered.
* Build and lead a global organization through senior leaders. Develop organizational capabilities, succession plans, technical career paths, and communities of practice while fostering scientific rigor, transparency, accountability, inclusion, and proactive risk management.
* Lead escalations and coordinated responses to significant Quality Control events, laboratory constraints, data-integrity concerns, assay failures, method or specification issues, and testing disruptions. Make or recommend risk-based decisions regarding testing strategies, product impact, remediation, and continuity of supply.
* Perform additional responsibilities in support of the broader Global Quality strategy and organizational objectives.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Biology, Microbiology, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Engineering, or a related scientific discipline, with at least 15 years of progressive Quality Control experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) sector; alternatively, a Master's degree with at least 10 years of relevant experience.
* At least 10 years of people-management experience, including a minimum of five years leading senior leaders with responsibility for multiple laboratories, sites, or functional areas.
* Demonstrated leadership of Quality Control operations across clinical development and commercial manufacturing, including analytical method transfer, qualification and validation, release and stability testing, microbiology, and environmental and utility monitoring.
* Proven experience managing global regulatory inspections and client audits, as well as complex out-of-specification, out-of-trend, data-integrity, and laboratory-compliance matters.
* Experience overseeing budgets, capital investment portfolios, headcount, laboratory capacity, external testing partners, and enterprise transformation initiatives within a complex, matrixed global organization.
* Strong executive communication, stakeholder-management, and client-facing skills, with the ability to communicate complex scientific and regulatory matters clearly and influence strategic decisions.
* An advanced scientific degree and/or a Master of Business Administration is preferred.
* Global leadership experience within a CDMO supporting biologics, vaccines, advanced therapies, or sterile manufacturing is highly desirable.
* Experience scaling Quality Control capabilities from clinical development through process performance qualification, product launch, and sustained commercial supply is an advantage.
* Working knowledge of relevant regulatory authorities, standards, and guidance, including the US Food and Drug Administration, European Medicines Agency, Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency, and Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices Agency.
* Familiarity with International Council for Harmonisation guidelines Q2, Q5, Q6, Q9, Q10, and Q14; United States Pharmacopeia; European Pharmacopoeia; Japanese Pharmacopoeia; Title 21 of the Code of Federal Regulations Parts 210, 211, and 11; European Union Good Manufacturing Practice Annexes 1 and 11; and applicable data-integrity expectations.
* Experience implementing global laboratory information management systems and laboratory digitalization and automation initiatives is preferred.
* Professional credentials from the American Society for Quality, along with Lean, Six Sigma, or equivalent quality and operational excellence training, are valued.

**Benefits**

* Annual salary range of $272,000–$325,000, with compensation determined by work location and relevant knowledge, skills, and experience.
* Medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage.
* Health Savings Account option with company contributions.
* Industry-leading 401(k) savings plan.
* Insurance coverage and employee assistance programs.
* Wellness incentives designed to support overall health and well-being.
* Paid vacation, sick leave, and company holidays.
* A supportive environment that encourages personal and professional development.
* Global scope, with the role supporting sites worldwide. Compensation and benefits are governed by the location designated as the employee's home site.

to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. **Job Description**
Our client, an organization that provides comprehensive outpatient and inpatient mental health services, is hiring a
**Vice President of Quality Management, RN.**
The Vice President of Quality Management, RN, will provide executive leadership while remaining actively engaged in day-to-day quality operations. The role is designed for a hands-on, player-coach leader who can guide the quality team, strengthen performance, and contribute directly to departmental priorities.
 
 
**Responsibilities**

* Lead and support the quality management function at both strategic and operational levels.
* Serve as an engaged player-coach who works directly with the team and remains involved in execution.
* Provide guidance, direction, and leadership to quality management professionals.
* Promote effective quality practices and continuous operational improvement.
* Represent the quality function with strong executive presence and sound professional judgment.

**Requirements**

* Demonstrated leadership experience in quality management.
* Ability to operate as a hands-on leader while effectively coaching and developing a team.
* Strong executive presence and the ability to communicate effectively with senior leadership.
* Proven ability to work in the details while maintaining a strategic perspective.
* Excellent judgment, collaboration, communication, and organizational skills.
* Preferred educational background, required years of experience, certifications, travel expectations, and additional technical qualifications were not provided and should be confirmed before publication.
* Candidates with relevant industry experience and a record of leading quality improvement initiatives are encouraged to apply.

Some of the Benefits
 
 

* Competitive salary.
* Potential bonus opportunity.

If you would like to request an alternative selection process or a reasonable accommodation, please contact Tal Healthcare at operations@talhealthcare.com.

records.title: VP Operations
records.description:
Daubert Chemical Company is seeking a Vice President of Operations at our specialty chemical plant near Midway airport. The VP leads the functional areas of chemical production, customer service, supply chain, engineering, maintenance and reliability, and EHS. The VP of Operations is a member of the executive team reporting to the CEO, and is accountable for achieving safe, reliable, efficient, and cost-effective operations while consistently meeting product quality standards, customer commitments, and regulatory requirements. This leader will establish clear performance and behavioral expectations, execute with the appropriate sense of urgency, develop organizational capabilities, and drive accountability across all operational functions.
 
 
The successful candidate will balance day-to-day operational execution with long-term strategic planning, continuous improvement and corrective action programs, ensuring that plant equipment, processes, systems, and people are positioned to support business growth and operational excellence.
 
 
This position requires a hands-on, visible leader who demonstrates sound judgment, urgency, follow-up, disciplined problem-solving, and a commitment to improvement and resolution of issues via a methodical corrective action program. The VP of Operations must effectively lead through others, collaborate across departments, and develop sustainable solutions that improve safety, productivity, reliability, product quality, waste reduction, and regulatory compliance.
 
 
**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES**
include, but not limited to the following.
 
 

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of functional managers and operational leaders, establishing clear responsibilities, performance standards, and accountability. Build leadership capability at all levels through coaching, performance feedback, succession planning, and professional development
* Evaluate organizational structure, staffing levels, technical competencies, and resource requirements to ensure effective operational support
* Lead operational decision-making with a strong sense of urgency, appropriate prioritization, and consideration of safety, quality, cost, and customer impact
* Develop and manage departmental operating budgets, control expenditures, evaluate variances, and identify opportunities to improve financial performance
* Collaborate with Sales, R&D, IT, Procurement, Quality, Finance, and other functions to align operational capabilities with business requirements
* Provide leadership to production management to optimize plant capacity, equipment utilization, labor resources, product mix, and material availability
* Develop and ensure execution of a long-range capital investment plan; provide strategic leadership and oversight of plant engineering, equipment performance, reliability initiatives, and capital improvement projects that align with business priorities and integrate safety and environmental considerations
* Direct the team in the development and effectiveness of preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance programs
* Provide executive oversight of EHS programs and ensure compliance with applicable OSHA, EPA, state, local, and other regulatory requirements
* Support effective safety inspections, regulatory audits, incident investigations, corrective actions, and ongoing risk-reduction initiatives
* Champion the use of structured problem-solving, root cause analysis, 5S, and other appropriate improvement methodologies
* Foster a culture of respect, teamwork, ownership, continuous learning, and personal accountability.
* Demonstrate and reinforce the company's Core Values: Reliable, Improving, Fair, and Caring

**Supervisory Responsibilities**
Directly manages functional leaders. Performs managerial responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws, such as recruitment, selection, training, goals, performance expectations and accountability, compensation management.
 
 
**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical discipline required; Chemical Engineering strongly preferred. MBA preferred.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressive manufacturing and operations leadership experience, including at least five years leading managers and multiple operational functions
* Significant leadership experience in specialty chemical manufacturing, batch processing, or a comparable process manufacturing environment strongly preferred
* Demonstrated responsibility for managing and improving cost optimization with a multi-million-dollar operational budget in manufacturing operations, engineering, maintenance, equipment reliability, capital projects, and resource allocation
* Experience in a regulated manufacturing environment with strong safety, environmental, and process compliance requirements.
* Proven experience developing and executing operational improvement initiatives with measurable business results
* Experience leading cross-functional teams and managing competing operational priorities in a manufacturing plant
* Support change management and transactional integrity within the new ERP, Microsoft Dynamics - D365
* Expertise in methodologies like Lean or Six Sigma to streamline plant throughput and reduce waste
* Exhibits solid judgement along with decision making skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills as well as interpersonal, analytical and presentation skills.
* Must read, speak and write English fluently.
* Strong attention to detail with solid organizational and planning skills
* High degree of professional integrity, ethics and confidentiality.
* Ability to learn company ERP. Requires advances proficiency with MS Office suite i.e. Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, etc.

**Compensation & Benefits**

* Base salary range $209,000-235,000, plus management incentive bonus plan
* BCBS of Illinois Medical & Dental. Vision Service Plan.
* 401(k) Savings Plan + generous company match
* Paid time off with 11 annual Holidays
* Disability, Family, & Military Leave
* Life Insurance, Identity Protection, and more!

Relocation assistance is not available. Must be authorized to work in the U.S.
 
 
Daubert Chemical Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer: Disability/Veteran.
 
 
Powered by JazzHR

records.title: Vice President of Quality
records.description:
VP of Quality – Structural Steel & Bridge Fabrication

**Confidential Fabricator**

The cost of poor quality rarely sits in one department.

Production loses hours to repairs.

Project managers spend time chasing answers.

Shipping loses its window.

And the customer remembers who had to explain the delay.

That’s when quality becomes a leadership issue.

A large-scale structural steel and bridge fabricator is hiring a
**VP of Quality**
to set the quality strategy and make it work across engineering, fabrication and project delivery.

You’ll set expectations with department leaders, use data on rework and audit findings to decide where to act first, and build a quality team that can support the business as it grows.

You’ll need the technical credibility to challenge a welding or inspection decision and the judgment to know when a recurring issue calls for investment, a process change or clearer ownership.

**What they’re looking for**

* Senior quality leadership in structural steel, bridge fabrication or comparable heavy welded fabrication
* Experience owning a quality management system and leading quality managers or inspection teams
* Strong knowledge of AWS D1.1, AWS D1.5 and AISC certification requirements
* Evidence of measurable improvements in rework, delivery performance or customer outcomes
* Confidence representing the business with customers, auditors and third-party inspectors

**Why it’s worth a conversation**

* Executive influence over how quality decisions are made across the business
* State-of-the-art facility: 2000+ tonnes a month
* Complex steel and bridge work where those decisions have a real impact on cost and delivery
* Scope to shape the quality team, systems and standards as the business grows

If you’ve changed how a fabrication business manages quality, I’d like to hear what you changed and what improved.

**Apply on LinkedIn or message me directly for a confidential conversation.**

**Vice President of Quality | FHC**

**Shape enterprise quality. Build organizational capability. Influence the business at the highest level.**

FHC is seeking a
**Vice President of Quality**
to join the Senior Leadership Team of a
**$1.5 billion public company**
.

This opportunity calls for a quality executive who can connect technical excellence with business strategy—and build the organization, systems, and accountability needed to deliver both.

As a peer to the CFO, CHRO, COO, General Counsel, and other senior leaders, you’ll bring a clear quality perspective to enterprise decisions. You’ll need the judgment and credibility to engage a discerning Board of Directors and, potentially, major investors.

**The opportunity**

• Shape an enterprise quality strategy that supports business performance and growth.

• Build and develop a strong quality organization, with capable leaders and clear accountability.

• Partner with business and operational leaders to improve consistency, reduce risk, and strengthen customer confidence.

• Translate quality performance and emerging risks into clear insights for executive and Board discussions.

• Establish meaningful measures that connect quality improvement to customer and financial outcomes.

• Lead change across the organization and ensure improvements become sustainable practices.

**The executive we’re looking for**

You bring deep quality expertise, a record of developing quality organizations, and demonstrated success operating at the executive level.

You can move comfortably between a detailed technical discussion and an enterprise business decision. You know how to challenge constructively, influence peers, communicate difficult issues clearly, and earn trust through sound judgment and follow-through.

Experience presenting to Boards or similarly demanding executive stakeholders will be particularly valuable.

**Why consider this role?**

This is an opportunity to help shape the direction of a public company, develop its quality leadership capability, and make quality a stronger contributor to business performance.

**Interested in exploring the opportunity—or know an executive who should? Send me a direct message for a conversation about the role and its scope.**

#VPQuality #QualityLeadership #ExecutiveOpportunity #OperationalExcellence
