records.title: Senior Manager, Manufacturing Engineering Programs
records.description:
**Welcome to the future of nuclear energy**
, where Westinghouse Electric Company is leading the field with expertise and innovation to shape the power of tomorrow. At Westinghouse, innovation is in our DNA. We are creative. We think differently. We reimagine the possible across the nuclear industry every day.
 
 
**About The Role**
As a Senior Manager of MFG Engineering Programs in our New Product Introduction group, you will be responsible and accountable to lead and deliver global nuclear fuel manufacturing project execution across Westinghouse Electric Corporation (WEC) fuel manufacturing facilities in the US, UK & Sweden operations. You will be deployed to guide progress and execution of multiple projects within our organization, based on the program needs. The Sr Manager owns the global manufacturing scope of new product introduction and is accountable to lead project execution to delivery in-full, without complaint products to our customers while meeting safety and financial goals. This position will guide interaction between Fuel Engineering, Nuclear Fuel Project Managers, Product Delivery & Commercial Managers, Product Management, Supply Chain, SIOP, Plant Manufacturing Managers, Global Quality, and Supplier or customer teams. It will also coordinate on project deliverables, issues, and resolution. Program budget accountability ranges from $1M - $20M.
 
 
You will report to the Director of New Product Introduction and support the role remotely with 25 - 35% travel between global manufacturing facilities. This position may be based in the United States, Sweden, or the United Kingdom.
 
 
**Key Responsibilities**

* Comprehend entire program scope, such as commercial, licensing, regulatory and initiate appropriate scope within the manufacturing program scope.
* Support project task-based schedules and track/report milestone progress against the program management plan.
* Deploy strategies for optimizing and streamlining legacy fuel manufacturing operations in partnership with manufacturing sites and functional leads.
* Analyze existing processes and identify value-added and non-value-added activities to solve design challenges.
* Manage project risks and opportunities to closure in partnership with functional leads and Program Managers. Identify issues, propose solutions and lead recovery plans to closure.
* Implement within project schedule and budget, tracking expenses and identifying cost-savings opportunities. Communicate with partners, providing updates on project milestones, risks, critical escalations and issues.
* Present strategic project reports, status updates, and performance metrics to senior leadership and important partners.
* Identify areas of improvement or gaps in current processes and develop strategies to promote efficiency and productivity in new product and process introduction.
* Perform as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) to support project teams in new product and process development such as APQP and PPAP industry standards.
* Compare actual performance against planned performance to identify variances and help manage tasks on project planning.
* Collaborate with program team members and departments to establish plans and schedules that allocate resources to best achieve program requirements and service internal and external client or customer needs.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering.
* 10 -15 years related experience in Nuclear/ Automotive/ Heavy Engineering/ Metals Industry / Manufacturing / Assembly.
* Experience with project management and new product introduction into manufacturing.
* Analytical capabilities to identify critical schedule paths and improve engineering / supply chain timelines.
* Demonstrated skills in internal operational partner relationship management.
* Advance level PMI certification in Project Management.
* Experience of Engineering Component Manufacturing systems.
* Experience with engineering product development including design phases, manufacturing processes and global supply chain management.
* Familiarization with Kaizen, Lean Operations, FMEA's, DMAIC, DFMAs, POCA cycles.
* Familiarization with Microsoft Project, P6 or other scheduling software.

We are committed to transparency and equity in all of our people practices. This position may be based in multiple countries, and compensation is determined using the salary structure applicable to the employee's primary work location. The hiring range applicable to your work location will be provided in accordance with local requirements. Actual compensation will be determined based on work location, experience, qualifications and skills.
 
 
**Why Westinghouse?**
We know that to put forth your best effort, you need to be challenged and enjoy what you do in a supportive and respectful environment. We aim to maintain this balance by offering our employees the amenities, benefits and training they need to reach personal and professional goals.
 
 
**Below Is An Example Of What Employees Can Expect**

* Attractive pay
* Hybrid work opportunities
* High flexibility and autonomy
* Great health and welfare benefits
* Employee Assistance Program: confidential counseling and resources for employees, eligible dependents, and household members
* Learning and development opportunities
* Employee referral program
* We encourage our employees to participate in community service events and other team-building activities to strengthen their bonds and inspire each other.

Recruiters will provide specific benefits information that is applicable for this role
 
 
**You can learn more about Westinghouse by visiting**
http://www.westinghousenuclear.com .
 
 
Westinghouse is an Equal Opportunity Employer including Veterans and Individuals with Disabilities
 
 
**Get connected with Westinghouse on social media:**
**Twitter**
**|**
**Facebook**
**|**
**LinkedIn**
**|**
**YouTube**

records.title: Director of Continuous Improvement
records.description:
*Job Seekers can review the Job Applicant Privacy Policy by clicking here (http://ryder.com/job-applicant-privacy-policy) .*
**Summary**
**Job Description**
:
 
 
The Director of Continuous Improvement will support the AAI (Automotive, Aerospace, and Industrial) vertical. The services are primarily warehousing operations for distribution and inbound to manufacturing operations.
 
 
This position supports the Ryder Continuous Improvement culture across the Business Unit by actively promoting and facilitating the use of continuous improvement methods to support new and existing operations.
 
 
The Director will lead a team of CI Managers/Leads across the business to influence and drive change through data driven CI, Engineering, and Automation efforts to deliver higher levels of performance in safety, quality, delivery, cost and growth. Effectively leverage data analytics, engineering methodologies, and all Ryder lean tools to enable root cause identification and elimination.
 
 
This high influence position will interface with employees at all levels and functions across the business. This individual will work directly with his/her Operational peers in the business units to define and set a strategy for engineering efforts and continuous improvement activities. This position directly reports to the Group or Senior Director of CI with dotted-line reporting to the assigned Groub Director/VP of Operations (Business Unit/Vertical). This individual will work directly with his/her peers and their direct reports in the business units to define and set a strategy for engineering efforts and continuous improvement activities for new and existing operations.
 
 
**Essential Functions**

* Directs continuous improvement program and oversees engineering support functions .Supervise a team of continuous improvement Managers and quality professionals. Make employment decisions (hire, promote, coach, development) and manage performance. Develop CI Engineering bench to strategically support the BU/Vertical long term requirements. Manages and assigns CI resources for multiple and complex Supply Chain projects aligned with strategic and growth initiatives. Regularly interacts with Senior Management and/or customer(s).
* Aligns CI initiatives and project objectives to business strategy and prioritizes projects accordingly; includes key stakeholders in process, as required. Facilitate strategic planning (vertical blueprinting) and tactical process improvement events. Lead cross functional team to identify improvement opportunities and works with leadership to prioritize & plan initiatives. Present to executive leadership team on status and results of continuous improvement initiatives. Participate in regular business review session with VP of Operations, SCE team and Customers . Provide regular reports of data and actions to measure progress against strategic business objectives.
* Provide training, coaching, and mentoring: must be able to translate all Ryder Business System concepts and strategic objectives to local situations and help all levels of the organization develop understanding and application of tools for sustainable business improvements. Coach business owners to use Engineering, Data Analysis and Lean methods to achieve operational excellence. Support start-ups, retrofits and expansions including pricing inputs, go-live and steady state certifications.
* Work with vertical leaders to establish continuous improvement goals, and act as a liaison with finance to build continuous improvement budgets and validating actual improvement results. Develops, deploys and maintains account plans for assigned process areas designed to continually improve service offerings through the implementation of recognized engineering, quality, lean standards, continuous improvement strategies and demonstrated best practices. Manage monthly budget review process and financial reconciliation. Interfaces with senior level management to establish standard quality communications and action oriented forums (reviewing /analyzing operational performance, deploy policies and strategies, share best practices)
* Serve as the business owner, establish and regulate the standards for Quality Management Systems based on company and/or industry standards. Oversee internal auditing to ensure regulatory compliance and certification. Facilitate regular Performance Reviews with operations leadership and monitor metrics. Develop/implement strategy to manage scope and meet customer expectations. Support business start-ups, retrofits and expansions including pricing inputs, go-live and steady state certifications. Manage the design, implementation, monitoring and maintenance of the QMS based on established company and/or industry standards. Implement and monitor a standardized corrective action system. Support regulatory compliance and certification requirements. Oversee all functions related to Quality Assurance for a start-up or expansion
* Effective facilitation and execution of Value Stream Maps & Kaizen Events through all stages (A3 charter creation, pre-work identification and completion, delivery of results, regular follow up and follow through on sustainment). Independently identifies process gaps and recommends and leads CI Team to implement process improvement. Manage, track, and report the progress and value of the transformational activities and projects across customer accounts. **Summary**
**Job Description**
:
 
 
The Director of Continuous Improvement will support the AAI (Automotive, Aerospace, and Industrial) vertical. The services are primarily warehousing operations for distribution and inbound to manufacturing operations.
 
 
This position supports the Ryder Continuous Improvement culture across the Business Unit by actively promoting and facilitating the use of continuous improvement methods to support new and existing operations.
 
 
The Director will lead a team of CI Managers/Leads across the business to influence and drive change through data driven CI, Engineering, and Automation efforts to deliver higher levels of performance in safety, quality, delivery, cost and growth. Effectively leverage data analytics, engineering methodologies, and all Ryder lean tools to enable root cause identification and elimination.
 
 
This high influence position will interface with employees at all levels and functions across the business. This individual will work directly with his/her Operational peers in the business units to define and set a strategy for engineering efforts and continuous improvement activities. This position directly reports to the Group or Senior Director of CI with dotted-line reporting to the assigned Groub Director/VP of Operations (Business Unit/Vertical). This individual will work directly with his/her peers and their direct reports in the business units to define and set a strategy for engineering efforts and continuous improvement activities for new and existing operations.
 
 
**Essential Functions**

* Directs continuous improvement program and oversees engineering support functions .Supervise a team of continuous improvement Managers and quality professionals. Make employment decisions (hire, promote, coach, development) and manage performance. Develop CI Engineering bench to strategically support the BU/Vertical long term requirements. Manages and assigns CI resources for multiple and complex Supply Chain projects aligned with strategic and growth initiatives. Regularly interacts with Senior Management and/or customer(s).

records.description:
Have you ever u sed the self-checkout? Played the slots at a Casino? Maybe you grabbed a drink from a vending machine or paid to park your car? If you’ve answered with a resounding “YES”, then you’ve done so with the aid of one of the 10 million devices installed by Crane Payment Innovations (CPI).
 
 
We make the technology that powers your everyday life, enabling more than 4 billion transactions every week in more than 143 currencies worldwide. From cash and coins to cards and mobile, we keep the world of payments moving with smart validation devices and business management software.
 
 
Headquartered in Malvern, PA, CPI is supported by: ~2,000 global associates, 6 manufacturing sites, more than 10 corporate offices and a global field service organization.
 
 
**What You’ll Be Doing**
We are seeking a strategic and influential CBS Director for the Service Business Unit to build and facilitate the business system that turns strategy into execution. This role owns how we execute and improve as a business. The Director will lead strategy deployment and the transformation review cadence, develop repeatable growth and operating processes, and use daily management and kaizen to improve cross-functional performance. You will build and facilitate the Service business system that connects strategy, growth, customer experience, service capabilities, and operational execution. Working through functional leaders and initiative owners, you will make priorities, progress, barriers, and improvement opportunities visible while preserving clear accountability for business results and execution.
 
 
**Key Responsibilities**

* Service business system: Design, implement, and continuously improve the management system used to translate Service Business Unit strategy into coordinated execution across functions.
* Strategy deployment: Facilitate the process for converting strategic priorities into defined initiatives, outcomes, measures, milestones, owners, and review routines.
* Transformation review cadence: Lead a consistent transformation review process that makes progress, risks, dependencies, decisions, and expected benefits visible to business leadership.
* Accountability model: Maintain clear governance, templates, and escalation paths while preserving accountability with initiative owners for delivering and reporting their results.
* Growth processes: Partner with Sales, Marketing, and Service leadership to develop a repeatable growth system spanning market mapping, target account selection, lead generation, account planning, opportunity qualification, funnel management, initiative launch, cross-functional readiness, benefit tracking, and revenue launch and ramp performance.
* Growth performance management: Establish practical measures and review routines that help leaders identify and address gaps in pipeline coverage, conversion, sales cycle time, launch performance, and progress against growth commitments.
* Operating processes: Standardize critical cross-functional processes where consistency, ownership, handoffs, or decision speed constrain execution.
* Daily management: Establish practical daily management routines, visual controls, performance measures, and escalation mechanisms that enable teams to identify and resolve issues at the appropriate level.
* Kaizen and continuous improvement: Identify, scope, facilitate, and sustain kaizen activity focused on meaningful cross-functional business priorities, using appropriate CBS tools and disciplined follow-through.
* Cross-functional performance: Partner across Operations, Commercial, Customer Experience, Quality, Technical Enablement, Service Offerings, Finance, HR, and other functions to improve end-to-end outcomes rather than isolated departmental measures.
* Problem solving and process improvement: Coach teams in structured problem solving, root-cause analysis, process mapping, standard work, action planning, and benefit validation.
* Performance visibility: Develop an integrated view of initiative progress, operating performance, growth metrics, risks, benefits, and corrective actions for leadership review.
* Capability building: Build business-system capability by coaching leaders and initiative owners, facilitating working sessions, and embedding repeatable methods rather than assuming ownership of their deliverables.
* Sustainment: Confirm that improvements are adopted, measured, and sustained through standard work, ownership, governance, and follow-up reviews.
* Enterprise learning: Document effective practices, scale them across the Service business, and share proven approaches more broadly within CPI where appropriate.
* Executive communication: Provide concise, fact-based updates on transformation progress, cross-functional performance, barriers, decisions required and realized benefits.

**Qualifications And Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
* Progressive leadership experience in continuous improvement, business transformation, strategy deployment, operational excellence, or business-system development.
* Demonstrated experience building or advancing an operating or business system that connects strategic priorities to execution and measurable results.
* Demonstrated ability to partner with commercial leaders on funnel management, account planning, opportunity qualification, or another measurable growth process.
* Strong working knowledge of lean management methods, including kaizen, daily management, visual management, value-stream or process mapping, standard work, and structured problem solving.
* Experience facilitating complex, cross-functional initiatives while maintaining clear accountability with business and initiative owners.
* Ability to design governance, review cadences, performance measures, and escalation routines that improve execution without adding unnecessary bureaucracy.
* Excellent analytical, planning, facilitation, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with frontline teams, functional leaders, and executives.
* Strong influencing skills and the ability to establish credibility, challenge constructively, and move groups toward decisions and deliverables in a matrixed environment.
* Experience in a service-intensive, field-service, industrial technology, or similarly complex operating environment preferred.
* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt or comparable advanced continuous-improvement certification preferred.
* Ability to travel to support Service operations, transformation activity, and kaizen events as business needs require.

**Personal Attributes**

* Enterprise thinker: Connects strategy, growth, customer experience, capabilities, operating performance, and financial outcomes.
* System builder: Creates simple, repeatable management processes that clarify priorities, ownership, measures, and decisions.
* Facilitative leader: Enables leaders and initiative owners to execute successfully without taking accountability away from them.
* Results oriented: Focuses improvement activity on measurable business outcomes and sustained benefits.
* Objective and analytical: Uses facts, process evidence, and performance data to identify constraints and guide decisions.
* Constructive challenger: Surfaces gaps, risks, and trade-offs directly while maintaining trust and productive relationships.
* Change leader: Builds understanding, engagement, and adoption across functions and levels of the organization.
* Disciplined communicator: Makes progress, barriers, decisions, and accountability visible through concise and consistent communication.

**What Success Looks Like In The First Year**
Service has a consistent, measurable growth process from market opportunity through qualified pipeline, launch, and revenue ramp. Leaders use a disciplined strategy and transformation review cadence to address gaps, resolve barriers, and make timely decisions. Improvements become part of how teams work, with clear measures, sustained standard work, and ownership that continues beyond each kaizen event or initiative launch.
 
 
**What We’re Offering**

* Base $190-210K
* Hybrid role
* Defined career growth plans with opportunities to go outside of your “comfort zone”
* Generous paid time off, including sick and holiday
* Medical, dental, & vision insurance
* 401K with Company contribution
* Flexible spending accounts
* Life insurance and disability benefits
* Discounts for childcare
* Tuition assistance
* Community involvement and volunteering events
* Opportunities to travel and work at our global sites

Sound interesting? Come see why we are !
 
 
**CPI is part of Crane NXT**
Crane NXT is a premier industrial technology company that provides proprietary and trusted technology solutions to secure, detect, and authenticate what matters most to its customers. The company is a pioneer in advanced, proprietary micro-optics technology for securing physical products, and its sophisticated electronic equipment and associated software leverages proprietary core capabilities with detection and sensing technologies. Crane NXT has approximately 4,000 employees with global operations and manufacturing facilities in the United States, the United Kingdom, Mexico, Japan, Switzerland, Germany, Sweden, and Malta. For more information, visit www.cranenxt.com.
 
 
*Crane Payment Innovations is committed to hiring a diverse workforce. Applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, military status, or national origin or any other characteristic protected under federal, state, or applicable local law.*

records.title: Director, Continuous Improvement
records.description:
Join Reynolds Consumer Products…and Drive Your Career across a world of opportunities!
 
 
We currently have an opportunity for a
**Continuous Improvement Director**
at our
**Lake Forest Corporate Headquarters**
plant in
**Lake Forest, IL**
. This position will support our Malvern, AK, Louisville, KY, Bellwood, VA, and Wheeling plants with up to 75% travel. This position could also be located at our Malvern, AK, or Louisville, KY locations.
 
 
**Responsibilities**
The
**Continuous Improvement Director**
will be responsible for driving continuous improvement and demonstrating maximum efficiency and delivery productivity for the entire Business Unit (BU) with disciplined process and world class measures. The Continuous Improvement Director will be a key creator of the Continuous Improvement and Digital Factory strategy for the BU, leveraging best practices across our manufacturing sites as we continue to develop our Boundless operating system across Reynolds Consumer Products (RCP). We embrace and accept individual experiences and backgrounds to achieve a diverse and inclusive workplace.
 
 
**You Will Have the Opportunity to Make Great Things Happen!**
**Strategy & Business Transformation**

* Develop plans, schedules, and budgets for tactical projects to improve existing processes; ensure cost-benefit evaluation for all assigned projects are completed to define potential financial, business and industry impacts of initiatives.
* Support the business leaders in the development of intermediate and long-term CI strategies to assure delivery of the projected CI Saving Budget.
* Create the digital manufacturing (IoT) strategy and coach plant teams on implementation and sustained performance enhancement as a result.
* Advise and influence senior leadership on business transformation topics that include organizational effectiveness, performance results, and change management in the terms of complexity and impact on the business.

**Continuous Improvement & Operational Excellence**

* Manage a CI Savings Budget across the Business Unit that represents an achievable value to deliver back to the business.
* Act as the subject matter expert for the core pillars of the Boundless operating system to assure sustained results, including assisting in training and plant acclimation to the new PEPS process.
* Drive the improvement of processes and systems in the plants and implement programs that will have continuing long-term benefits.
* Continuously evaluate and measure program or initiative performance and progress against goals and serve as a change agent within the organization.
* Monitor existing processes to make sure they continue to perform at optimal levels of efficiency achieving lowered conversion costs year-over-year.
* Direct all CI activities to include Kaizen events in 5S, SMED, TPM, VSM, PDCA or equivalent, A3 Problem Solving.
* Ensure adherence to Lean Methodology, including Kaizen, 5S, Standard Work, Daily Management, Layered Audit Process and Business Plan development to eliminate waste.
* Confer with management, engineering, and other staff regarding manufacturing capabilities, production schedules, and other considerations to facilitate production process improvements.

**Leadership & Talent Development**

* Effectively lead, manage, develop, coach, and evaluate team members and associates at various levels of experience.
* Develop and deliver Lean Training at all levels of the organization while driving Operational Excellence standards.

**You Will Love It Here If…**

* You listen, learn, and evolve
* You thrive in a fast-paced environment
* You put safety first, always
* You are passionate about collaboration, teamwork, and achieving shared goals
* You believe in treating all people with respect, operating ethically, and growing a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace
* You are committed to improving our impact on local communities and creating positive experiences

**Qualifications**
**Education/Experience**
**Required**

* BA/BS degree in Business, Supply Chain or related field.
* 10+ years of related professional Manufacturing with experience in Continuous Improvement and Operations.
* 3+ years in a leadership role focused on continuous improvement or operational excellence.

**Preferred**

* MBA or other advanced degree a plus.
* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt strongly preferred.
* Previous experience with Automation and SAP strongly preferred.

**Knowledge/Skills/Abilities**

* Proficient in MS Office with advanced Excel Skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including presentation skills and the ability to communicate and influence at all levels within the organization.
* Self-directed with the ability to work in a fast-paced environment with multiple accountabilities and multiple internal customers.
* Strong analytical skills as well as organizational skills with high attention to detail.
* Solid project management capabilities with the ability to organize and manage multiple projects simultaneously from origin through execution.
* Ability to work a flexible schedule during key business deadlines.
* Must be team oriented with the ability to work on high collaboration and performance teams.

**Competencies**

* Results Driven – Ability to focus on organizational growth, financial performance and achieving results.
* Critical Decision Maker – Clear, critical thinker that engages in thoughtful, data-driven decisions and has the ability to summarize and draw appropriate conclusions from complex data.
* Strategic Orientation – Ability to balance short-term goals with long-term organizational and functional strategic priorities.
* Innovative Thinking – A forward thinker who offers new, creative and often unconventional thoughts, opinions and methods for solution generation and problem solving.
* People Leadership – Ability to develop employees through coaching and feedback and holds team members accountable through modeling appropriate behavior.
* Compelling Communication – Effective written and verbal communicator that clearly and succinctly conveys information across all levels.

Want to know more? Check out our website or connect with us on LinkedIn!
 
 
**Apply today to join a fast-growing innovative company!**
Not a good fit but know someone who is? Please refer them!
 
 
**No unsolicited recruiter or agency inquiries, please.**
RCP affords equal employment opportunities to applicants without regard to race, color, religion, age, disability status, sex, marital status, protected veteran status, pregnancy, national origin, genetics, genetic information, parental status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. RCP conforms to the spirit as well as to the letter of all applicable laws and regulations.
 
 
**Posted Salary Range**
USD $144,100.00 - USD $214,350.00 /A
 
 
**Bonus Eligibility**
Role is eligible for 25% annual incentive provided the business meets financial goals and the individual meets their performance goals, subject to plan administration guidelines.

records.title: Director, Operational Excellence
records.description:
Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.
 
 
**Director, Operational Excellence**
We're advancing cancer care through innovative screening and diagnostic tests that help patients and healthcare providers make informed decisions before, during and after a cancer diagnosis. Our growing portfolio includes Cologuard®, Oncotype DX®, Cancerguard® and Oncodetect®, along with advanced genetic testing, supporting patients from cancer prevention and early detection through personalized treatment decisions and recurrence monitoring. We're focused on helping more people take action against cancer at its earliest, most treatable stages, so they can live longer, healthier lives.
 
 
This role is based on-site in Madison, WI.
 
 
**Position Overview**
Abbott is seeking a Director, Operational Excellence to lead the development, implementation, and sustainability of operational excellence practices across our Cancer Diagnostics operations.
 
 
This leader will partner closely with operations leadership and frontline teams to strengthen daily management practices, improve operational performance, and build a culture of continuous improvement and accountability.
 
 
**Key Responsibilities :**

* Lead the implementation of operational excellence practices that improve safety, quality, delivery, productivity, and cost performance.
* Establish and sustain tiered management routines, visual performance boards, standardized metrics, and structured performance reviews across hourly, daily, weekly, and monthly intervals.
* Partner with operations leaders to implement supervisor standard work, strengthen accountability, and develop consistent problem-solving and performance management practices.
* Apply Lean and Six Sigma methodologies to improve process flow, eliminate waste, reduce variation, and drive measurable operational results.
* Establish employee-driven improvement programs that encourage frontline participation, idea generation, and ownership of operational improvements.
* Lead change management efforts that ensure new processes are adopted, embedded into daily operations, and sustained over time.
* Collaborate with Operations, Quality, Engineering, Supply Chain, and other stakeholders to align improvement initiatives with business priorities.
* Lead and coach a team of operational excellence professionals while building continuous improvement capabilities across the broader organization.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Science, Operations Management, Business, Supply Chain, or a related field with a minimum of 10 years of relevant experience; or Master's degree in a related field with a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience.
* Significant progressive experience in operations leadership, operational excellence, or continuous improvement within a manufacturing, laboratory, or complex operational environment.
* Demonstrated experience implementing and sustaining Lean practices, daily management systems, visual performance management, and structured problem-solving.
* Experience leading operational teams or working directly with frontline leaders to drive measurable performance improvements.
* Proven ability to lead organizational change, influence cross-functional stakeholders, and build accountability.
* Strong people leadership, coaching, analytical, and problem-solving capabilities.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Direct leadership experience in manufacturing, laboratory, or other high-volume operations.
* Experience in regulated industries such as diagnostics, medical devices, pharmaceuticals, or healthcare.
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt certification or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience implementing tiered management systems, supervisor standard work, and employee-driven continuous improvement programs.
* Demonstrated success sustaining operational improvements through frontline engagement and leadership ownership.

The base pay for this position is $149,300.00 – $298,700.00. In specific locations, the pay range may vary from the range posted.

**Summary**
**Job Description**
:
 
 
The Director of Continuous Improvement will support the AAI (Automotive, Aerospace, and Industrial) vertical. The services are primarily warehousing operations for distribution and inbound to manufacturing operations.
 
 
This position supports the Ryder Continuous Improvement culture across the Business Unit by actively promoting and facilitating the use of continuous improvement methods to support new and existing operations.
 
 
The Director will lead a team of CI Managers/Leads across the business to influence and drive change through data driven CI, Engineering, and Automation efforts to deliver higher levels of performance in safety, quality, delivery, cost and growth. Effectively leverage data analytics, engineering methodologies, and all Ryder lean tools to enable root cause identification and elimination.
 
 
This high influence position will interface with employees at all levels and functions across the business. This individual will work directly with his/her Operational peers in the business units to define and set a strategy for engineering efforts and continuous improvement activities. This position directly reports to the Group or Senior Director of CI with dotted-line reporting to the assigned Groub Director/VP of Operations (Business Unit/Vertical). This individual will work directly with his/her peers and their direct reports in the business units to define and set a strategy for engineering efforts and continuous improvement activities for new and existing operations.
 
 
**Essential Functions**

* Directs continuous improvement program and oversees engineering support functions .Supervise a team of continuous improvement Managers and quality professionals. Make employment decisions (hire, promote, coach, development) and manage performance. Develop CI Engineering bench to strategically support the BU/Vertical long term requirements. Manages and assigns CI resources for multiple and complex Supply Chain projects aligned with strategic and growth initiatives. Regularly interacts with Senior Management and/or customer(s).
* Aligns CI initiatives and project objectives to business strategy and prioritizes projects accordingly; includes key stakeholders in process, as required. Facilitate strategic planning (vertical blueprinting) and tactical process improvement events. Lead cross functional team to identify improvement opportunities and works with leadership to prioritize & plan initiatives. Present to executive leadership team on status and results of continuous improvement initiatives. Participate in regular business review session with VP of Operations, SCE team and Customers . Provide regular reports of data and actions to measure progress against strategic business objectives.
* Provide training, coaching, and mentoring: must be able to translate all Ryder Business System concepts and strategic objectives to local situations and help all levels of the organization develop understanding and application of tools for sustainable business improvements. Coach business owners to use Engineering, Data Analysis and Lean methods to achieve operational excellence. Support start-ups, retrofits and expansions including pricing inputs, go-live and steady state certifications.
* Work with vertical leaders to establish continuous improvement goals, and act as a liaison with finance to build continuous improvement budgets and validating actual improvement results. Develops, deploys and maintains account plans for assigned process areas designed to continually improve service offerings through the implementation of recognized engineering, quality, lean standards, continuous improvement strategies and demonstrated best practices. Manage monthly budget review process and financial reconciliation. Interfaces with senior level management to establish standard quality communications and action oriented forums (reviewing /analyzing operational performance, deploy policies and strategies, share best practices)
* Serve as the business owner, establish and regulate the standards for Quality Management Systems based on company and/or industry standards. Oversee internal auditing to ensure regulatory compliance and certification. Facilitate regular Performance Reviews with operations leadership and monitor metrics. Develop/implement strategy to manage scope and meet customer expectations. Support business start-ups, retrofits and expansions including pricing inputs, go-live and steady state certifications. Manage the design, implementation, monitoring and maintenance of the QMS based on established company and/or industry standards. Implement and monitor a standardized corrective action system. Support regulatory compliance and certification requirements. Oversee all functions related to Quality Assurance for a start-up or expansion
* Effective facilitation and execution of Value Stream Maps & Kaizen Events through all stages (A3 charter creation, pre-work identification and completion, delivery of results, regular follow up and follow through on sustainment). Independently identifies process gaps and recommends and leads CI Team to implement process improvement. Manage, track, and report the progress and value of the transformational activities and projects across customer accounts. Direct the assessment, development, implementation, and continuous improvement activities related to the implementation of lean processes across accounts.

**Additional Responsibilities**

* Manage the design, implementation, monitoring and maintenance of the QMS based on established company and/or industry standards.
* Implement and monitor a standardized corrective action system.
* Support regulatory compliance and certification requirements.
* Oversee all functions related to Quality Assurance for a start-up or expansion.
* Oversee internal auditing to ensure regulatory compliance and certification.
* Performs other duties as assigned

**Skills And Abilities**

* Microsoft Office Suite skills with emphasis on Access, Excel and PowerPoint & Visioexpert required
* Data visualization (PowerBI, Tableau) and database programming (SQL, DAX, etc.) intermediate preferred
* Expertise in developing and managing: Leader Standard Work, Visual Management Systems and Management Accountability Systems, Plan-Do-Check-Act (PDCA), Value Stream Mapping, Kaizen, 5S/Workplace Organization expert required
* Understanding and experience in core engineering and data analysis functions (slotting, utilization, labor planning, layouts, metrics, etc.) and warehouse design tools such as CAD (e.gAutoCAD); slotting (e.gSlot3D), Predetermined Motion and Time Systems and methods (e.gMOST); Warehouse Management Systems (e.gManhattan Scale), and Labor MgtSystems expert preferred
* Knowledge of Warehouse Management operations, data analytics, Industrial Engineering, warehouse types (ambient, temp control, warehouse layout/ design and Lean methods
* Knowledge of material handling solutions and automation types such as: powered industrial truck (PIT) applications; racking and other storage solution designs, packaging equipment; conveyor and sortation equipment; and other automation solutions (e.gAS/RS)expert required
* Knowledge of Dedicated Services and Managed Transportation Networks
* Knowledge of all available equipment types such as; dry van, temperature control, flat bed, other specialized equipment
* Transportation Design Tools ie; JDA, Appian, Network Design Tools ie; Llamasoft, Transportation Management Systems ie; JDA, OTM, , Mapping Software ie; Tableau expert required
* Knowledge working with HRM systems (e.gWorkday) and associated HR processes
* Knowledge on team member hiring/on-boardingKnowledge of goal setting and performance management/resolutionadvanced preferred

* Master's degree preferred Supply Chain Management or Industrial Engineering
* Ten (10) years or more Fourteen (14) yrs or more in the Distribution, Warehousing and/or Manufacturing, Transportation, Supply Chain Logistics industry required
* Microsoft Office Suite skills with emphasis on Access, Excel and PowerPoint & Visio. expert required

records.title: Director Supply Chain Continuous Improvement
records.description:
**Who we are?**
As the world's largest organization of board-certified pathologists and leading provider of laboratory accreditation and proficiency testing programs, the College of American Pathologists (CAP) serves patients, pathologists, and the public by fostering and advocating excellence in the practice of pathology and laboratory medicine worldwide.
 
 
**Our Culture**

* CAP employees make a meaningful difference by partnering with colleagues customers and members on challenging and rewarding work
* CAP provides its employees with an energetic and collaborative work environment and encourage opportunities to further develop their skills—offering reimbursement for educational programs and participation in events that enhance your skills
* We offer a generous compensation and benefits package, 401K, and more -- visit Careers at the CAP for more details

Brief Description
 
 
The Director, Supply Chain Continuous Improvement is accountable for optimizing the end-to-end flow of work across the Supply Chain & Logistics function, including order management, procurement, planning, fulfillment, distribution, and logistics, from order receipt through customer delivery. The role streamlines and simplifies work, establishes process ownership and decision rights, clarifies roles and responsibilities, designs reliable handovers, and improves on-time delivery and temperature integrity through data, cross-functional leadership, and employee coaching.
 
 
Specific Duties
 
 

* Provides enterprise-wide matrix leadership to process owners, functional leaders, operations managers, and cross-functional transformation teams.
* Establishes accountability for outcomes, milestones, financial benefits, risk mitigation, and sustainment across a portfolio of strategic initiatives.
* Coaches senior leaders, managers, professional staff, and frontline employees in Lean, Lean Six Sigma, structured problem solving, change leadership, and daily management.
* May lead direct reports, contractors, consultants, or dedicated project resources as the transformation portfolio evolves.
* Develop and execute a multi-year Supply Chain & Logistics continuous improvement and operational excellence strategy aligned with enterprise customer, financial, quality, and service objectives.
* Own the Supply Chain & Logistics transformation portfolio: identify opportunities, size value, prioritize initiatives, define resource requirements, and govern delivery to scope, schedule, budget, risk, and targeted benefits.
* Lead end-to-end supply chain value-stream redesign across order management, procurement, planning, fulfillment, distribution, logistics, customer service, quality, and enabling functions.
* Establish process ownership, decision rights, escalation paths, governance forums, RACI frameworks, standard work, controls, and reliable handovers.
* Create an enterprise performance-management system and single source of truth for OTIF, temperature excursions, productivity, cost, handover defects, and customer-impact measures.
* Build executive-ready business cases for process, automation, analytics, and technology investments; partner with Finance to validate baselines, track realized value, and prevent benefit leakage.
* Lead complex Lean, A3, kaizen, root-cause analysis, and problem-solving initiatives that resolve systemic constraints and deliver sustained results.
* Sponsor digital process improvement using D365, WMS, TMS, workflow automation, Power BI/Tableau, and other enterprise platforms where appropriate.
* Build organizational capability through leader standard work, training, coaching, certification pathways, communities of practice, and succession development.
* Lead change-management and stakeholder-engagement plans that drive adoption, accountability, and sustained behavioral change.
* Partner with Quality, Customer Service, Supply Chain, IT, Finance, Human Resources, cold-packaging teams, suppliers, technology partners, and external carriers.
* Present portfolio performance, financial impact, risks, decisions, and recommendations to executive leadership and governance forums.

Source of Supervision
 
 
The Director, Supply Chain Continuous Improvement is a seasoned supply chain and operations excellence leader accountable for creating measurable enterprise value by improving the end-to-end flow of work across Supply Chain & Logistics and the broader value chain, from order receipt through customer delivery. This role owns the continuous improvement operating system and process governance for Supply Chain & Logistics, while leading a portfolio of high-impact cross-functional initiatives that improve customer experience, service reliability, quality, temperature integrity, productivity, working capital, and cost. The Director partners with executive and functional leaders to translate supply chain and logistics strategy into scalable processes, clear decision rights, disciplined execution, and sustained financial and operational results.
 
 
Education / Experience
 
 

* Expert-level knowledge and practitioner of Lean, operational excellence, supply chain value-stream management, process governance, and structured problem solving.
* Demonstrated record of leading supply chain, logistics, or enterprise-scale transformations and delivering measurable improvements in customer service, quality, productivity, cycle time, cost, working capital, and operational resilience.
* Strong financial acumen, including business-case development, investment prioritization, benefit validation, sensitivity analysis, and executive-level performance reporting.
* Advanced analytical capability using data modeling, dashboards, Excel, Power BI, Tableau, or comparable tools to convert complex data into decisions and action.
* Proven ability to influence executives and functional leaders without direct authority in a complex, matrixed, and regulated environment.
* Exceptional executive communication, facilitation, negotiation, change leadership, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Preferred: Experience with D365, WMS, TMS, workflow automation, process mining, and regulated, laboratory, life-sciences, healthcare, pharmaceutical, diagnostics-distribution, or cold-chain operations.
* Bachelor's degree in Operations, Industrial or Systems Engineering, Supply Chain, Business, or a related field required; master's degree, MBA, or equivalent advanced education preferred.
* Twelve or more years of progressive experience in operational excellence, process transformation, and continuous improvement.
* Seven or more years leading teams, enterprise programs, or complex cross-functional transformation portfolios with executive visibility and measurable financial and operational outcomes.
* Experience partnering with Finance to validate benefits and with IT to deliver process-enabled digital transformation strongly preferred.
* Experience in laboratory, life sciences, healthcare, pharmaceutical, diagnostics distribution, cold chain, or another quality-driven and regulated environment preferred.

Additional Criteria
 
 
**This position requires candidates to live within 75-miles of Northfield, IL and meet in office requirements.**
**Salary:**
$138,000 - $176,000
 
 
Equal Opportunity Employer The CAP is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer, providing equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, creed, color, religion, sex, gender identity and/or expression, national origin, age, ancestry, disability or genetic information, military status, sexual orientation, marital status, citizenship status, order of protection status, homelessness, or any other characteristic protected by federal law and the applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. Applicants have rights under Federal Employment Laws: Family and Medical Leave Act Equal Employment Opportunity Employee Polygraph Protection Act

records.description:
Pay Range:$65.73 - $92.22 $25K Sign On and $10K Relocation for qualified hire!
 
 
The Director of Operational Excellence leads SEARHC’s improvement function, translating annual operating plan priorities into measurable, sustainable operational results. Reporting directly to the System Director of Enterprise Portfolio & Organizational Excellence, the Director supervises Associate Program Managers, Program Managers, and Senior Program Managers, develops improvement and change capabilities, balances team assignments and capacity, and oversees delivery quality and benefits measurement. This hands-on leader personally leads selected complex transformations and partners with executive sponsors and operational owners to diagnose problems, redesign processes, implement change, and sustain results. The Senior Program Manager level expands advanced program leadership capacity while the Director remains accountable for the function and continues direct involvement in transformational projects. The Director works with the PMO through one integrated portfolio and common reporting approach. The System Director retains enterprise direction and executive alignment; operational sponsors retain accountability for operational decisions, resources, and sustained performance.
 
 
SEARHC is a non-profit health consortium which serves the health interests of the residents of Southeast Alaska. We see our employees as our strongest assets. It is our priority to further their development and our organization by aiding in their professional advancement.
 
 
Working at SEARHC is more than a job, it’s a fulfilling career. We offer generous benefits, including retirement, paid time off, paid parental leave, health insurance, dental, and vision benefits, life insurance and long and short-term disability, and more.
 
 
**Key Essential Functions And Accountabilities Of The Job**

* Leads the Operational Excellence team and translates approved annual operating plan priorities into a coordinated improvement work plan; personally leads selected highly complex efforts while maintaining capacity for staff leadership and development.
* Integrates related improvement work across functions and operational owners; develops coherent transformation approaches, resolves cross-workstream dependencies, and coordinates supporting projects with the PMO through shared portfolio processes.
* Advises sponsors on competing approaches, sequencing, risks, and tradeoffs; facilitates difficult cross-functional decisions and escalates resource and priority decisions through established governance without assuming executive approval authority.
* Synthesizes complex operational, quality, service, and financial information with specialist partners; establishes credible baselines and benefits measures, examines performance variation, and evaluates outcomes, unintended effects, and sustained benefits.
* Assigns improvement work, balances team capacity, and oversees plans, milestones, risks, dependencies, and delivery quality within approved priorities and resources; partners with the PMO on common reporting and escalates capacity and priority tradeoffs to the System Director.
* Leads change-impact assessment, stakeholder alignment, readiness, and adoption planning for complex transformations; partners on communication and training and verifies that new practices are used across affected operations.
* Leads advanced performance diagnosis, workflow and operating-model redesign, structured testing, and implementation; establishes standard work, measurement ownership, review routines, and transition plans with operational owners to sustain results.
* Develops executive-level updates, governance materials, and strategic implementation reporting for leaders and decision-making bodies.
* Supervises, coaches, and develops improvement professionals at the Associate Program Manager, Program Manager, and Senior Program Manager levels; establishes role-appropriate performance expectations, evaluates performance, supports recruitment and onboarding, and builds reusable improvement and change methods to strengthen team capability and consistency.
* Demonstrates SEARHC’s values and supports work that advances the organization’s mission, vision, strategic plan, and operating plan.
* Other duties as assigned

Supervisory Responsibilities
 
 
This position reports directly to the System Director of Enterprise Portfolio & Organizational Excellence and directly supervises improvement professionals at the Associate Program Manager, Program Manager, and Senior Program Manager levels. Responsibilities include staff performance management, coaching and development, assignments, workload balancing, and delivery oversight in accordance with organizational policies. Senior Program Managers provide technical coaching and program leadership; the Director retains personnel and assignment authority across all levels. The System Director retains enterprise direction, executive alignment, and escalation of enterprise priority and resource decisions.
 
 
**Additional Details**
**Education, Certifications, and Licenses Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in healthcare administration, business administration, public health, nursing, or a related field
* Equivalent combination of education and relevant healthcare, operational improvement, program management, or project management experience may be considered in lieu of a degree
* Master’s degree in business administration, healthcare administration, public health, or a related field preferred
* Project Management Professional (PMP), Lean Six Sigma, change management, or similar improvement methodology training/certification preferred

**Experience Required**

* Six to eight or more years of experience in healthcare operations, program management, project management, quality improvement, or operational improvement, including independent leadership of complex, ambiguous, enterprise-wide improvement programs with measurable and sustained results
* Experience advising executive sponsors, integrating changes across multiple operational owners, facilitating consequential cross-functional decisions, and supervising and developing professional staff
* Demonstrated advanced expertise in performance diagnosis, process redesign, change adoption, benefits measurement, and sustainment across complex healthcare operations, with experience managing staff performance, assignments, and workload

**Knowledge of**

* Healthcare operations, workflow design, and advanced performance improvement principles
* Advanced improvement methods, including process mapping, root cause analysis, structured testing, performance variation, operating-model redesign, and outcome, process, and balancing measures
* Project and program management practices, including planning, tracking, risk management, issue escalation, and cross-functional integration across large or interdependent initiatives
* Data analysis, reporting, and use of healthcare operational and performance metrics to support executive decision-making
* Advanced change-impact assessment, stakeholder engagement, readiness and adoption measurement, capability building, standard work, sustainment, and shared governance principles
* Regulatory, accreditation, and compliance considerations that affect healthcare operations and process redesign
* Staff supervision, performance management, professional development, workload planning, and improvement practice management

Skills in
 
 

* Building effective working relationships with leaders, providers, staff, and cross-functional teams, including senior leaders, governance participants, and executive stakeholders
* Facilitating complex meetings, work sessions, governance discussions, decision-making, and follow-through across multiple stakeholders
* Using standard business software and healthcare information systems to organize work, analyze information, and communicate effectively
* Communicating clearly and effectively in written, verbal, presentation, and executive reporting formats
* Coaching and developing improvement professionals, setting clear expectations, balancing assignments, and providing constructive performance feedback

Ability to
 
 

* Facilitate complex problem-solving, support conflict resolution, and help remove high-level operational barriers to execution across enterprise or highly interdependent initiatives
* Influence without direct authority, foster collaboration, and align diverse stakeholders around shared goals, tradeoffs, and execution plans
* Analyze complex issues, develop practical recommendations, and support implementation of operational change across multiple functions or enterprise priorities
* Work effectively with people from diverse disciplines, backgrounds, and perspectives
* Adapt to changing organizational priorities, healthcare environments, and operational demands while maintaining momentum across complex initiatives

**Position Information**
Work Shift:Exempt
 
 
*If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!*

records.title: Director - Corporate Continuous Improvement
records.description:
**Description**
****Position Summary****
The Director of Corporate Continuous Improvement (CI) leads MacAllister’s enterprise CI strategy, Corporate CI team, and improvement portfolio. In partnership with the owner, executive team, and divisional leaders, the Director helps establish and build alignment around MacAllister’s CI vision, strategy, priorities, and multi-year roadmap. The Director identifies and prioritizes high-value opportunities, builds organizational problem-solving capability, and leads improvement work from opportunity identification through execution and sustainment.
 
 
The role establishes CI standards, tools, and training; coaches, mentors, and influences leaders and teams across the organization; and communicates CI priorities, results, and opportunities for support.
 
 
The ultimate objective is to build and sustain a culture in which continuous improvement becomes habitual and is reflected in how leaders and employees think, act, solve problems, and improve the way work gets done.
 
 
****Position Duties/Responsibilities****
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Partner with the executive team, and divisional leaders to develop and maintain MacAllister’s CI strategy, multi-year roadmap, priorities, and operating model aligned with company goals. Build leadership alignment and shared ownership of CI priorities and expectations across the organization.
* Own CI project identification, prioritization, approval, execution, and close-out, focusing on where CI creates the most value; support employee-driven improvement alongside leader-sponsored initiatives.
* Maintain consistent project close-out documenting results, lessons learned, and sustainment plans; verify improvements and results are sustained and take corrective action as needed.
* Set organization-wide CI standards, tools, and terminology; guide Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, DMAIC, and PDCA application grounded in facts, data, and root cause analysis; coach project teams and facilitate select high-impact improvement events.
* Lead improvement-related change management, engaging affected employees early and ensuring process adoption and sustainment.
* Oversee CI training tailored to responsibility levels using consistent terminology and live projects; coach and support CI-trained departmental leaders who remain in their home departments outside CI.
* Define CI value primarily through capability measures—leaders solving problems independently, AI use cases adopted, and idea-to-approval cycle time—with financial results as supporting evidence.
* Communicate CI initiatives, results, and available support so leaders know when and how to engage the team; share success stories and recognize improvement contributors.
* Use coaching-first leadership to build team autonomy, confidence, and influence; foster problem reporting, experimentation, and learning from mistakes by supporting people publicly and coaching privately.
* Hire, develop, and manage CI personnel; oversee budget, resource allocation, and team structure as needs evolve.
* Play a leadership role in MacAllister’s Center of Practice for CI, AI, and problem-solving leadership, incorporating AI and other emerging technologies into CI methods where they improve problem solving, decision making, or productivity. Partner with MacAllister’s enterprise AI leadership on broader AI strategy, standards, and adoption.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**

* Directly supervises the Corporate CI team and oversees day-to-day operations of the CI department. Mentors and coaches CI team members to strengthen their capabilities as problem solvers, facilitators, coaches, and trusted business partners.
* Reviews and evaluates the work and performance of reporting employees; has authority for hiring and disciplinary actions.

****Position Requirements****
**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, or a related field.
* 10 years or more of experience in continuous improvement, operations, or business transformation.
* 5 years or more of experience leading leaders.
* Proven success coaching others to identify and solve problems independently.
* Working knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, DMAIC, and PDCA.
* A valid driver’s license.

**Preferred**

* Master’s degree in business or a related discipline.
* Lean Six Sigma Master Black Belt or equivalent depth of experience designing and delivering CI training.
* Experience at a Caterpillar dealership or in the equipment sales, service, or rental industry.
* Demonstrated curiosity and willingness to learn and apply emerging technologies, including AI, to strengthen problem solving, process improvement, decision support, and organizational productivity. Experience applying AI in these areas is preferred but not required.
* Experience building on an existing CI function and growing its influence across a multi-location organization.

****Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities****

* Strong coaching and leadership development skills; leads through influence rather than authority.
* Ability to connect improvement work to business priorities and help leaders choose where to focus.
* Curiosity about and practical comfort with AI as a business tool.
* Exceptional communication and facilitation skills with all levels, from the front line to executives.
* Ability to build and maintain trusted relationships with executives, senior managers, and teams.
* Respect for existing culture and relationships, with the judgment to improve without unnecessary disruption.
* Strong organizational, prioritization, and project management skills.
* Effective computer skills with Microsoft Office and the ability to learn proprietary systems.

****Other Requirements of Position****

* Works under broad supervision. Designs and carries out programs and far-reaching objectives independently, informing management as appropriate.
* Major responsibilities require a wide degree of creativity and latitude.
* If an error is made while in this position, it will require some effort to identify and can significantly impact the company financially.
* Frequently communicates with coworkers, customers, company executives, and management.
* Maintain equipment and supplies to avoid waste, damage to areas and equipment, and to prevent accidents.

The duties and responsibilities outlined in this posting are not exhaustive and may evolve based on business needs.
 
 
All MacAllister Machinery companies are an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer, including Disabled and Veteran applicants.

records.title: Business Application Consulting - Program Risk & Quality Director

postedPay.title: Business Application Consulting - Program Risk & Quality Director

records.description:
As a Business Application Consulting - Program Risk & Quality Director, you will guide clients through business application transformations within our Advisory practice, bringing program risk and quality considerations into software implementation. This role connects application consulting with security and controls: you will help clients assess their needs, integrate safeguards into cloud-enabled processes, and support adoption across platforms such as Workday, Salesforce, and Microsoft Dynamics 365. You will help organizations manage technology risk while improving how their applications support day-to-day operations.
 
 
As a Director, you will set the direction for this work, cultivate executive client relationships, and identify opportunities to expand services where transformation programs call for integrated controls. You will guide multiple engagements, make decisions informed by program performance and emerging technology, and develop future leaders through coaching and candid feedback. Working across disciplines, you will connect platform architecture, application delivery, and risk perspectives while balancing commercial priorities with professional standards. Your leadership will foster an inclusive environment where people and technology contribute to client outcomes, reflecting PwC’s commitment to integrity and thoughtful service.
 
 
Responsibilities
 
 

* Setting strategic direction for program risk and quality across business application transformations, aligning implementation, security, and controls priorities with client objectives
* Directing risk assessments and quality reviews across application projects, using business data analytics and performance measures to identify delivery gaps and guide corrective action
* Overseeing the design and integration of application access controls, automated monitoring, and compliance processes within cloud solutions such as Workday, Salesforce, and Microsoft Dynamics 365
* Guiding recovery of application security and controls work on large projects, coordinating resources, documentation, and technical consultation to address implementation challenges
* Shaping governance for SaaS security posture management and AI-enabled application integrations, including Model Context Protocol security, through research and the use of digital tools
* Leading teams through software implementation, user training, and ongoing support, coaching emerging leaders and adapting plans based on feedback and operational needs
* Cultivating executive client relationships and developing business opportunities by translating technical risks, transformation progress, and proposed solutions into recommendations for decision-makers
* Upholding professional standards while coordinating project delivery across disciplines, assessing technology performance, and encouraging inclusive collaboration between people and AI-enabled tools

 
What You Must Have
 
 

* At least a Bachelor's degree
* At least 9 years of experience

 
What Sets You Apart
 
 

* Directing security and controls strategy across cloud business application transformations and multiple client engagements
* Leading application security and access control design for Workday, Salesforce, or Microsoft Dynamics 365 implementations
* Integrating automated controls into business processes and monitoring their performance throughout technology implementations
* Overseeing application security and controls project recovery for large technology implementations
* Shaping SaaS Security Posture Management implementation and governance across client environments
* Guiding Model Context Protocol security and governance for AI-driven solutions
* Coaching project leaders through risk decisions, resource planning, and executive client communication

The salary range for this position is: $155,000 - $410,000. Actual compensation within the range will be dependent upon the individual's skills, experience, qualifications and location, and applicable employment laws. All hired individuals are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. PwC offers a wide range of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, 401k, holiday pay, vacation, personal and family sick leave, and more. To view our benefits at a glance, please visit the following link: https://pwc.to/benefits-at-a-glance

As PwC is an equal opportunity employer, all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment at PwC without regard to race; color; religion; national origin; sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity); age; disability; genetic information (including family medical history); veteran, marital, or citizenship status; or, any other status protected by law.

PwC does not intend to hire experienced or entry level job seekers who will need, now or in the future, PwC sponsorship through the H-1B lottery, except as set forth within the following policy: https://pwc.to/H-1B-Lottery-Policy.

Learn more about how we work: https://pwc.to/how-we-work

For only those qualified applicants that are impacted by the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, the Los Angeles' Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, San Diego County Fair Chance Ordinance, and the California Fair Chance Act, where applicable, arrest or conviction records will be considered for Employment in accordance with these laws. At PwC, we recognize that conviction records may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship to responsibilities such as accessing sensitive company or customer information, handling proprietary assets, or collaborating closely with team members. We evaluate these factors thoughtfully to establish a secure and trusted workplace for all.

records.title: Director, Supply Chain Quality
records.description:
Are you ready to be part of a company that's not just talking about the future, but actively shaping it? Join The AES Corporation, the largest US-based global power company with a team of 8,300 employees across 12 countries.
 
 
AES has been **ranked #1 by BloombergNEF** in renewable energy sales to corporations in the US and Americas for five consecutive years, providing electricity for **millions of people worldwide.**
 
 
We are proud to foster a strong workplace culture, earning prominent positions in Great Place to Work™ rankings across the markets where we operate. AES was also named one of the World’s Most Ethical Companies for the 13th consecutive year in 2026, highlighting our dedication to integrity, transparency, and responsible business practices.

Our spirit of innovation continues to earn industry recognition. AES is the only seven-time winner of the Edison Electric Institute’s Edison Awards in the twenty-first century, a distinction honoring global leadership in advancing the electric power industry. 
 
If you're ready to be part of a company that's not just adapting to change, but driving it, AES is the place for you. We're not just building a more sustainable future, we're powering it. Apply now and energize your career with a true leader in global energy.

**Job Description Summary**

The Director – Supply Chain Quality will establish and lead the Supply Chain Quality program within the Strategic Sourcing function. Reporting to the Vice President of Strategic Sourcing, this position will be responsible for developing AES strategy and processes to ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of owner-furnished equipment supporting the AES Renewables & Power business. This role will serve as the primary interface between Strategic Sourcing and internal teams such as Engineering, Execution, Operations, and our primary suppliers to proactively manage quality risk, improve supplier performance, and drive continuous improvement throughout the equipment lifecycle.

The ideal candidate will be capable of coordinating and collaborating with multiple teams across AES and take responsibility for ensuring the successful improvement of supplier performance across our equipment pipeline. Prior experience in Supply Chain Quality in renewables, gas and/or power sector strongly preferred.

This position will be ideally based in Louisville, CO. AES provides a flexible working environment, and remote work is possible with approval of location. Travel will also be required (~50%) 
 
**Primary Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Develop and implement the company’s supply chain quality strategy, standards, and governance processes
* Lead supplier qualification, factory audits, manufacturing surveillance, inspections, testing, and corrective action programs for major equipment suppliers.
* Oversee quality assurance activities for solar modules, battery energy storage systems, inverters, transformers, wind equipment, gas turbines, and other critical project components.
* Participate in and support Strategic Sourcing Category Managers with regular supplier meetings, including Quarterly Business Reviews, with quality-related updates and reviews
* Identify and mitigate supplier quality, manufacturing, and reliability risks that could impact project cost, schedule, safety, or operational performance.
* Partner with Engineering, Construction, Procurement, and Operations teams to resolve quality issues and incorporate lessons learned into future sourcing strategies and design/specification practices.
* Manage third-party quality service providers supporting audits, inspections, production monitoring, and testing activities.
* Establish supplier performance metrics and continuous improvement initiatives focused on reliability, delivery performance, and defect reduction.
* Create data-driven systems to track and manage all activities and progress
* Drive root cause analysis, corrective actions, and warranty recovery efforts related to equipment failures and field performance issues.
* Maintain strong vendor relationships and represent the company’s values, quality expectations, and culture in all supplier interactions.
* Other job‑related duties and projects as assigned.

**Skills & Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s Engineering degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, or related field preferred; equivalent experience considered
* 10+ years of experience in quality assurance, quality control, supplier quality, manufacturing, or major‑equipment oversight within renewable energy, electrical equipment, EPC, or related industries
* 2+ years managing a team
* Technical knowledge of solar modules, inverters, racking, transformers, HV equipment, wind equipment, and/or battery energy storage systems
* Demonstrated success working to develop consensus from diverse opinions in a highly fluid and sometimes ambiguous multi-cultural environment
* Experience conducting or managing factory audits, FATs, certification testing, and supplier qualification activities
* Proficient with MS Office suite, Quickbase, Power BI and other software systems and analytical tools
* Experience building dashboarding and reporting metrics, and establishing those within a company’s system of record
* Familiarity and willingness to use AI tools and platforms to support work and reporting
* Understanding of and experience with SAP or similar ERP systems
* Quality certifications (ASQ, Six Sigma, ISO Auditor)

AES is an Equal Opportunity Employer who is committed to building strength and delivering long-term sustainability through diversity and inclusion. Respecting all backgrounds, differences and perspectives enables us to improve the lives of our people, customers, suppliers, contractors, and the communities in which we live and work. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity and/or expression, race, national origin, ethnicity, age, religion, marital status, physical or mental disability, pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical condition, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law. E-Verify Notice: AES will provide the Social Security Administration (SSA) and if necessary, the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) with information from each new employee's I-9 to confirm work authorization.
