records.title: Plant Manager (Yokosuka, Japan)
records.description:
**NORESCO, an OPTERRA Company**, helps customers modernize aging building systems and upgrade energy and water infrastructure to meet evolving demands. We implement innovative energy efficiency, distributed generation, energy storage, and renewable energy solutions that optimize the operational efficiency and improve resilience of buildings, campuses, military installations, and communities.

We are seeking an on-site Project Manager to oversee all preventive, corrective, and major maintenance activities (including repair and replacement work) at NORESCO’s 40 MW electric and thermal production facility at Yokosuka Naval Base, Japan. The cogeneration plant (CGS) is a critical asset for the base and daily operations are conducted by Navy personnel in partnership with NORESCO and our subcontractors.

NORESCO constructed the plant, which generates 50Hz and 60Hz power as well as a combination of Soft and Pure Steam, in 2008 under a Federal Energy Savings Performance Contract (ESPC). The plant pays for itself out of energy savings which NORESCO has guaranteed for the past 18 years. In order to meet our savings and availability guarantees, we employ a robust preventive maintenance program which relies heavily on Long Term Service Agreements (LTSAs) for all major pieces of equipment.

This is a Senior level position reporting to NORESCO’s Operations Manager and is administered through a 3 to 5 year International Assignment Agreement (IAA). This agreement is negotiated with each of our employees working Outside of the Continental Unites States (OCONUS). The agreement includes consideration for overseas pay, benefits, healthcare, housing, food, travel, vacation, stateside visits, relocation, etc., and is customized to the unique requirements of each new hire.

You will be the primary liaison between our NAVY customers, Japanese operators and subcontractors, as well as NORESCO team to ensure contractual obligations are met. While many of the team members in Japan speak English or are Bi-Lingual, some are not. Translators are available to facilitate conversations or process written correspondence as necessary. Japan is an amazing culture with many unique customs and protocols, a willingness to learn and adapt to their approach is an important part of your success.

It is of utmost importance for you to possess good listening, communication, and computer skills in addition to being proactive, organized, and having a bias for action. The Yokosuka Project Manager is supported by (and in-turn supports) many other NORESCO departments; Development, Engineering, Commissioning, O&M, M&V, Accounting, Legal, etc. Cross-functional technical skills, adaptability, versatility, and a quest for continuous learning and integration of advances are key in this position.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Overall contractual responsibility for plant maintenance and repair activities through careful management of Long-Term Service Agreements (LTSAs) and work orders.
* Ensuring subcontractor work is performed in a safe and professional manner with materials that meet or exceed applicable Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) and Regulatory standards.
* Participate in scheduled operations meetings and coordinate upcoming maintenance activities within the defined expectations and constraints of the customer and subcontractor availability.
* Prepare and distribute standard monthly reports (that summarize operations, maintenance, and repair activities) to NORESCO management, key customer contacts, and other stakeholders.
* Review plant operations logs, alarms, and performance data on a regular basis to evaluate equipment condition, collaborate with NORESCO team to identify potential issues.
* Perform plant inspections and safety walkthroughs during regular operations, confirm changes in equipment line-up, and subcontractor compliance with typical maintenance activities.
* Support Profit and Loss (P&L) management; assist with generating and maintaining the annual budget; capital expenditure planning; monthly forecasts, accruals, and variance analysis with development of recovery plans as needed to deliver the target revenue and profit.
* Review service agreements/proposals with manager; generate purchase orders as required; provide initial review and approval of invoices for materials and services.
* Collaborate with LTSA contractors to plan work and identify resources required for shutdown tasks such as parts, tooling, equipment, materials, and work procedures. Review and confirm subcontractors’ detailed work plans meet the customer and project needs.
* Maintain NORESCO’s Computer Maintenance Management System (CMMS) to generate reports for maintenance schedules, completion status reports, equipment histories, and forecasts.
* Coordinate with subcontractors, visitors and customers to ensure protocols are followed on matters related to site access, security clearance, safety measures, and work permits.
* Monitor warranty programs to ensure the planned and required coverage is maintained by complying with all warranty requirements. Ensure warranty work is claimed in a timely manner, and all warranty issues are resolved to minimize out of pocket expenses.
* Monitor and analyze facility performance and host data for equipment and systems condition assessments. Review finings with Operations Manger and adjust maintenance plans accordingly.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelors degree, Associates degree, or equivalent Technical Training (ex; Navy Nuclear)
* 5+ years of experience in one of the following fields; electric power generation, cogeneration, industrial utility, or district energy industry with strong working knowledge of equipment
* Ability to obtain a Federal Security Clearance for work at Government facilities.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**:

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, project management discipline or equivalent experience
* High level communication, leadership, technical, and project management skills.
* Strong sense of ownership and focus on maintaining; a Safe work environment, Uninterrupted Plant operations, Quality control, Project schedule, Resolving issues in a timely manner, and consistently meeting deadlines and commitments.
* Graduate degree in engineering or business administration
* Strong interest in engaging operators, customers, and partners to grow relationships.
* Advanced knowledge of one or more facets of Engineering or Central Plants operations; design principles, technologies, equipment maintenance and troubleshooting.
* Energy optimization, utility rates, energy costs, applicable codes, design guides, and standards.
* Robust combination of business acumen, risk management, and strategic thinking skills.
* US military or DOD project management experience, Japanese language skills, and international work experience are a plus.

**Physical requirements include:**

* Ability to climb stairs and fixed ladders.
* Ability to access rooftops and elevated work areas while following safety protocols.
* Ability to work at heights and in confined or industrial environments as required.
* Ability to maintain balance and mobility while navigating mechanical, utility, and production areas.

**Compensation:**

* $130,000 – $150,000 per year, depending on experience + bonuses

**Benefits:**

* HSA Medical insurance, with a choice of 2 buy-up options
* Dental insurance
* Vision insurance
* 100% Safe Harbor 401(k) match
* 100% company paid Life insurance
* 100% company paid Long-term Disability insurance
* Short-term Disability insurance
* Flexible Spending Account
* Commuter Benefits
* Legal and Identity Protection
* Pet Insurance Coverage
* Fertility and Reproductive Health
* Generous Paid Time Off, including Holiday, Vacation, and Sick Pay

records.title: Plant Manager
records.description:
**About the role:**
-------------------

As Plant Manager for Eaton’s Critical Power Solutions operations in Santa Ana, California, you’ll lead two facilities, 500+ employees, and approximately $280M in annual sales, delivering engineered-to-order critical power solutions for some of the world’s fastest-growing customers.

This is a **high-visibility business and operations leadership role** with the opportunity to make a significant impact. You’ll co-own the P&L, lead the full plant organization, and help scale the operation as demand continues to grow.

**We’re looking for a leader who can:**

* Build and develop high-performing, cross-functional teams.
* Deliver consistently against safety, quality, delivery, inventory, cost, and financial commitments.
* Create a culture of structured problem solving using A3, 8D, PDCA, and root cause analysis.
* Lead through growth, complexity, and change while maintaining strong operational discipline.
* Make sound financial decisions around cost, budgets, capital, capacity, and profitability.
* Move comfortably between the manufacturing floor, customer conversations, and senior leadership discussions.

**What you will do:**
---------------------

**Lead people and culture** 

* Build a safety-first culture where every employee owns EHS, and keep our safety management systems strong through active, visible leadership.
* Be a visible leader on every shift: communicate openly, spend real time on the floor, and build an inclusive team where people want to stay and grow.
* Model Eaton's values and Code of Ethics in how results get delivered, every day.

**Run a high-performing operation** 

* Co-own the site P&L and scorecard (safety, quality, delivery, inventory, cost, productivity and engagement), set stretch goals and close gaps quickly.
* Turn the division strategy and annual profit plan into clear short- and long-term site plans and run a disciplined daily management rhythm to deliver them.
* Lead demand, capacity and inventory planning (our Sales, Inventory and Operations Planning process) so we keep our commitments to customers and to the business.

**Put customers first** 

* Protect on-time delivery and shorten engineered-to-order and configure-to-order lead times so we win new business and grow with our customers.
* Partner with Sales, Marketing, Engineering, Project Management and Supply Chain to deliver end-to-end quality and customer satisfaction.

**Improve continuously** 

* Use the Eaton Business System and our continuous improvement tools to make lasting gains in safety, quality and productivity.
* Develop lean experts and problem-solvers on every shift, coach leaders to teach problem solving, and recognize teams that improve their own work.

**Grow the site** 

* Lead capacity expansion and footprint plans, including capital projects, new lines and cell layouts, automation and new product launches with Engineering.

records.title: Plant Manager
records.description:
Plant Manager

**Company:** Smitty Bee Honey - Defiance, IA

**Reports to:** President

Job Summary

SBH is seeking an experienced, results-driven Plant Manager to coordinate and direct all major plant functions. You will oversee manufacturing, maintenance, and warehouse operations while fostering positive employee relations and managing operational budgets. The ideal candidate will ensure strict compliance with SBH policies, food safety regulations, and legal requirements, while driving continuous improvement and on-time customer delivery.

Key Responsibilities

* **Operations & Production Management:** Oversee daily manufacturing, maintenance, and warehouse operations, ensuring production schedules and product quality consistently meet specifications.
* **Customer Fulfillment:** Coordinate and communicate scheduled open orders to guarantee on-time delivery to all SBH customers, supporting strategic efforts to retain existing business and generate new sales.
* **Continuous Improvement & Efficiency:** Identify and implement initiatives to reduce labor costs, material waste, and indirect expenses. Develop and manage labor utilization strategies that adapt effectively to shifting production demands and deadlines.
* **Equipment & Facility Optimization:** Partner with Engineering and Maintenance to minimize equipment downtime. Manage process flows, optimize plant layouts, and coordinate shutdowns and startups for new production lines and equipment installations.
* **Food Safety & Quality Culture:** Champion a strong food safety culture by ensuring strict site-wide adherence to Food Safety, Quality, HACCP, and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs).
* **Workplace Safety:** Actively monitor, support, and enforce all plant safety objectives and regulatory standards.
* **Financial & Budgetary Oversight:** Consult with the SBH President on operational budgetary planning, forecasting, and disciplined spending.
* **Team Leadership & HR Partnership:** Collaborate with Human Resources on policy development, employee relations, talent development, and workforce motivation. Clearly communicate changes in company policies, procedures, and strategies to management and plant personnel.

Qualifications

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Operations Management, Business, Engineering, or Supply Chain Management preferred (equivalent relevant work experience will be considered).
* Experience:
* 5+ years of leadership experience within a manufacturing environment required.
* Prior food processing plant management experience in an HACCP- and GMP-regulated environment.
* Certifications & Knowledge: Strong working knowledge of HACCP, GMPs, and chain-of-custody management; current forklift certification (or willingness to obtain certification upon hire).
* Skills: Proven ability to communicate clearly, lead effectively, and influence team members across all levels of the organization.

Physical Requirements

* Frequently required to stand, walk, sit, talk, hear, bend, stoop, and kneel; occasionally required to climb, balance, crouch, and crawl.
* Frequently required to push, pull, lift, and carry up to 60 pounds with assistance.
* Routinely required to reach with hands and arms, involving repetitive motion of the wrists, hands, and fingers.
* Occasionally required to maintain balance while ascending or descending ladders or open stairs.
* Specific vision abilities required include close, distance, color, and peripheral vision, as well as depth perception and the ability to adjust focus.

Work Environment

* Active, fast-paced manufacturing and production floor with heavy forklift traffic and moving machinery; constant situational awareness is essential.
* Exposure to varying climate conditions, including wet surfaces, temperature extremes (hot, unconditioned environments), and high noise levels.
* Strict adherence to food safety and PPE protocols is mandatory, including wearing hairnets/beard nets and following rigorous hand-washing procedures (safety training is provided).

Pay: $90,000.00 - $113,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Relocation assistance

Work Location: In person

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

**Position Summary**

CVS is seeking a Senior Manager to own the end-to-end process and technology strategy for stocking and picking across CVS Distribution. This role sits within the Operational Excellence (OpEx) Initiatives team, reporting to the Executive Director of Operational Excellence Initiatives (whose peers lead the OpEx Regional and OpEx Analytics organizations), alongside three other Senior Managers and a team of Managers/Senior Analysts. This role has two direct reports. Where peer Senior Managers on the team own the inbound-through-machine-replenishment and inbound/outbound value streams, this role owns the network's stocking and picking processes – the highest-volume and most labor-intensive processes in our network. This individual will also serve as the process-side subject matter expert on Warehouse Management System (WMS) configuration within owned value streams, to ensure system and process are in alignment. The role requires approximately 30–50% travel, often in stretches on an every-other-week cadence.

Responsibilities:

* **Technology Deployment (50%) —** Own the 3-year technology roadmap for stocking, picking, and module support, including code updates to existing processes, new process rollouts, and major enhancements, to improve colleague experience, quality, and productivity.
* + **Success Measures** — Deliver measurable improvements in inventory accuracy, stocking and picking quality defects, and throughput, specific to each enhancement or process change.
* **Process Optimization (15%) —** Own the process and technology, and advise on WMS configuration needs within your value streams, working with the other subject matter experts on the team who consult on and implement WMS changes, to tune system settings, improve operations, and keep WMS, technology, and process aligned across stocking and picking:
* + **Stocking —** Own the process and core technology for replenishing split-case picking modules
* + **Picking —** Own the process and core technology for picking across multiple picking methods, including split case and full case, in both active pick slots and reserve storage locations
* **Project & Change Management (25%) —** Plan and execute multiple concurrent projects (typically 4–5 programs in parallel, with a rollout roughly every other week across approximately 2,000 associates), applying strong project management skills — managing risk, critical path, dependencies, and budget — to meet project goals on time. Larger programs are led by the network Center of Excellence (COE); on others, this role provides oversight while the site leads. Build the financial business case and project plan for new opportunities, and ensure robust follow-through on changes to sustain results.
* **Mentorship/Training (10%)—** Grow and shape the organization's lean capability, developing training content and standard work that enhances the continuous improvement culture across the network. Lead, coach, and develop direct reports.

This is a work-from-home role with travel; relocation is not offered. The ideal candidate is located near one of the following distribution centers: La Habra (CA), Patterson (CA), Conroe (TX), Lumberton (NJ), Woonsocket (RI), Chemung (NY), Novi (DT), Kansas City (MO), Indianapolis (IN), Orlando (FL), North Augusta (SC), Fredericksburg (VA), or Knoxville (TN).

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or related engineering/science field or additional 4 years of experience in the requirements below
* 6+ years' experience in a manufacturing or distribution center environment
* 4+ years of demonstrated success and experience in Lean Manufacturing, Continuous Improvement, or Operational Excellence in a manufacturing or warehouse operation
* 4+ years of demonstrated success in managing projects
* 4+ years of experience with WMS, ERP, MES, or LMS systems and database structure

* 2+ years of experience with SQL
* Proven ability to influence and partner with operations, IT, and finance leaders; strong written and verbal communication; self-motivated and effective at managing multiple priorities 
 
 **Preferred Qualifications**
* 9+ years' experience in a manufacturing or distribution center environment
* 6+ years as continuous improvement, industrial engineering, or process engineering
* 2+ years of experience with Microsoft Azure Snowflake semantic modeling and Power BI
* 2+ years running operations (plant manager, senior operations manager, etc.)
* Certified in standards-based time and motion study systems such as MOST and MTM
* APICS CPIM, CSCP, or CLTD Certified
* PMP Certified
* Six Sigma Black Belt Certified

**Pay Range**

The typical pay range for this role is:

$82,940.00 - $182,549.00

This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors. This position is eligible for a CVS Health bonus, commission or short-term incentive program in addition to the base pay range listed above. This position also includes an award target in the company’s equity award program.

Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong.

**Great benefits for great people**

We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families.

 
This full‑time position is eligible for a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the physical, emotional, and financial well‑being of colleagues and their families. The benefits for this position include medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, retirement savings options, wellness programs, and other resources, based on eligibility.

Additional details about available benefits are provided during the application process and on Benefits Moments.

 
We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on: 12/14/2026

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state and local laws.

records.title: Sr. Manager, External Manufacturing Operations
records.description:
At Solventum, we improve lives by helping healthcare professionals do their best work. Join a team using innovation and insight to make a real impact on the future of healthcare. All roles listed are with Solventum, and we’re committed to protecting your personal information—learn more in our Privacy Policy

**Job Description:**

**Sr. Manager, External Manufacturing Operations**

**3M Health Care is now Solventum**

**At Solventum, we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers’ toughest challenges, we pioneer game-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. Because people, and their wellbeing, are at the heart of every scientific advancement we pursue.**

**We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy. Because at Solventum, we never stop solving for you.**

**The Impact You’ll Make in this Role**

As a **Sr, Manager of External Manufacturing Operations**, you will have the opportunity to tap into your curiosity and collaborate with some of the most innovative and diverse people around the world. Here, you will make an impact by:

* Owning the operational performance and strategic relationship of the external manufacturing partners supporting Brookings.
* Maintaining direct accountability for the continuity and availability of externally supplied materials and products required for Brookings manufacturing.
* Ensuring materials are available when needed, meet established specifications, and do not disrupt the manufacturing process.
* Establishing clear expectations for Contract Manufacturing Organization (CMO) performance across quality, delivery, capacity, cost, responsiveness, compliance, and supply continuity.
* Maintaining visibility to supplier production plans, materials, inventory, logistics, capacity, and constraints.
* Leading rapid response and escalation when supplier quality, capacity, production, logistics, technical, or operational issues threaten Brookings manufacturing.
* Driving containment, recovery, root cause, corrective action, and prevention to ensure issues are sustainably resolved.
* Establishing a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and operational excellence across the CMO network.

**Your Skills and Expertise**

To set you up for success in this role from day one, Solventum requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:

 

* Bachelor's degree or higher in (completed and verified prior to start) AND twelve (12) years of combined experience in manufacturing, operations, external manufacturing, supply chain, quality, engineering, planning, and/or procurement

In addition to the above requirements, the following are also required:

 

* Experience managing contract manufacturing organizations (CMOs), contract manufacturers, and/or strategic manufacturing suppliers
* Experience supporting medical device manufacturing within a regulated manufacturing environment
* Experience managing supply continuity, CMO capacity, production planning, supplier quality, asset strategy, and/or operational risk

Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:

 

* Experience applying medical device quality systems and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Experience applying GMP, supplier quality, change control, specifications, CAPA, SCARs, Quality Agreements, and/or regulatory compliance requirements.
* Experience developing and executing CMO risk mitigation and business continuity strategies.
* Experience establishing supplier KPI dashboards, scorecards, and executive performance reviews.
* Experience supporting CMO contracts, Quality Agreements, commercial negotiations, and supplier performance management.
* Experience supporting budgeting, forecasting, capital expenditure (CapEx) planning, and business case development.
* Experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives involving Manufacturing, Engineering, Supplier Quality, Value Stream Management, Supply Chain, Procurement, Quality, Regulatory, Finance, and/or external partners.
* Experience communicating, negotiating, and presenting recommendations to cross-functional stakeholders and senior leaders.

**Work location:**

* **Hybrid Eligible (Job Duties allow for some remote work but require travel to Brookings and other sites, including suppliers and other Solventum locations)** 
 **OR**
* **Remote in United States**

**Travel: May include up to 70% domestic/international**

**Relocation Assistance: May be authorized**

**Must be legally authorized to work in country of employment without sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H1B status).**

**Supporting Your Well-being**

Solventum offers many programs to help you live your best life – both physically and financially. To ensure competitive pay and benefits, Solventum regularly benchmarks with other companies that are comparable in size and scope.

Applicable to US Applicants Only:The expected compensation range for this position is $187,600 - $257,950, which includes base pay plus variable incentive pay, if eligible. This range represents a good faith estimate for this position. The specific compensation offered to a candidate may vary based on factors including, but not limited to, the candidate’s relevant knowledge, training, skills, work location, and/or experience. In addition, this position may be eligible for a range of benefits (e.g., Medical, Dental & Vision, Health Savings Accounts, Health Care & Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts, Disability Benefits, Life Insurance, Voluntary Benefits, Paid Absences and Retirement Benefits, etc.). Please note that all email communications from Solventum regarding job opportunities with the company will be from an email with a domain of **@solventum.com**. Be wary of unsolicited emails or messages regarding Solventum job opportunities from emails with other email domains.

Solventum is an equal opportunity employer. Solventum will not discriminate against any applicant for employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

**Please note: your application may not be considered if you do not provide your education and work history, either by: 1) uploading a resume, or 2) entering the information into the application fields directly.**

records.description:
**Job Description**

**General Summary**
-------------------

The Manufacturing Technical Services Senior Manager provides technical leadership for commercial manufacturing operations for Spray Dried Dispersion (SDD) at external manufacturing partners. The role is accountable for overseeing technical services activities across the commercial manufacturing lifecycle, including manufacturing readiness, process performance, technical investigations, change management, process improvement, and supply-risk mitigation.

The Senior Manager partners with Manufacturing Operations, MS&T, Quality, Supply Chain, Engineering, Regulatory Affairs, and CDMOs/CMOs to ensure manufacturing processes are robust, compliant, reliable, and capable of supporting product supply. The role leads complex cross-functional technical workstreams and develops technical talent within the Manufacturing Technical Services organization.

**Key Duties and Responsibilities**
-----------------------------------

* Lead Manufacturing Technical Services support for assigned commercial manufacturing programs and external manufacturing partners.
* Establish technical plans and priorities to support manufacturing readiness, commercial production campaigns, product supply, and lifecycle-management objectives.
* Provide technical oversight during manufacturing execution; lead escalation and resolution of complex process, equipment, yield, and manufacturing-performance issues.
* Lead technical investigations of significant manufacturing deviations, process excursions, yield loss, equipment failures, and product-quality events; ensure root cause, technical impact, and sustainable corrective actions are clearly defined.
* Oversee manufacturing, process, analytical, and batch-performance trending to identify emerging risks, assess process robustness, and prioritize improvement opportunities.
* Lead technical assessment and approval of change controls, risk assessments, comparability assessments, process updates, and related manufacturing documentation.
* Partner with Manufacturing Operations and Supply Chain to assess technical constraints, manage manufacturing and supply risks, and develop recovery or mitigation plans.
* Lead technical governance with CDMOs/CMOs, including performance review, issue escalation, technical decision-making, data review, and follow-up of technical deliverables.
* Collaborate with MS&T, Quality, Engineering, and Regulatory Affairs to ensure technical strategies align with process-validation requirements, cGMP expectations, regulatory commitments, and product lifecycle plans.
* Lead continuous-improvement initiatives that enhance process robustness, product quality, yield, manufacturing efficiency, and supply reliability.
* Develop, mentor, and provide technical directions to Manufacturing Technical Services staff and matrixed technical teams.
* Travel to support on-site manufacturing activities, CDMO/CMO operations, audits, inspections, and business needs as required (10-20% travel expected)

**Knowledge and Skills**
------------------------

* Deep understanding of pharmaceutical manufacturing processes, testing, controls, and commercial manufacturing operations for Spray Dried Dispersion (SDD)
* Strong knowledge of current Good Manufacturing Practices, pharmaceutical quality systems, and controlled-documentation requirements.
* Demonstrated experience with commercial manufacturing support, technical services, process monitoring, product lifecycle management, and external manufacturing oversight.
* Advanced experience leading complex technical investigations, root-cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions, change controls, risk assessments, and process-improvement initiatives.
* Ability to interpret manufacturing, process, and analytical data; identify process-performance trends; assess technical risks; and recommend practical, sustainable solutions.
* Understanding of manufacturing operations, maintenance, engineering, equipment performance, capacity constraints, and supply-continuity planning.
* Experience leading CDMO/CMO technical relationships, including governance, performance management, technical issue resolution, and escalation.
* Strong cross-functional leadership and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to influence decisions without direct authority.
* Excellent written, verbal, presentation, strategic-thinking, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, and relevant manufacturing or business systems.

**Education and Experience**
----------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Biological Sciences, Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Materials Science, or a related scientific or technical discipline.
* Typically requires 8+ years of experience in biotechnology, pharmaceutical, chemical, or another regulated manufacturing environment, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Significant experience supporting commercial manufacturing operations, technical services, MS&T, process development, engineering, quality, or external manufacturing.
* Demonstrated experience leading technical programs, manufacturing workstreams, complex investigations, process improvements, or cross-functional teams.
* Experience working in a cGMP environment and supporting controlled manufacturing documentation is required.
Demonstrate people leadership, matrix leadership, or technical leadership experience is required. 

 
 

At Vertex, we embrace continuous learning and encourage employees to stay informed on advances in AI, technology, automation, and industry trends. We seek talent who bring an external perspective, demonstrate curiosity and sound judgment, and thoughtfully adopt new capabilities that improve decision-making, drive innovation, increase efficiency, and help deliver better outcomes for patients.

**Pay Range:**

$138,700 - $208,100

**Disclosure Statement:**

The range provided is based on what we believe is a reasonable estimate for the base salary pay range for this job at the time of posting. This role is eligible for an annual bonus and annual equity awards. Some roles may also be eligible for overtime pay, in accordance with federal and state requirements. Actual base salary pay will be based on a number of factors, including skills, competencies, experience, and other job-related factors permitted by law.

At Vertex, our Total Rewards offerings also include inclusive market-leading benefits to meet our employees wherever they are in their career, financial, family and wellbeing journey while providing flexibility and resources to support their growth and aspirations. From medical, dental and vision benefits to generous paid time off (including a week-long company shutdown in the Summer and the Winter), educational assistance programs including student loan repayment, a generous commuting subsidy, matching charitable donations, 401(k) and so much more.

**Flex Designation:**

Hybrid-Eligible Or On-Site Eligible

**Flex Eligibility Status:**

In this Hybrid-Eligible role, you can choose to be designated as:
 
1. **Hybrid** : work remotely up to two days per week; **or select** 
2. **On-Site** : work five days per week on-site with ad hoc flexibility.

Note: The Flex status for this position is subject to Vertex’s Policy on Flex @ Vertex Program and may be changed at any time.

#LI-Hybrid

**Company Information**

Vertex is a global biotechnology company that invests in scientific innovation.

Vertex is committed to equal employment opportunity and non-discrimination for all employees and qualified applicants without regard to a person's race, color, sex, gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, marital status, or any characteristic protected under applicable law. Vertex is an E-Verify Employer in the United States. Vertex will make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with known disabilities, in accordance with applicable law.

Any applicant requiring an accommodation in connection with the hiring process and/or to perform the essential functions of the position for which the applicant has applied should make a request to the recruiter or hiring manager, or contact Talent Acquisition at ApplicationAssistance@vrtx.com

records.description:
***Who We Are:***

Xenon Pharmaceuticals (NASDAQ:XENE) is a neuroscience-focused biopharmaceutical company dedicated to drug discovery, clinical development, and commercialization of life-changing therapeutics for patients in need. We are looking for great people who thrive in a respectful, collaborative, inclusive, and productive culture to join the Xenon team.

***What We Do:***

We are advancing an exciting product pipeline to address indications with high unmet medical need, including epilepsy, depression and pain. Our late-stage azetukalner program represents the most advanced, clinically validated potassium channel modulator in late-stage clinical development for multiple indications. In March 2026, we announced positive topline data from our Phase 3 X-TOLE2 study of azetukalner in focal seizures (FS), and we submitted a New Drug Application to the Food and Drug Administration in the third quarter of 2026. Our Phase 3 epilepsy program also includes a second FS study, X-TOLE3, which would support regulatory submissions outside the U.S., and the X-ACKT study in primary generalized tonic-clonic seizures, which would support regulatory submissions for an additional epilepsy indication. We also are investigating azetukalner in major depressive disorder (MDD) and bipolar depression (BPD), based on topline data from our Phase 2 X-NOVA clinical trial. In addition, we continue to advance an early-stage pipeline of novel ion channel candidates, including studies of XEN1701 and XEN1720 (targeting Nav1.7) and XEN1120 (targeting Kv7), which are being developed for pain. Backed by a strong balance sheet to support our growth plans, we continue to build a fully integrated, premier neuroscience company with strong discovery, clinical development, corporate, and commercial operations.

***About the Role:***

We are seeking a **Manager/Senior Manager, Global Quality Systems,** who will provide leadership and oversight across key Quality Management System (QMS) processes, including quality events, investigations, root cause analysis, CAPA, and change control. This role will serve as a key quality partner across GxP functions, helping to identify systemic issues, strengthen investigation practices, and drive sustainable, risk-based improvements that support compliance, inspection readiness, and operational excellence. The role will work closely with internal teams and external service providers across Xenon’s outsourced operating model to ensure the QMS remains effective, compliant, and inspection ready.

The ideal candidate will bring strong Quality Systems experience, broad GxP knowledge, and sound business judgment, with the ability to effectively challenge investigations, facilitate meaningful root cause analysis, and influence stakeholders across functions. The role will also support quality governance, QMS metrics and trending, change control review, and the continued optimization of electronic quality systems.

This position reports to the Associate Director, Quality Assurance, Systems and will be based out of Boston, MA, USA in our Needham office. This role is a hybrid position, requiring a minimum of two onsite days per week. The level of the position will be commensurate with the candidate’s education and industry experience.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* **Quality Systems & Governance**

 + Manage the oversight, lifecycle management, and continuous improvement of GxP Quality Systems, including quality events, investigations, CAPA, change control, and associated governance processes.
 + Ensure consistent, risk-based practices for investigation, root cause analysis, CAPA, and change management, including review and approval of records and escalation of significant quality or compliance risks.
 + Monitor QMS performance through metrics, trending, CAPA effectiveness, and Quality Management Review reporting to identify systemic risks and drive continuous improvement.
* **Compliance, Inspection Readiness & eQMS**

 + Assess QMS processes and proposed changes for GxP, regulatory, validation, training, documentation, and data integrity considerations, maintaining alignment with applicable regulatory requirements and industry expectations.
 + Support the administration, optimization, validation, upgrades, and continuous improvement of the eQMS and associated procedures, guidance, and training.
 + Support regulatory inspections and internal and external audits, including inspection readiness and responses to observations and findings.
* **Quality Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership**

 + Provide Quality Systems expertise, guidance, coaching, and training to promote consistent, inspection-ready, and risk-based quality practices across the organization.
 + Partner with GxP functions and external service providers to establish quality expectations, resolve quality issues, implement compliant changes and CAPAs, and drive cross-functional quality improvement initiatives.
 + Promote a strong quality culture through effective stakeholder engagement, sound judgment, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* **General Responsibilities**

 + Act in accordance with Company policies, including the Code of Business Conduct and Ethics, and ensure applicable policies are understood and followed by direct reports, if any.
 + Other duties as assigned.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Health Sciences, Pharmacy, or a related discipline; advanced degree preferred.
* 5–8+ years of relevant experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience, within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, or other regulated industry, with demonstrated experience in Quality Systems, Quality Assurance, or compliance.
* Demonstrated experience with quality event management, including complex investigations, root cause analysis, CAPA, and change control.
* Strong working knowledge of QMS requirements, quality risk management principles, and applicable GxP regulations, including GMP and familiarity with GCP, GVP, and GLP.
* Experience with electronic Quality Management Systems such as Veeva Quality, MasterControl, or equivalent, including supporting system implementation, optimization, or maintenance.
* Experience developing, reviewing, and maintaining quality procedures, SOPs, metrics, and trending to support risk-based decision-making and continuous improvement.
* Experience supporting quality governance activities, regulatory inspections, internal or external audits, and inspection readiness.
* Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally and influence stakeholders while effectively navigating ambiguity and driving quality initiatives to completion.
* Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to balance strategic judgment with a hands-on approach to execution.
* Excellent organizational, written, and verbal communication skills.

Our Total Rewards program includes base salary, target bonus, and stock options, as well as a full range of benefits including medical, dental, vision, short-& long-term disability, accidental death & dismemberment, and life insurance programs, Employee Assistance Program, travel insurance, and retirement savings programs with company matching contributions.

Xenon encourages time to rest and re-charge through vacation, personal days, sick days, and an end-of-year company shutdown. Xenon highly values employee development and has an expanding Training, Learning & Development program, including a Tuition Assistance program for advanced degrees.

Compensation Range: $131.3K - $173.3K

records.title: Senior Manager, Operations - Quality
records.description:
**About the role:**
===================

This is a hands-on role with both strategic and executional scope. You will build and lead quality assurance and quality control standards across Operations, set the sampling, validation, and escalation practices the organization runs on, and partner closely with the Senior Manager, Operations - Payer Ops, the Human-in-the-Loop Operations leader, Product, and Engineering. You will report to the Head of Operations and help define the company's AI/Human QA strategy as Adonis scales.

**What you'll do:**
===================

**Own the Quality Program across Operations**
---------------------------------------------

* Define and own QA/QC standards, sampling methodologies, audit practices, and validation processes across AI agent outputs, human-executed work, and vendor-delivered operations.
* Develop & present quarterly plans and operating metrics; communicate progress and trade-offs; surface risks early + Work closely with the Head of Operations on strategic projects
* Lead quality assurance for payer workflows and agent outcomes, including new payer activations on the voice channel.
* Lead the development and implementation of a near-real-time QA Dashboard to provide visibility into quality, identify performance gaps, and track improvement over time.
* Partner with the operations team and external vendors to ensure work consistently meets Adonis's accuracy, operational, and compliance standards.
* Partner closely with the operations team to align on quality standards, remediation priorities, and operational performance.
* Collaborate with Product, Engineering, vendors, and cross-functional stakeholders to address quality gaps, improve workflows, and support strategic initiatives.
* Serve as the quality subject matter expert across Operations, ensuring quality considerations are incorporated into new workflows, product launches, and operational changes.

**Turn quality findings into operational and product improvements**
-------------------------------------------------------------------

* Translate and present quality trends and findings into actionable recommendations for Product, Engineering, and Operations, driving improvements from identification through implementation and validation.
* Leverage AI, automation, and internal tooling to increase the efficiency, accuracy, and scalability of QA/QC processes.
* Establish quality thresholds and escalation criteria for uncertain, complex, or high-impact outcomes.

**Build and lead a high-performing quality function**
-----------------------------------------------------

* Build and scale the Quality function, establishing clear goals, ownership, processes, and performance metrics.
* Lead, coach, and develop onshore and offshore team members, as the function grows.
* Develop and maintain SOPs, playbooks, training materials, and quality guidelines to support operational consistency and continuous improvement.

**Who you are:**
================

* 6+ years of experience
* Experience in healthcare revenue cycle management (RCM) is required, with practical understanding of payer, claims, or related revenue-cycle workflows.
* Experience building or leading quality assurance, quality control, or quality programs in a technology-enabled operations environment.
* Experience coaching a team and creating clarity across multiple workstreams.
* Experience defining operating standards, evaluating results, investigating failures, and ensuring corrective actions are effective.
* Strong cross-functional communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with Product, Engineering, customer-facing teams, and operational partners.
* Comfort moving between strategic planning and hands-on operational detail in a fast-changing environment.
* An AI-forward mindset and practical experience applying AI, automation, or intelligent tooling to improve quality and operational performance, with sound judgment about when human review is needed.

The base salary range for this position is $140,000 to $180,000. Base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition to base salary, we also offer competitive equity and benefits packages.

**About Adonis**
================

Adonis is the leading AI orchestration platform for healthcare revenue cycle management (RCM), purpose-built for healthcare organizations seeking to transform their revenue operations. Traditional RCM processes often struggle with inefficiencies, costing providers up to 15% or more of their potential revenue. Through advanced automation, data science, and AI Agents, Adonis helps revenue teams detect vulnerabilities, optimize workflows, and deploy precise solutions that drive reliable and scalable financial outcomes.

Adonis is headquartered in New York City and has raised over $95M in funding, including a recent $40M Series C round led by Quadrille Capital with continued support from existing investors such as General Catalyst and Bling Capital. This funding supports our mission to restore sanity to RCM and equip provider groups and health systems with AI-driven revenue cycle operations at scale.

**Compensation Philosophy**
===========================

Actual base pay will depend on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Adonis determines compensation based on each candidate’s experience and qualifications relative to peers, and most new hires fall near the middle of the range. In addition to base salary, you’ll receive meaningful equity and great benefits.

**Perks at Adonis**
===================

* Competitive equity packages
* Employer-paid medical insurance
* Employer-paid dental insurance
* Employer-paid vision insurance
* Employer-funded HSA
* Parental leave
* Commuter benefits
* Office lunches every day
* Office snacks
* Generous PTO
* Located in 3 World Trade Center with easy access to all trains and the PATH, and amazing views of the city

Adonis is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive culture that celebrates authenticity to win as one. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, citizenship or immigration status, or any other legally protected characteristics.

At Adonis, we fully comply with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA). We are dedicated to embracing challenges and creating an accessible, inclusive workplace for all individuals.

Compensation Range: $140K - $180K

records.title: Senior Manager, Manufacturing Quality
records.description:
At GE Appliances, a Haier company, we come together to make “good things, for life.” As the fastest-growing appliance company in the U.S., we’re powered by creators, thinkers and makers who believe that anything is possible and that there’s always a better way. We believe in the power of our people and in giving them the freedom to explore, discover and build good things, together.

 

The GE Appliances philosophy, backed by three simple commitments defines the way we work, invent, create, do business, and serve our communities: *we come together*, *we always look for a better way*, and *we create possibilities*.

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and must be able to maintain such authorization without current or future employer or school sponsorship. GE Appliances will not sponsor employment-based visas for this position now or in the future.

Interested in joining us on our journey?

 
The Senior Manager, Manufacturing Quality leads a team supporting the execution of short-term and long term projects focused on product and process quality improvement. The role supports front-line leadership and development of both salary and hourly team members in support of the factory Manufacturing Control Plans. The role is responsible for working cross-functionally to execute the overall goal for reducing the cost of poor quality associated with plant operations and product performance post-sale.

**Position**
------------

Senior Manager, Manufacturing Quality

**Location**
------------

USA, Louisville, KY

**How You'll Create Possibilities**
-----------------------------------

* Live, promote and support the Appliance Production System (APS) philosophy and drive continuous improvement in the quality and adjacent areas. Coach all team members to ensure cross-functional, focused collaboration is the way we work.
* Partner with the Quality Improvement Engineering, Business Operations and Manufacturing Engineering Leaders to promote a culture that establishes, sustains and improves product quality through engineering problem solving and discipline around supporting systems. Promote a method-based quick response to new issues.
* Responsible for developing and tracking team performance metrics tied to the overall factory (FPY, EOLA, Scrap) and effect to the product line financial plan (Damage, Scrap). Leads the team to complete projects and tasks supporting this effort. Owns and assigns tasks and establishes accountability at the appropriate level.
* Closely collaborates with the product line Engineering, Field Quality and Service organizations to understand and respond to part or system product level performance issues impacting owner use and satisfaction. Responds to this data in addition to internal data streams (leading indicators) for product quality and reliability (Engineering, EOLA and audit labs).
* Identify and execute projects to improve the cost of operations. Serve as a broad owner for Corrective and Preventative Actions (CAPA), Corrective Action Request (CAR) approach to problem solving.
* Owner of the execution of attributes of the Manufacturing Control Plan for broad areas. Responsible for the training, execution, auditing and improvement of the Manufacturing Quality Control Plan. Support efforts intended to improve workstation documentation process; create, update and maintain Manufacturing Control Instructions (MCI’s), visual aid and alerts (single point lessons) as needed.
* Strong technical aptitude and ability to coach others in complex engineering topics like dimensional control, material properties, failure analysis as well as emerging technologies such as AI
* Support analysis of data as part of Statistical Process Control (SPC) and implementation of responses as required by MCI/MCP. Escalate and measure response to data trends. Validate root cause response for effectiveness.
* Lead and support 1x1 problem solving for quality systems and related issues collaborate cross functionally to improve product quality through the identification and elimination of root cause of issues. Focus on overall repair efficiency.

**What You'll Bring to Our Team**
---------------------------------

* 8+ Years of successful experience in Manufacturing / Quality, focused on providing operational support to support operations and vertical manufacturing operations.
* Demonstrated expertise in a combination of Metrology, CMM or 3D scanning of complicated assemblies
* Ability to work within large cross-functional teams and at multiple levels in the organization.
* Demonstrated excellent communication, presentation, and facilitation skills.
* Demonstrated experience as a hands-on problem solver including complex systems (supply, build, testing and diagnosis)
* Demonstrated leadership during technically challenging and complicated cross functional projects/tasks

**Desired Characteristics**

* Engineering degree with strong content tied to understanding and impact to business financial performance
* Quality Leadership experience
* Prior experience in a union environment
* Strong organizational skills- focused on project and resource management

### **Working Conditions**

### 

* Working conditions are normal for a high-volume manufacturing environment.
* Working in this environment will occasionally require the use of safety equipment to include but not limited to: eye safety glasses, hearing protectors, work boots, and hardhats.
* These roles require frequent walking in a manufacturing plant environment.
* Travel (up to 10%) to suppliers and other manufacturing locations as needed.
* This position will be located in Louisville, KY.
* Hours & Weekends: Working off-shift and weekends may be required.

**Our Culture**
---------------

Our work is centered on our People and Culture as reflected in our Zero Distance philosophy and we recognize the importance of reaffirming our commitment to inclusion and diversity (I&D). This underscores our commitment to fostering an environment where every individual feels valued, connected, and empowered to contribute, while positioning our organization to adapt seamlessly to the evolving needs of our workforce and communities. 
 
This reflects our dedication to creating solutions that: Empower colleagues by fostering an environment where all voices are heard, valued, and encouraged to contribute. Strengthen communities where we live and work. Reinforce a culture of belonging, purpose, and engagement. Reflect the diversity of the communities we serve through our workforce, products, and practices. 
 
By further embedding Zero Distance into our People and Culture framework, we will continue to build a deeply connected organization. We are cultivating a culture of engagement, belonging, and connection, because while attracting new talent remains a priority, retention is a cornerstone of our strategy.

GE Appliances is a trust-based organization. It is important we offer our employees the flexibility they need to do their best work while balancing the needs of the business and individuals. When you join GE Appliances, you will have the opportunity to work with your leader to create a flexible work arrangement that balances the needs of the individual, team, and organization.

GE Appliances is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

GE Appliances participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S

*If you are an individual with a disability and need assistance or an accommodation to use our website or to apply, please send an e-mail* *to ask.recruiting@geappliances.com*

records.description:
Job Summary

This Senior Manager, Quality Engineering role is a key leadership position responsible for overseeing Insulet’s global Design Transfer Quality Engineering team and ensuring new and modified Omnipod products and manufacturing processes are successfully transferred, validated, and sustained in compliance with FDA and ISO quality standards. The position leads a team of Quality Engineers supporting product launches, manufacturing expansion, process validation, risk management, CAPA, and continuous improvement initiatives across global manufacturing sites. The ideal candidate brings extensive medical device quality experience, deep expertise in design transfer, process validation, and regulatory compliance, along with proven people leadership skills. Success in this role requires partnering across Manufacturing, Operations, R&D, Regulatory Affairs, and Quality organizations to drive quality strategy, support global growth initiatives, and maintain high standards in a complex, high-volume regulated manufacturing environment.



The Senior Manager, Quality Engineering leads Insulet's global Design Transfer Quality Engineering team, ensuring new and changed Omnipod products and manufacturing processes are successfully transferred to production, validated and sustained in compliance with the Insulet Quality System, FDA Quality Management System Regulation (21 CFR Part 820), ISO 13485 and ISO 14971. The Sr. Quality Engineering Manager leads a team of Quality Engineers to support design transfer, capacity expansion, and process controls across Insulet's manufacturing sites. The Senior Manager establishes quality strategy, owns key QMS procedures and metrics, represents Quality throughout major design transfer and global expansion initiatives, and partners closely with Manufacturing Engineering, Operations, R&D, Regulatory Affairs and site Quality leaders. The ideal candidate is an experienced medical device quality leader who builds strong teams, makes sound risk-based decisions and drives continuous improvement in a highly regulated, high-volume manufacturing environment at a global scale.

 

Responsibilities:

· Lead, coach and develop a team of Quality Engineers; set priorities, manage workload and resourcing, conduct performance reviews and development plans, and lead hiring.

· Serve as Quality lead for the design transfer of new products and product design changes, ensuring quality deliverables (e.g. Project Quality Plans, Design Transfer Plans, Product Launch Plans) are created and properly executed through each phase gate.

· Serve as global process owner for Production & Process Controls and Design Transfer including procedure continuous improvement, performance monitoring of KPIs, and development of new or expanded processes to support Insulet’s growing production capacity.

· Support manufacturing process validation, equipment qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ) and Test Method Validation for new manufacturing lines, capacity expansion, site transfers and equipment upgrades; review and approve plans, protocols and reports.

· Drive process risk management across all sites, including pFMEA governance and integration of nonconformance and production data into risk management.

· Lead remediation and compliance initiatives and provide Quality oversight of CAPAs, investigations, quality events and nonconformances, ensuring effective root cause analysis and verification of effectiveness.

· Partner with global manufacturing sites and contract manufacturers to deploy harmonized quality and process improvements.

· Provide Quality leadership for enterprise systems and digital initiatives (e.g. SAP, MES, eDHR, eQMS).

· Prepare and present quality metrics and project status for operations leadership, QMS process owner forums, and management review.

· Support internal and external audits as a subject matter expert, maintain inspection readiness, and serve as the escalation point for cross-functional quality questions from Operations, Engineering and Supply Chain.

Education and Experience:

• BS degree in engineering, a technical or scientific discipline; and/or equivalent combination of education and experience.

• Master's degree in engineering or technical or scientific discipline preferred.

• Minimum 10 years' experience in Medical Device Quality Assurance.

• 3-5 years' experience managing people, including leading engineers and technical staff.

• In-depth knowledge of FDA 21 CFR Part 820, ISO 13485 and ISO 14971.

• Demonstrated experience leading design transfer and process validation for high-volume manufacturing of single-use products, preferably on automated manufacturing equipment.

• Experience with process risk management (pFMEA), CAPA, nonconformance and change control processes; QMS process ownership experience preferred.

• Experience with statistical methods (e.g. statistical process control, sampling plans, Test Method Validation, gauge R&R, and capability).

• Experience working with global manufacturing sites and contract manufacturers.

• Experience with eQMS/PLM, ERP and data visualization tools, as well as word processing, spreadsheet and database programs.

 

Skills/Competencies:

• Proven ability to build, lead and develop high-performing teams, including effective delegation and succession planning.

• Strategic thinking with the ability to organize, judge and balance priorities across multiple complex projects.

• Sound, risk-based decision making in a highly regulated environment.

• Strong verbal (including presentation) and written communication skills, with the ability to influence and present to executive leadership.

• Effective collaboration and communication with individuals at multiple levels and across functions, sites and geographies.

• Strong problem solving / root cause analysis skills.

• Ability to generate and maintain organized and accurate records, and to follow up with task owners to close out open items.

 

Other Expectations:

· Flexibility to work across multiple time zones, outside of normal working hours.

· Travel (International) – 10%

*NOTE: This position is eligible for hybrid working arrangements (requires on-site work from an Insulet office). #LI-Hybrid*

Additional Information:



Compensation & Benefits:

For U.S.-based positions only, the annual base salary range for this role is $138,700.00 - $208,000.00

This position may also be eligible for incentive compensation.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package, including:
• Medical, dental, and vision insurance
• 401(k) with company match
• Paid time off (PTO)
• And additional employee wellness programs

Application Details:
This job posting will remain open until the position is filled.
To apply, please visit the Insulet Careers site and submit your application online.

Actual pay depends on skills, experience, and education.

Insulet Corporation (NASDAQ: PODD), headquartered in Massachusetts, is an innovative medical device company dedicated to simplifying life for people with diabetes and other conditions through its Omnipod product platform. records.title: Senior Manager Operational Area Quality (Hybrid)
records.description:
**Job Description**

**General/Position Summary**

 

The Quality Assurance Senior Operational Manager is recognized as an expert internally in the principles and application of quality assurance and compliance. The Quality Snr Manager will provide QA support of manufacturing operations, analytical laboratory operations and materials management for the external manufacture of Cell & Genetic Therapeutic programs. This role will drive, review & support activities related to product disposition including review of batch data, batch records, deviations, in-process data, EM data, QC release testing and other quality systems documentation.

 

**Key Duties & Responsibilities**

* Responsible for quality support of Vertex Cell and Gene Therapy manufacturing operations across all phases of development, support of analytical laboratory, materials management and manufacturing operations.

* Responsible for GMP batch disposition activities including review and approval of batch records, deviations, in-process data, EM data, QC release testing, materials review board and other quality activities as applicable to determine acceptability of product disposition.

* Partner with External CDMOs

* Provide QA support of change controls, process and OOS investigations, and associated CAPAs.

* Responsible for approval of COAs and product labelling.

* Support review and approval of manufacturing documents such as technical and analytical protocols/reports

* Support technical transfer, and process performance qualification activities.

* Responsible for identifying compliance risks and gaps for GMP processes and supporting implementation of mitigating controls

* Support audit and inspection readiness activities.

* Act as a trusted advisor by providing compliance guidance through collaborative review and partnering with business stakeholders and contract manufacturers.

* Support the vendor management process including the creation and review of Quality Agreements with suppliers.

* Assist with addressing product complaints

* Maintain periodic batch record metrics and assists department with routine/quarterly Quality System data review metrics and reporting

* Execute improvements to QA operations procedure.

* Participate/ lead Cell & Genetic Program and Quality projects and drive continuous improvement activities.

 

**Required Education Level**

* Bachelor's degree in a biotech/ Lifesciences field.

* Preferred Master's degree or relevant comparable background.

 

**Required Experience**

8+ years of relevant industry experience such as manufacturing, quality assurance, and/or quality control in biotechnology/regulated pharmaceutical environment.

 

**Required Knowledge/Skills**

* Demonstrated experience providing QA support to GMP manufacturing operation
* Experience successfully leading event investigations, Root Cause Analysis and CAPA
* Experience with network-based applications such as Oracle, TrackWise, Veeva
* In-depth knowledge of both the conceptual and practical application of cGMPs in a pharmaceutical setting; Biotech/Cell & Gene GMP regulations and applicability. (e.g. EU, FDA, ICH, USP, etc. or other industry best practices ex. ISPE, WHO, etc.)
* Knowledge in Cell technology, aseptic manufacturing technology, analytical assays, cell & genetic therapies/Biologics processing, fill/finish and testing.
* Professional membership or equivalent in relevant societies, network of knowledge in cell and gene therapy industry.
* Ability to evaluate quality matters and make decisions utilizing risk-based approach
Ability to independently lead cross-functional teams, and effectively communicate with business stakeholders. 

 

**Other Requirements**

Up to 15% Travel may be required 

 
 

At Vertex, we embrace continuous learning and encourage employees to stay informed on advances in AI, technology, automation, and industry trends. We seek talent who bring an external perspective, demonstrate curiosity and sound judgment, and thoughtfully adopt new capabilities that improve decision-making, drive innovation, increase efficiency, and help deliver better outcomes for patients.

**Pay Range:**

$133,800 - $200,600

**Disclosure Statement:**

The range provided is based on what we believe is a reasonable estimate for the base salary pay range for this job at the time of posting. This role is eligible for an annual bonus and annual equity awards. Some roles may also be eligible for overtime pay, in accordance with federal and state requirements. Actual base salary pay will be based on a number of factors, including skills, competencies, experience, and other job-related factors permitted by law.

At Vertex, our Total Rewards offerings also include inclusive market-leading benefits to meet our employees wherever they are in their career, financial, family and wellbeing journey while providing flexibility and resources to support their growth and aspirations. From medical, dental and vision benefits to generous paid time off (including a week-long company shutdown in the Summer and the Winter), educational assistance programs including student loan repayment, a generous commuting subsidy, matching charitable donations, 401(k) and so much more.

**Flex Designation:**

Hybrid-Eligible Or On-Site Eligible

**Flex Eligibility Status:**

In this Hybrid-Eligible role, you can choose to be designated as:
 
1. **Hybrid** : work remotely up to two days per week; **or select** 
2. **On-Site** : work five days per week on-site with ad hoc flexibility.

Note: The Flex status for this position is subject to Vertex’s Policy on Flex @ Vertex Program and may be changed at any time.

#LI-Hybrid

**Company Information**

Vertex is a global biotechnology company that invests in scientific innovation.

Vertex is committed to equal employment opportunity and non-discrimination for all employees and qualified applicants without regard to a person's race, color, sex, gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, marital status, or any characteristic protected under applicable law. Vertex is an E-Verify Employer in the United States. Vertex will make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with known disabilities, in accordance with applicable law.

Any applicant requiring an accommodation in connection with the hiring process and/or to perform the essential functions of the position for which the applicant has applied should make a request to the recruiter or hiring manager, or contact Talent Acquisition at ApplicationAssistance@vrtx.com

records.title: Senior Manager, Operations
records.description:
**Primary Duties & Responsibilities**

* Day to day management/supervision of assigned Lab environment personnel.
* Manage the pilot line production of OCS chassis level products.
* Plan, design, implement, and manage a R&D lab environment including networking products and technologies, servers, network switches, and supporting infrastructure such as monitoring tools.
* Supervise the facilities management.
* Define lab requirements, coordinate equipment procurement, and oversee installation, configuration, and operational readiness
* Collaborate with internal teams to develop and deliver interactive demonstrations that highlight product capabilities and solutions
* Partner with cross-functional teams to create and maintain passive product displays, including hardware setups and technical signage within the lab
* Recruit, screen, hire, train, retain, discipline direct labor, Timecards, PTO, reviews, performance improvements, cultivate team leads.
* Manage and ensure accuracy of timecards. Plan and Schedule for OT when necessary.
* Coordinate material, equipment, facilities, and labor to achieve production targets. Manage constraints.
* Report shift’s outputs. Participate and conduct pass down meetings.
* Work collaboratively with Process Engineering, R&D, Quality, Planning, Facilities, and Equipment Maintenance to achieve output targets. Provide inputs and feedback for improvement.
* Shift planning such that production and maintenance shift targets are achieved.
* Maximizing the contributions from available resources.
* Organize employee training and development through operator appraisals.
* Ensure Health & Safety standards/procedures are adhered to.
* Ensure all clean room protocols are adhered.
* Communicate daily/weekly shift goals/targets to shift personnel.
* Ensure that personnel receive appropriate training in line with training schedule/programs.
* Provide accurate information with respect to all production & engineering (process & equipment). related issues to the appropriate person / supervisor / manager.
* Analyze manufacturing information and implement any required actions to ensure goals are achieved.
* Experience with Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) e.g., CAMSTAR and Product Data Management (PDM) systems e.g., Agile. Experience with MS Excel, Word, PowerPoint.
* Promote quality awareness and encourage ideas for improvement.
* Maintain a consistent and fair approach to all designated shift personnel.
* Promote working practices and formalized procedures.
* Respond to business needs, scheduling WIP and maintenance in order to meet desired output.

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Optics, Physics , Electronics or a related field (or equivalent practical experience); Master’s degree or higher preferred
* 7+ years of experience in the communications and Optical industry in technical roles. (Manufacturing)
* Strong problem-solving and technical troubleshooting skills in complex environments
* Customer-facing experience is a plus, with the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly and effectively

**Skills**

* Heighten ability to attention to detail.
* Good at working with small parts.
* Experience with semi-automated and automated processing tools.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Excel and Word.
* Meticulous and thorough; diligent with data entry and follow workflow.
* Ability to speak, read, write, and comprehend English required.
* Integrity and self-motivated.
* Ability to work in fast paced team and independent setting all within a clean room.
* Knowledge of machining, construction, electrical useful.
* Ability to control all operations on a shift including the ability to:
 + Implement remedial action to sustain committed/required wafer throughput and quality.
 + Record all pertinent information.
 + Effectively allocate resources.
 + Provide constructive instructions to designated shift.
 + Positively motivate designated shift personnel.
 + Promote a consistent approach within supervisory group.
 + Committed individual with appreciation of business needs.
 + Excellent interpersonal skills.
 + Can effectively prioritize available time.
 + Adaptable to changing circumstances.
 + Reliable and punctual.
 + Ability to identify and focus on priority issues.
 + Fair and approachable.

**Working Conditions**

* This position is Onsite
* May require occasional off-site meetings
* Regular use of a computer and other office equipment is necessary
* Interaction with team members and external contacts is a regular part of the job
* May require occasional overtime and flexibility in work hours to accommodate the executive’s needs

**Physical Requirements**

* Sitting for extended periods while working on a computer or conducting meetings.
* Use of hands and fingers for typing, writing, and handling documents.
* Occasional lifting of objects or materials up to 20 pounds for administrative tasks.
* Ability to communicate verbally and in writing.
* Mobility within the office environment to attend meetings or interact with colleagues.

**Safety Requirements**

All employees are required to follow the site EHS procedures and Coherent Corp. Corporate EHS standards.

**Quality and Environmental Responsibilities**

Depending on location, this position may be responsible for the execution and maintenance of the ISO 9000, 9001, 14001 and/or other applicable standards that may apply to the relevant roles and responsibilities within the Quality Management System and Environmental Management System.

**Culture Commitment**

Ensure adherence to company’s values (ICARE) in all aspects of your position at Coherent Corp.:

**I** ntegrity – Create an Environment of Trust

**C** ollaboration – Innovate Through the Sharing of Ideas

**A** ccountability – Own the Process and the Outcome

**R** espect – Recognize the Value in Everyone

**E** nthusiasm – Find a Sense of Purpose in Work

 

*Coherent Corp. is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.*

 

*If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at* *talentacquisition@coherent.com* *.*
