records.title: Senior Director of Operations
records.description:
The Senior Director of Operations oversees all aspects of operations and provides leadership to the plant managers across multiple sites in a campus environment. Overall responsibility for Production, Maintenance, Personnel Scheduling, and Safety, as well as associated responsibilities in Warehouse Operations, Quality Assurance, Human Resources, Commercialization and other related areas. The Director of Operations is also responsible for establishing the campus culture, servicing business needs, and the 3-year masterplan that delivers all KPIs of Safety, Quality, Customer Service and Cost control.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Direct and oversee ongoing performance and efficiency of all plant functions through the establishment and monitoring of KPI's that seek to meet and/or exceed corporate objectives.
* Develop and mentor plant teams, future leaders, and succession planning by partnering with plant managers and human resources.
* Responsible for strategy development based on customer support, OpEx, return on capital, transformational goals, increasing capacity and throughput and cost discipline.
* Formulates and implements manufacturing programs to maintain and improve the competitive position and profitability of the operations. Set structure and discipline in daily management and utilizing data and KPI's to drive priorities and decisions.
* Sets Fiscal Year and 90-day priorities for the plants.
* Rapidly communicate to Vice President of Operations any significant challenges or failures that may pose a risk to the business.
* Leads the development and implementation of TPM strategies that maximize operational effectiveness/performance while partnering with other divisions to develop actionable plans to improve overall operational effectiveness.
* Develop and implement strategies to drive continuous improvement in safety, productivity, product quality, customer service, quality of work life, and lowering manufacturing costs.
* Works closely with sales and finance teams to ensure seamless start-ups of new products on-time and at optimized costs.
* Role models ownership, collaboration, and disciplined execution.
* Provides support and guidance in the management of product quality and ensures compliance with quality and sanitation policies, procedures, and systems to include HACCP, GMPs and the management and reduction of consumer complaints.
* Ensures all performance issues are addressed in a timely manner and all employees adhere to company policies and procedures on an ongoing basis.
* Ensure compliance with all FDA, OSHA, local regulatory agencies and auditing requirements.

Other duties as assigned

Requirements:

* Bachelor's degree in business, engineering, or manufacturing or related field of study.
* Experience with plant transformation including organizational design, facility enhancement and upskilling and development of the workforce. Track record of delivering significant business KPI goals in turnaround opportunities.
* Proven leadership skills to put employees first, ability to remove barriers and promote succession planning
* Directly supervise a team of leaders who supervise leaders.
* Able to simply and effectively communicate complex issues up, down and across the organization.
* High degree of financial acumen is required with the ability to perform plant-level financial analysis.
* Self-motivated with excellent organizational skills and the ability to prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
* Computer skills including MS Office programs such as Outlook, Word, Excel PowerPoint.
* Strong analytical / problem solving skills and attention to detail
* Ability to empower, motivate and inspire staff.
* Ability to lead change and execute strategic decisions.

**Preferred:**

* MBA preferred, but not required
* TPM, TQM, IWS, Six Sigma, or Lean Manufacturing experience
* Organizational Performance Design capability

**Work Environment:**

* This position works in both office AND manufacturing floor environments.
* Evening and weekend work may be required on an as needed basis
* Travel up to 30%

*Tandem Foods is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation or preference, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.*

 
 
Compensation: $201,500.00 - $277,000.00

records.title: Senior Manager, Industrial Engineering
records.description:
**Continue to Grow with GXO.**

At GXO, we know our greatest asset is people like you - energetic, innovative people of all experience levels and talents who make GXO a great place to work. Your career matters to us because your passion and excitement will help keep our company moving forward.

 

As the **Senior Manager, Industrial Engineering**, you will lead the development of facility layouts and designs, labor standards, staffing and efficiency analyses, and identify cost-saving opportunities while supporting operational implementations.

**Pay, benefits and more.**

We are eager to attract the best, so we offer competitive compensation and a generous benefits package, including full health insurance (medical, dental and vision), 401(k), life insurance, disability and more.

**What you’ll do on a typical day:**

* Hire, train and develop industrial engineering staff; provide technical support and direction to site industrial engineers and managers
* Develop labor standards, process flow diagrams and job descriptions for new and existing operations
* Conduct time study analyses to estimate facility staffing requirements and establish production standards
* Identify, evaluate and implement productivity improvements
* Document processes to facilitate operational startups and provide on-site support as required
* Convert contract documents and SOWs into work instructions and operating procedures
* Analyze ongoing costs and compare them to prior cost and pricing estimates
* Select appropriate models for receiving, put-away, picking and packing solutions
* Identify storage and picking strategies based on product dimensions and activity levels
* Identify facility design requirements based on activity levels, product envelopes, product flow, transportation methods, building layout and power requirements
* Specify material handling and storage equipment solutions, including automation where justified
* Collaborate with IT resources to develop equipment requirements based on activity levels

**What you need to succeed at GXO:**

At a minimum, you’ll need:

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent related work or military experience
* 5+ years of experience working in a warehouse, distribution or 3PL environment
* Experience with Warehouse Management Systems (WMS)
* Experience with Labor Management Systems (LMS)
* Project management experience, including leading projects from concept through completion
* Experience with Lean Methodology and AutoCAD
* Familiarity with Six Sigma practices and principles

It’d be great if you also have:

* Advanced degree in Industrial Engineering or a related field
* 7 years of industrial engineering experience in a distribution environment
* 2 years of supervisory or management experience
* SQL experience

**We engineer faster, smarter, leaner supply chains.**

GXO is a leading provider of cutting-edge supply chain solutions to the most successful companies in the world. We help our customers manage their goods most efficiently using our technology and services. Our greatest strength is our global team – energetic, innovative people of all experience levels and talents who make GXO a great place to work.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer including Disabled/Veterans.

GXO adheres to CDC, OSHA and state and local requirements regarding COVID safety. All employees and visitors are expected to comply with GXO policies which are in place to safeguard our employees and customers.

All applicants who receive a conditional offer of employment may be required to take and pass a pre-employment drug test.

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this classification. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of personnel so classified. All employees may be required to perform duties outside of their normal responsibilities from time to time, as needed. Review GXO's candidate privacy statement here.

records.title: Senior Manager, Global Visual Merchandising Production

postedPay.title: Senior Manager, Global Visual Merchandising Production

records.description:
**Michael Kors is always interested in hearing from talented, globally-minded individuals with a passion for fashion.**

**If you enjoy working in a creative, fast-paced environment, then we would love to hear from you!**

—

**Who You Are:**

The Senior Manager, Global Visual Merchandising Production will lead the strategic planning, creative execution, and global production of visual merchandising activations across the Michael Kors retail network. This role is responsible for delivering innovative, brand-elevating experiences that drive customer engagement while ensuring operational excellence, fiscal responsibility, and flawless execution worldwide.

 

Working closely with Global Visual Experience, Store Design, Marketing, Creative Services, Supply Chain, and regional partners, the Senior Manager will oversee the end-to-end production lifecycle for seasonal campaigns, retail environments, windows, in-store experiences, and new store openings. This role will also lead vendor strategy, production innovation, and team development to support the continued growth of the brand globally.

 

**What You’ll Do:**

**Strategic Leadership**

* Define and lead the global production strategy for all Visual Merchandising assets, while providing direct leadership and oversight for the North America region, ensuring alignment with brand, business, and market objectives.
* Own the performance and evolution of the global production function, including operating models, production capabilities, quality standards, vendor networks, and operational effectiveness.
* Establish scalable production processes, governance, and resource strategies that support current business priorities and future growth across North America, EMEA, and APAC.
* Serve as the strategic advisor to Visual Merchandising, Design, and Creative teams, influencing decisions related to feasibility, engineering, materials, fabrication, innovation, and investment priorities.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives that enhance speed-to-market, scalability, sustainability, quality, and cost efficiency while maintaining brand integrity.
* Champion the adoption of AI-enabled tools and emerging technologies to streamline workflows, improve operational efficiency, enhance decision-making, and identify opportunities to simplify and modernize Visual Merchandising production process globally.

**Global Production Management**

* Lead the end-to-end production lifecycle for all global Visual Merchandising programs, including windows, props, visual tools, branded environments, animations, and special activations.
* Oversee planning, budgeting, fabrication, logistics, installation, and execution across retail, outlet, wholesale, and special project channels.
* Ensure all programs are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest standards of quality, craftsmanship, and brand consistency.
* Drive cross-functional project management across multiple concurrent initiatives, balancing competing priorities, business needs, and market requirements.
* Proactively identify executional risks and develop mitigation plans to ensure successful delivery across regions and stakeholders.

**Financial & Vendor Management**

* Own global production budget planning, forecasting, capital investment recommendations, and overall financial performance.
* Develop cost optimization strategies and scalable sourcing models that improve efficiency without compromising quality, customer experience, or brand standards.
* Build and manage strategic partnerships with fabricators, printers, logistics providers, installation partners, and other key vendors worldwide.
* Establish vendor performance metrics, accountability measures, and continuous improvement initiatives to ensure best-in-class execution.
* Evaluate production investments, operating models, and resource requirements, providing recommendations based on business impact, risk, and return on investment.

**Executive Influence & Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Serve as the senior production partner to Visual Merchandising, Store Design, Marketing, Procurement, Finance, Supply Chain, and regional leadership teams.
* Influence decision-making through data-driven recommendations, business acumen, and a comprehensive understanding of brand, customer, operational, and financial priorities.
* Build alignment across functions and regions while balancing competing priorities to achieve the best overall business outcome.
* Represent the production function in senior leadership discussions, ensuring production considerations are incorporated into broader business planning.
* Lead organizational change initiatives and drive adoption of new processes, technologies, and ways of working that improve operational effectiveness globally.

**Team & Organizational Leadership**

* Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing production team while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Build organizational capability by developing future leaders, strengthening succession plans, and creating scalable ways of working.
* Establish clear performance expectations, operating rhythms, and development plans that enable increasing levels of ownership and autonomy across the team.
* Allocate resources strategically to ensure effective execution across a complex portfolio of global initiatives.
Create an environment where proactive problem-solving, strategic thinking, and enterprise leadership are expected at all levels. 

 

**You’ll Need to Have:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Visual Merchandising, Production Management, Design, Construction Management or a related field.
* PMP certification or equivalent project management credentials preferred.
* 7-10 years of progressive experience in visual production, retail marketing production, environmental design, experiential production, or related fields.
* 5+ years of leadership experience managing high-performing teams in a global environment.
* Proven success leading large-scale, multi-market production programs within a premium or luxury retail organization.
* Strong expertise in project management, fabrication, print production, logistics, and installation processes.
Experience managing multimillion-dollar budgets and complex vendor ecosystems. 

 

**We’d Love to See:**

* Exceptional leadership, communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong strategic thinking with the ability to translate creative vision into operational execution.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
* Expertise in vendor negotiations, contract management, and cost optimization.
* Strong analytical and financial acumen.
* Highly collaborative with experience working across global, matrixed organizations.
* Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, project management platforms, and collaborative workplace tools.

—

The Company is an equal employment opportunity employer. The Company’s policy is not to unlawfully discriminate against any applicant or employee on the basis of race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, age, military status, disability, genetic information or any other consideration made unlawful by applicable federal, state, or local laws. The Company also prohibits harassment of applicants and employees based on any of these protected categories.

At Capri Holdings Limited, we are committed to providing a fair and accessible recruitment process. If you require a reasonable accommodation for the interview or application process, please contact our Talent Acquisition team at CapriTalentAcquisition@CapriHoldings.com.

In compliance with certain Pay Transparency laws, employers are required to disclose a compensation range. The range for this position will vary based on role requirements, skill set, and years of experience. Please note that for salaried roles, the figures reflect full-time equivalency, while for hourly roles, the figures represent the applicable hourly rate.

Compensation Range:

140,000.00 - 150,000.00 USD

records.title: Senior Manager - Data Center Operations
records.description:
**About Us** 
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Visa will accept applications for this role until at least 12-03-2026

**Job Description**

Position Summary

The Senior Manager, Data Center IT Operations is a first-line people leader responsible for the safe, reliable, and disciplined execution of Data Center IT Operations across enterprise data center environments. The role oversees teams supporting day-to-day data center operations, mainframe physical infrastructure activities, and storage and tape/media operations while ensuring work is completed to approved scope, service commitments, security requirements, and operational standards.

This position translates Director-level strategy and priorities into daily operating plans, clear accountability, effective staffing, measurable outcomes, and consistent execution. The role provides direct people leadership, operational governance, technical escalation, change and incident oversight, vendor coordination, audit readiness, and continuous improvement across the supported functions.

The Senior Manager is a working people leader. The role is expected to maintain sufficient technical depth to challenge plans, validate readiness, guide escalations, and make risk-based operating decisions, while relying on senior technical contributors and subject-matter experts for detailed engineering authority and platform-specific design decisions.

The Senior Manager collaborates with capacity planning, facilities, DCIM, engineering, finance, and business stakeholders by providing accurate operational data, site constraints, implementation demand, lifecycle information, and risk inputs needed for forecasting and investment decisions.

Proficiency

 

* Leadership Proficiency: Experienced first-line manager capable of leading 24x7 operational teams, senior technical contributors, and cross-functional delivery in a regulated, highly available environment.
* Technical Proficiency: Broad working knowledge across data center IT operations, hardware lifecycle execution, mainframe physical operations, enterprise storage, and tape/media handling, with the judgment to engage the correct engineering authority for specialized decisions.
* Operating Scope: Accountable for team performance, daily service execution, risk management, workforce readiness, controls, and stakeholder communication across assigned sites or operating functions.

Supported Organization and Role Alignment

The role is designed to provide direct people leadership and operational accountability for the following job families or equivalent roles, subject to the final organization design:

* **Data Center Operations Analysts and Senior Analysts:** 24x7 on-site operational coverage; change implementation; rack-and-stack; migration, turn-up, decommission, incident, remote-hands, inventory, documentation, and site-readiness activities.
* **Senior and Senior Consultant Data Center Engineers:** Advanced execution, small-project or process ownership, work-team guidance, technical escalation, documentation quality, operational improvement, and mentoring within the assigned job function.
* **Staff Data Center Engineers or Technical Leads:** Senior individual contributors providing change governance, complex escalation support, cross-site standards, process design, technical strategy input, and first-among-equals workload coordination without formal personnel-management authority.
* **Mainframe Operations Support Personnel:** Physical installation and lifecycle support, cabling and connectivity coordination, hardware change readiness, incident response, vendor activity, console or access coordination where applicable, documentation, and escalation to mainframe engineering teams.
* **Storage and Tape/Media Operations Personnel:** Physical storage infrastructure support, tape library and media operational activities, secure media handling and chain-of-custody controls, inventory reconciliation, vendor coordination, incident and change support, and escalation to storage or backup engineering teams.

Final direct-report assignments should be confirmed through the approved organization design. This profile establishes the management scope and accountabilities expected if these roles report to the Senior Manager.

Core Responsibilities

People Leadership and Workforce Management

* **Direct People Management:** Lead, coach, and develop direct reports through clear goals, regular feedback, performance management, development planning, recognition, and accountability.
* **Staffing and Coverage:** Maintain staffing and schedule coverage appropriate to business demand, including 24x7 operations where assigned. Manage timecards, attendance, leave coordination, required training, on-call participation, and escalation coverage in accordance with policy.
* **Talent and Succession:** Partner with recruiting and leadership to fill vacancies, onboard employees, build bench strength, identify successors, reduce single points of knowledge, and create development opportunities across operations, mainframe, and storage/tape disciplines.
* **Role Clarity:** Define decision rights, work expectations, handoffs, escalation paths, and ownership boundaries among people leaders, Staff engineers, Senior Consultants, Senior engineers, Analysts, vendors, and partner teams.
* **Team Culture:** Foster a culture of safety, service, inclusion, accountability, operational excellence, continuous learning, and respectful challenge.

Data Center IT Operations Management

* **Daily Operations:** Oversee day-to-day execution of changes, installations, rack-and-stack work, migrations, turn-ups, decommissions, break/fix activity, incident response, remote-hands requests, inventory support, and site-readiness work.
* **Work Prioritization:** Translate business priorities into executable daily and weekly plans. Balance urgency, customer impact, technical risk, available skills, approved change windows, service commitments, and staffing capacity.
* **Operational Handoffs:** Ensure shift turnover, open-work tracking, escalation notes, customer commitments, incident status, and incomplete activities are communicated accurately and acted upon.
* **Site Stewardship:** Maintain operational ownership for non-facilities data center areas within scope, including organization, housekeeping, staging, tools, test equipment, spares, consumables, labeling, access readiness, and visitor or vendor coordination.
* **Service Continuity:** Ensure the team can sustain critical operations during staffing shortages, severe weather, major incidents, business-continuity events, or other disruptions, using approved contingency and escalation procedures.

Mainframe, Storage, and Tape/Media Oversight

* **Mainframe Operations:** Provide people leadership and operational oversight for physical mainframe activities, including implementation readiness, installation and deinstallation support, connectivity and cabling coordination, incident support, vendor access, documentation, and escalation to platform engineering.
* **Storage Operations:** Oversee operational support for enterprise storage hardware and related physical infrastructure, including approved changes, hardware lifecycle events, break/fix coordination, cabling, inventory, documentation, and vendor engagement.
* **Tape and Media Operations:** Ensure tape library and removable-media activities follow approved procedures for handling, tracking, movement, storage, reconciliation, retention, destruction coordination, and chain of custody.
* **Technical Authority Boundaries:** Ensure platform design, configuration authority, architecture, and specialized engineering decisions remain with designated engineering owners. The Senior Manager is accountable for operational execution, readiness, controls, and escalation.
* **Lifecycle Coordination:** Coordinate lifecycle demand, maintenance windows, end-of-life risks, spares, vendor support, and implementation dependencies with Hardware Asset Management, engineering, procurement, security, and service owners.

**Change, Incident, Problem, and Escalation Governance**
--------------------------------------------------------

* **Change Governance:** Ensure assigned changes are reviewed for scope, approvals, implementation and backout plans, access, staffing, materials, dependencies, risk controls, customer communication, and validation evidence before execution.
* **Incident Leadership:** Lead or support operational response for high-severity or complex incidents, establishing clear ownership, timely escalation, evidence-based communication, recovery validation, and follow-through.
* **Problem Management:** Use recurring incidents, failed changes, defects, rework, control exceptions, and customer feedback to drive root-cause analysis, corrective actions, preventive controls, and sustained remediation.
* **Decision and Escalation:** Make timely decisions within delegated authority and escalate when business impact, safety, security, compliance, architecture, funding, or cross-organizational tradeoffs exceed the role’s authority.
* **After-Hours Leadership:** Participate in the established leadership escalation model and ensure appropriate technical and management support is available for critical events outside standard business hours.

Controls, Security, Safety, and Audit Readiness

* **Control Execution:** Ensure operational procedures support company policies, regulatory obligations, security requirements, change controls, asset controls, media controls, and documented evidence expectations.
* **Safety and Stop-Work:** Promote safe work practices and ensure employees or contractors pause and escalate work when unsafe conditions, unauthorized activity, inadequate controls, or material quality risks are identified.
* **Physical Security:** Enforce access, escort, visitor, vendor, material-movement, and restricted-area requirements. Escalate access anomalies and security concerns promptly.
* **Audit Readiness:** Maintain accurate records, evidence, inventories, reconciliations, procedures, training completion, corrective actions, and control-owner responses needed to support audits and risk reviews.
* **Media Governance:** Ensure secure media handling, inventory accuracy, chain of custody, retention and destruction coordination, exception management, and evidence quality for tape and other removable media within scope.

Operational Standards, Documentation, and Data Quality

* **Standardization:** Implement and reinforce consistent operating standards across shifts, sites, and supported platforms while allowing documented local variations where required.
* **Procedures and Runbooks:** Ensure SOPs, runbooks, checklists, escalation guides, implementation instructions, and training materials are current, usable, controlled, and understood by the team.
* **Systems of Record:** Ensure timely and accurate updates to approved ticketing, DCIM, CMDB, Hardware Asset Management, inventory, media, and operational reporting systems.
* **Data Quality:** Establish ownership for correcting discrepancies in asset records, rack elevations, device locations, cable records, inventory, media records, work notes, and completion evidence.
* **Knowledge Resilience:** Reduce dependence on individual subject-matter experts through cross-training, documented procedures, mentoring, simulations, and structured knowledge transfer.

Vendor, Partner, and Stakeholder Management

* **Vendor and Contractor Oversight:** Confirm scope, access, safety expectations, schedules, tools, materials, deliverables, evidence, and escalation paths for vendors, contractors, customer engineers, and service partners.
* **Cross-Functional Partnership:** Build effective working relationships with facilities, network, mainframe, storage, backup, security, Hardware Asset Management, DCIM, capacity planning, change management, incident management, procurement, finance, and business service owners.
* **Customer Communication:** Provide concise, risk-based communication on service status, delivery commitments, blockers, operational impacts, decisions, and corrective actions.
* **Leadership Representation:** Represent the operational perspective in planning forums, change reviews, incident calls, audit discussions, project reviews, and leadership meetings, escalating strategic or funding decisions to the Director.

**Metrics, Financial Stewardship, and Continuous Improvement**
--------------------------------------------------------------

* **Operational Measures:** Define and monitor measures such as change success, on-time completion, failed changes, rework, incident response, repeat incidents, backlog age, throughput, service-level attainment, inventory accuracy, media-control accuracy, documentation quality, audit findings, and corrective-action closure.
* **Performance Management:** Use data to identify trends, clarify accountability, prioritize improvements, and coach the team. Measures should support better decisions and sustained service improvement.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Lead initiatives that reduce manual effort, eliminate recurring failure modes, strengthen controls, improve workflow efficiency, and increase predictable service delivery.
* **Financial Stewardship:** Manage assigned operating expenses, tools, training, vendor usage, overtime, spares, and discretionary spending within delegated authority. Identify cost avoidance and efficiency opportunities without compromising safety, security, resilience, or control effectiveness.
* **Benefits Validation:** Set measurable outcomes for improvement initiatives and verify that adopted changes deliver the intended operational, risk, quality, or financial benefit.

Capacity Planning Collaboration, Not Ownership

* **Role Boundary:** The Senior Manager does not own enterprise capacity strategy, forecasting models, white-space planning, power and cooling forecasts, or capital capacity decisions.
* **Operational Inputs:** Provide accurate demand signals, rack and floor observations, deployment schedules, lifecycle events, backlog, staffing constraints, inventory needs, and implementation risks to the teams accountable for capacity planning.
* **Plan Review:** Participate in capacity reviews to validate operational feasibility, implementation sequencing, site readiness, resource requirements, and delivery risk.
* **Constraint Escalation:** Identify and escalate operational constraints involving space, power, cooling, cabling, access, staffing, tools, spares, or schedule conflicts to the accountable owner.

*This is an on-site position. An on-site position must be consistently performed at an assigned Visa office location and require daily commute to the office location*

**Qualifications**

Basic Qualifications:

 

* 8+ years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor's Degree or at least 5 years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g., Master's, MBA, JD, MD) or 2 years of work experience with a PhD, OR 11+ years of relevant work experience.

Preferred Qualifications:

 

* 9 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor's Degree or 7 or more relevant years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g., Master's, MBA, JD, MD) or 3 or more years of experience with a PhD.
* 5+ years of direct people-leadership experience, including performance management, coaching, staffing, talent development, and accountability for operational outcomes.•
* Experience leading 24x7 data center operations teams and managing shift-based coverage models.
* Experience in financial services or another highly regulated, audit-intensive, high-availability environment.
* Experience with DCIM, CMDB, Hardware Asset Management, media-management, inventory, change-management, incident-management, ticketing, and workflow systems.
* + Experience supporting IBM Z or comparable mainframe physical operations, enterprise storage platforms, tape libraries, and secure removable-media processes.
* Experience establishing operational metrics, dashboards, control evidence, corrective-action programs, and data-driven improvement plans.
* Experience managing vendor performance, operational budgets, training investments, overtime, tools, spares, and service contracts.
* Relevant industry certifications in data center operations, IT service management, project management, infrastructure, security, storage, mainframe, or safety are beneficial.
* 10+ years of relevant experience in data center operations, infrastructure operations, mainframe operations, enterprise storage, backup/tape operations, hardware lifecycle management, or a related technology discipline.
* Experience leading teams in a production, highly available, regulated, or geographically distributed data center environment.
* Demonstrated experience overseeing change execution, incident response, problem management, vendor activity, operational controls, documentation, and service-level commitments.
* Broad working knowledge of data center physical infrastructure, including rack-and-stack practices, structured cabling, fiber and copper connectivity, labeling, power dependencies, equipment handling, inventory, and asset lifecycle processes.
* Working familiarity with mainframe physical environments, enterprise storage infrastructure, and tape/media operational controls, with the judgment to engage specialist engineering teams when required.
* Demonstrated ability to lead through influence across engineering, facilities, security, asset management, service management, vendors, and business stakeholders.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including concise executive escalation, risk communication, performance reporting, and operational decision documentation.
* Ability to participate in after-hours escalation support and work safely within a physical data center environment in accordance with applicable procedures.

**Information for US Applicants**

For roles located in the US, the estimated salary range for this position is $143,700.00 to $ 229,500.00 USD per year, which may include potential sales incentive payments (if applicable). Salary may vary depending on job-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location. In addition, this position may be eligible for bonus and equity.Visa has a comprehensive benefits package for which this position may be eligible that includes Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), FSA/HSA, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, and Wellness Program.

Varies upon the needs of the department.

**Mental/Physical Requirements**

This position will be performed in an office setting. The position will require the incumbent to sit and stand at a desk, communicate in person and by telephone, frequently operate standard office equipment, such as telephones and computers.

records.title: VP of Technical Operations & Support
records.description:
**Who We Are**

Accommodations Plus International (API) is a technology and services company focused on driving innovation across the travel and transportation industry. We partner with organizations in the airline, cruise, and rail sectors to deliver solutions that improve layover operations, enhance customer experience, and support long-term growth.

Our mission is to make layovers simpler and more efficient for crew members—and we bring that to life through deep industry expertise and a practical, results-driven approach.

Today, API’s platform powers over 18 million crew room nights each year for 100+ airlines and travel operators worldwide. Our Global Reach ensures that airline crews are rested, transported, and connected so global aviation runs on time.

At API, we’re building a culture rooted in succeeding and thriving together. It’s a place where people are encouraged to take ownership, develop their skills, and contribute to work that matters.

If you’re looking to grow your career in a company that values steady progress, real impact, and long-term development, we’d like to meet you!

**Summary/Objective**

The Vice President of Technical Operations & Support is a senior technology leader accountable for the secure, reliable, and seamless support of API's mission-critical software applications and employee systems. This leader sets the strategy for, and runs, all technical operations (application support, incident management, observability, and company and employee systems support) and technical support functions (Customer Support and Tier 2/Tier 3 support teams). With teams based in Canada and India and contract resources worldwide, the Vice President will lead a multi-tier support and operations organization, fostering a culture of accountability, responsiveness, and technical growth. The core objective is optimal system performance and superior customer and employee satisfaction and retention, driven by data and continuous improvement.

**Essential Functions:** *Reasonable* ***accommodations*** *may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*

**Leadership & Team Management**

* Lead, mentor, and develop Tier 1, Tier 2/Tier 3, customer support, and incident management teams across Canada and India, along with contract resources worldwide, building a high-performing culture across time zones
* Define team structure, roles, and career paths; set goals, KPIs, and performance expectations; and partner with HR and talent acquisition to recruit, coach, and retain skilled professionals
* Partner with infrastructure and application engineering, product, security, and business leaders to ensure product stability and that employee systems meet and exceed business and client needs

**Customer Support & Incident Management**

* Define and implement world-class customer support and incident management strategies, including SLAs, that drive high customer satisfaction and retention for mission-critical applications
* Oversee Tier 1, Tier 2, and Tier 3 workflows with clear escalation paths and knowledge transfer to engineering; maintain a searchable knowledge base and self-service resources to reduce repeat tickets
* Own the incident management process end-to-end, including severity definitions, major incident command (with the Senior Director of Cloud Infrastructure & Technical Operations as infrastructure technical lead), and communication to customers and executives
* Monitor ticket aging, MTTR, and CSAT; use the data to identify systemic issues and prioritize improvements
* Serve as the executive escalation point for strategic customers and key accounts, joining business reviews and leading communication during major outages
* Manage 24/7 on-call coverage across time zones, serving as the final executive escalation point for major incidents, with day-to-day on-call handled through team rotations

**Application Reliability & Service Levels**

* Define and enforce SLOs and KPIs for APIs and applications, in partnership with the Senior Director of Cloud Infrastructure & Technical Operations, who owns infrastructure and platform availability; report performance to executives
* Lead blameless post-mortems and drive root cause analysis (RCA), ensuring corrective and preventive actions are completed with engineering
* Partner with engineering and product on change management and release readiness so supportability is built into the software development lifecycle
* Support business continuity and disaster recovery testing for supported applications and corporate systems, in partnership with the Senior Director, who owns cloud infrastructure recovery

**Observability & Monitoring**

* Own observability as a core function of the organization, including monitoring, alerting, logging, tracing, and dashboards for production applications, APIs, and employee systems
* Define observability standards for application teams, including instrumentation requirements, key service indicators, alert severity definitions, and runbook expectations
* Own the observability tooling and platforms (such as Datadog, CloudWatch, Grafana, or equivalent), including configuration, integrations, licensing, and vendors
* Build SLI and SLO dashboards with error-budget tracking so reliability against targets is visible to engineering, support, and executives
* Establish alerting hygiene (actionable alerts, noise reduction, paging policies) and automatic ticket and incident creation in Jira Service Management
* Deploy proactive detection, including synthetic monitoring, anomaly detection, and AI-based correlation, to find issues before customers report them
* Partner with the Senior Director on infrastructure and network telemetry, and with application engineering on instrumentation; report coverage, MTTD, MTTR, and alert quality to executives

**Company & Employee Systems Support**

* Provide executive oversight of helpdesk and end-user support, employee hardware lifecycle, and corporate systems administration
* Oversee the availability, governance, and performance of Microsoft 365, Entra, Teams, and related platforms; partner with security on identity, access, and endpoint standards
* Champion AI-enabled automation across support and operations, such as ticket triage, knowledge retrieval, and self-healing, in partnership with security and AI tooling owners

**Service Management Processes & Partner Alignment**

* Align ITIL-based incident, problem, change, and knowledge management processes with engineering, product, and security partners, with shared severity definitions, escalation paths, ownership, and handoff standards
* Drive continuous improvement through rigorous RCA, with partner teams committing to and tracking corrective actions in a shared backlog
* Build shared dashboards and metrics with partner teams, and extend these processes to external vendors and partners through agreed escalation paths and SLAs

**Strategy, Governance & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Develop and execute a multi-year technology operations and support strategy and roadmap aligned with business goals, product strategy, and growth
* Report regularly to the SVP of Infrastructure Engineering and Technical Operations and executive leadership on service performance, satisfaction, reliability, cost, and initiative progress
* Manage the operations and support budget, including headcount, tooling, and vendor spend, with accurate forecasting and variance analysis
* Lead vendor relationships for support, service management, observability, and employee enablement tools, including negotiations and SLA management

Competencies

* Exceptional leadership, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities, with experience building, scaling, and retaining high-performing technical teams across geographies and time zones
* Strong service-delivery orientation and commitment to customer experience
* Executive presence; able to convey complex technical information to non-technical stakeholders and translate operational metrics and investment needs into clear narratives for C-suite audiences
* Customer-facing credibility; builds trust with strategic customers and communicates clearly and calmly during outages and escalations
* Strategic thinking balanced with operational discipline, with strong project management skills
* Data-driven; uses SLOs, KPIs, and service metrics to identify trends, prioritize investments, and report on effectiveness
* Deep understanding of enterprise architecture, system design, and software development lifecycle principles, sufficient to partner credibly with engineering during major incidents
* Commitment to a blameless culture and continuous learning; experience with AI-based automation for support efficiency and self-healing

Position Type and Expected Hours of Work

This is a full-time, exempt position that can be hybrid or remote. Hybrid employees will be based in either our Melville, NY or Markham, Ontario, Canada office, with a combination of in-office and remote work. Standard hours are Monday through Friday during core business hours. Given the global nature of this role and the 24/7 support model, flexibility is expected to collaborate with teams in Canada and India, and contract resources worldwide, across significant time zone differences, including early-morning or late-day calls to overlap with the India team. Occasional availability outside standard hours may be required for major incidents, outages, and maintenance windows.

Travel

This position may require occasional domestic and international travel (approximately 10%) for team visits, vendor meetings, industry conferences, and cross-functional leadership engagements.

Required Education and Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field; Master's degree or MBA preferred
* 15+ years of progressive experience in IT operations, systems administration, and/or technical support, including at least 7 years in a senior leadership or executive role (director level or above)
* Proven track record managing globally distributed technical teams, including onshore and offshore employees and contract resources, in a SaaS or enterprise software environment
* Demonstrated experience owning customer support and incident management for mission-critical applications, including SLA/SLO management, post-mortems, RCA, and executive service reporting
* Deep experience with employee enablement tools, including Microsoft 365, Entra, and Teams
* Extensive experience with cloud computing and infrastructure management
* Experience owning observability and monitoring platforms (such as Datadog, CloudWatch, Grafana, or equivalent) and building a metrics-driven approach to operational health
* Working knowledge of ITSM platforms (such as Jira Service Management) and frameworks such as ITIL, and of data analytics tools for performance monitoring
* Experience managing operations budgets for staffing, tooling, and vendors

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience leading technical operations and support at a SaaS or cloud-native company serving enterprise customers
* Experience overseeing technical support or IT staff in India, and managing contract and vendor-supplied resources
* ITIL certification (ITIL 4 Foundation or higher) and hands-on experience administering Jira Service Management
* Experience with AI-based automation for ticket triage, incident response, and self-healing, and familiarity with AI risk and responsible-use frameworks
* Experience in travel technology, hospitality, or other high-volume, customer-facing SaaS environments

Compensation:

The good faith compensation is $200,000 - $220,000 USD.

Compensation is determined based on several factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and skill set, geographic location, as well as internal alignment and external benchmarks.

**Other Duties**

Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time according to business needs.

The performance of additional responsibilities if you are designated as a Data Protection Champion (DPC), Senior Information Risk Owner (SIRO) or Information Assurance Accounting Officer (IAAO).

**Work Environment**

This position operates in a professional office environment. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets and fax machines.

**Physical Demands**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to stand, walk; use hands to finger, handle or feel; and reach with hands and arms.

**AAP/EEO Statement**

Accommodations Plus International is an Equal Opportunity Employer that does not discriminate on the basis of actual or perceived race, creed, color, religion, alienage or national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, disability or handicap, sex, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, genetic information, arrest record, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws. Our management team is dedicated to this policy with respect to recruitment, hiring, placement, promotion, transfer, training, compensation, benefits, employee activities and general treatment during employment.

**Privacy Statement**

API may use the contact information you provide to communicate about this role, including via text message. See our [Privacy Policy] for details. By clicking "Apply" you agree to Rippling's Terms of Service / User Privacy Notice.

records.description:
**Job Description:**

**Position Overview**
---------------------

TransMedics is seeking a **Senior Director of Automation and New Process Engineering** to lead a critical transformation within our R&D and Engineering organization. This highly visible leadership position will oversee Automation, New Product Introduction (NPI), and Sustaining Engineering, driving engineering innovation, manufacturing excellence, and operational scalability.

**This is a build role, not a maintain role.**

As TransMedics continues its rapid growth, we need a strategic, hands-on engineering leader who can develop and execute a multi-year transformation roadmap while remaining closely connected to day-to-day manufacturing operations.

The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise in automation and advanced manufacturing with proven experience building high-performing engineering organizations. This leader will drive improvements in product quality, reliability, manufacturing efficiency, and scalability while developing the engineering talent needed to support our continued growth.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Engineering Leadership & Organizational Development**

* Lead the Automation, New Product Introduction, and Sustaining Engineering organizations.
* Develop and execute a multi-year engineering transformation strategy aligned with business growth.
* Build, mentor, and develop high-performing, multidisciplinary engineering teams.
* Establish organizational structures, processes, and capabilities to support long-term scalability.
* Oversee performance management, professional development, and engineering resource planning.

**Automation & Advanced Manufacturing**

* Drive the implementation of advanced automation, robotics, and innovative manufacturing technologies.
* Lead automation initiatives across multiple manufacturing lines to improve quality, efficiency, and throughput.
* Identify opportunities to modernize manufacturing processes, systems, and infrastructure.
* Establish scalable, reliable, and cost-effective manufacturing solutions.

**New Product Introduction & Sustaining Engineering**

* Provide strategic leadership for NPI engineering and manufacturing process development.
* Ensure successful transitions from product development into scalable manufacturing.
* Lead sustaining engineering initiatives to improve existing products and manufacturing processes.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to resolve complex technical challenges and support product launches.
* Maintain a hands-on approach to troubleshooting manufacturing issues and addressing production or launch risks.

**Design for Excellence (DfX)**

* Champion Design for Excellence (DfX), including Design for Manufacturability (DFM), throughout the product development lifecycle.
* Drive product and process simplification, including part-count reduction.
* Improve product reliability, manufacturing efficiency, and cost effectiveness through engineering design improvements.
* Establish best practices supporting consistent, scalable manufacturing performance.

**Strategic Collaboration & Operational Excellence**

* Partner closely with R&D, Quality, Supply Chain, and Manufacturing leadership.
* Drive continuous improvement in engineering systems, processes, and infrastructure.
* Leverage manufacturing technologies, digital tools, and operational data to improve engineering outcomes.
* Support capital planning, resource allocation, and strategic investment decisions.
* Foster a culture of technical excellence, accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Biomedical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
* 15+ years of progressive engineering leadership experience.
* Demonstrated experience specifying, developing, and implementing automation across multiple manufacturing lines.
* Strong technical understanding of manufacturing processes, automation technologies, and engineering operations.
* Ability to balance strategic leadership with hands-on technical problem-solving.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* MBA or advanced degree.
* Proven success leading multidisciplinary engineering organizations through significant growth or transformation.
* Experience implementing advanced manufacturing technologies, including robotics and automated production systems.
* Strong understanding of Design for Excellence (DfX) and Design for Manufacturability (DFM).
* Knowledge of regulatory frameworks, quality systems, and compliance requirements.
* Experience leveraging Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), and digital manufacturing technologies.
* Demonstrated financial acumen, capital planning, project management, and resource allocation experience.
* Proven ability to attract, develop, and retain exceptional engineering talent.

**Work Environment**
--------------------

This position operates in both office and manufacturing floor environments and requires a leader who is comfortable engaging directly with engineering teams, manufacturing operations, and cross-functional stakeholders.

**Compensation & Benefits**
---------------------------

TransMedics is committed to equitable and transparent compensation.

The expected base salary range for this position is **$220,600 – $314,050 annually**, representing the company's current good-faith estimate of compensation.

Actual compensation will depend on factors including candidate experience, qualifications, skills, and specific work location.

This position may also be eligible for:

* Performance-based bonuses
* Equity compensation
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Retirement savings benefits
* Paid time off
* Wellness resources

TransMedics complies with all applicable U.S. pay transparency laws and does not request or consider salary history.

**About TransMedics**
---------------------

TransMedics is transforming organ transplantation through innovative technologies designed to improve the availability, utilization, and outcomes of donor organs.

Our mission is to help save more lives by advancing the science and technology of organ preservation and transplantation.

Join a growing organization where engineering innovation, technical excellence, and meaningful impact come together to advance life-saving technology.

This is a full-time, **on-site position** currently based at TransMedics' facility in Andover, MA.

TransMedics is preparing to transition operations to a new facility in **Somerville, MA**. Candidates should be aware of this upcoming move and must be willing and able to work on-site at both locations as the transition occurs.

Candidates must currently reside within commuting distance of the work location or be willing to relocate to the Greater Boston area.

This position requires regular collaboration with engineering, manufacturing, and cross-functional teams, including direct engagement on the manufacturing floor.

TransMedics is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

TransMedics is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the application and hiring process.

We value the unique perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences of our employees and believe that an inclusive workforce strengthens our ability to innovate and fulfill our mission of saving lives.

**Employee Benefit:**

Medical with Health Reimbursement Account through Blue Cross/Blue Shield of MA

Dental

Vision

Healthcare Flexible Spending Account

Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account

Short Term Disability

Long Term Disability

401K Plan

Pet insurance

Employee Stock Purchase Plan

TransMedics is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, marital status, age, disability or protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

records.title: Director of Operations
records.description:
Who is Taco Bell?

Taco Bell is a leading Mexican-inspired quick service restaurant brand that is a part of Yum! Brands, Inc. which includes Pizza Hut and KFC. Founded on innovation and passion with Glen Bell bringing tacos to the masses in a world of hot dog and hamburger stands in 1962, today we have nearly 7000 restaurants in the United States and over 400 restaurants in 27 countries outside of the United States. The future holds 2,000 more restaurants across the globe within the next decade. It's easy to see we're in the business of making tacos, but at heart, we're a business that's fueled by the Live Mas energy and passion of people serving people.

What is "Live Mas"?

Equally important to the job role and responsibilities is making sure the Director of Operations can represent the amazing Live Mas! culture that is Taco Bell. At Taco Bell, we embrace breakthrough thinking and innovative ideas that continue to differentiate us from our competitors. We have a maniacal focus on our customers, never follow, and always celebrate the accomplishments of our people. If you want to have fun serving great food to our customers, we would love to meet with you.

Job Description:

About this Job: Reporting to the General Manager, the Director of Operations is responsible for all aspects of operations including people, customers, sales and profits. This leader has up to 3 area coaches as direct reports compiling 12 restaurants. They drive excellence in day-to-day operations; hire, train, coach, & support managers; plan and set goals; focus on problem solving/process improvement; set standards; recognize and motivate area managers, unit level management & their teams. Influence people to drive business results and franchise partnership

The Day-to-Day:

Build People Capability

* Recruit and equip the best operators in the world to deliver great customer experiences
* Build a healthy and robust bench of developed and capable Managers
* Hold Area Coaches accountable for people, customer, sales and profit targets
* Lead by example be a culture champion and live by Taco Bell principles
* Leverage culture and people capability to fuel brand performance
* Resolution oriented in all Employee Relations (ER) activities; provides needed
ER assistance to managers; proactive in addressing ER needs in the market 

 

Deliver a Consistent Customer Experience

* Provides leadership for each manager in the market to ensure customer satisfaction
* Leverage customer programs to coach and improve on execution opportunities
* Train, coach and hold accountable Area Coaches and Restaurant Managers for executing the Taco Bell Operating System and delivering Brand Standards including food safety
* Identify and act with urgency to resolve Brand protection issues
* Excellent execution of Global Operating System initiatives
* Absolutely uncompromising execution of the highest standards of their local regulation around occupational safety and health standards for employee working conditions, and their company safety and security policy

Grow the Brand, Sales, and Profits

* Partners with each Manager in the market to build sales over last year's sales achievement
* Training and operations execution of marketing promotions
* Train and coach Area Coaches how to teach RGMs to use the tools and processes to improve restaurant financial results
* Coach to deliver restaurant profit targets in every restaurant
* Leads the way by working with each Area Coach in the market to deliver profit goals and meet targeted flow-thru objectives; utilizes available reports to identify opportunities; encourages a top-line orientation through operational focus; ensures that correct operational procedures are followed at all times
* Build capability to improve problem solving and planning skills through hands-on demonstrations
* Exhibits ownership working with Management to resolve chronic Repair & Maintenance issues; determines causes of excessive R&M; gathers R&M issues; identifies trends and takes to R&M Business Partners

Minimum Requirements-

Is This You?

* Bachelor's Degree preferred
* Strong Quick Service Restaurant Experience, balancing product quality with fast service times
* Is a Dynamic, energetic and positive leader, a self-starter, proactively driven to get things done and does the right thing for the business
* Exhibits unrivaled leadership behaviors; providing coaching, developing the team, driving culture, problem solving, strong communication, time management, executing tasks and achieving results through others
* 10+ years Restaurant Management experience with strong people growing record, recruiting talent, development and performance management
* Corporate restaurant company field operations leader experience
* Has lead multiple managers of multiple high volume units in an area
* Extensive Area Coach experience leading 6-8 restaurant general managers
* Has personally ran a successful restaurant and has knowledge of restaurant operations and expectations for team member's positions
* Corporate office Cross-Functional leading teams experience
* Good communication skills, and strong interpersonal and conflict resolution skills with exceptional team building capability

Why Taco Bell?

We truly believe that where you work matters, and we know a thing or two about what makes employees happy. Join us on our mission of feeding people's lives with Mas!

* We are about more than just building restaurantswe connect with our fans through their passions including sports, gaming, and music
* We know that employees want a company they can live and grow with; they crave a unique culture that fosters creativity and encourages pursuit of passion, and they look for opportunities to take risks, develop skills and learn in ways that fit their lifestyle
* We foster a culture of authenticity and believe all people can make a difference

records.title: Director of Process Engineering & Continuous Improvement
records.description:
The Director of Process Engineering & Continuous Improvement is the company's technical authority for how meals are made and the owner of its improvement engine. This hands-on leader combines deep manufacturing process engineering with a disciplined continuous improvement approach to make production operations more consistent, efficient, safe, and cost-effective across Mom's Meals.

The role will focus primarily on kitchen and production operations, supporting a highly automated manufacturing environment through process design, equipment performance, root cause problem solving, and structured improvement projects. The position will also support fulfillment operations by identifying automation and process opportunities that improve throughput, labor efficiency, accuracy, and customer service.

The Director partners closely with Production, Fulfillment, Supply Chain, Food Safety and Quality, Maintenance, R&D, IT, and Finance to execute strategic projects and deliver measurable, sustained improvement across the enterprise. This is a player-coach role: the Director is expected to engage directly on the production floor, lead technical problem solving, and develop the engineers and improvement practitioners on the team.

***This position will travel to our other facilities 25-50% at varying times.***

***Ideally, the selected candidate will work out of one of our Production facilities (Ankeny/Grinnell, IA, Oklahoma City, OK, or North Jackson, OH) but are open to remote for the right skills and experience.***

Benefits

Our employees enjoy a generous package of benefits that we are thrilled to provide, and feel is part of what makes us different as an employer. We value our team members, and this is one way we can show it.

Benefits include:

* PTO, holiday pay and holiday of choice

* 401(k) match

* Life insurance

* Short-term disability

* Health, dental and vision insurance

* Maternity/paternity leave

* Health savings account (HSA)

* Flex spending accounts (FSA) – health and dependent

### **Position Responsibilities may include, but not limited to**

Process & Technical Engineering

* Serve as the company's process authority for meal production, owning process design, line layouts, standard work, and process specifications for cooking, chilling, portioning, and packaging
* Lead structured process control plans, risk assessments, and capability studies to reduce variation and improve consistency
* Drive yield, discard, and portion-control improvements through engineering-based solutions
* Partner with Production, Food Safety and Quality, Maintenance and R&D teams to ensure process changes are validated, documented, and sustained on the production floor
* Reduce downtime and defects through root cause analysis and hands-on, engineering-based problem solving
* Evaluate emerging manufacturing technologies and process innovations that improve efficiency, quality, and scalability
* Ensure engineering and process solutions comply with USDA, FDA, food safety, sanitary design, and regulatory requirements

Continuous Improvement & Operational Excellence

* Build and lead a multi-site continuous improvement program, maintaining a prioritized project portfolio with defined savings targets validated with Finance
* Champion Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and structured problem-solving methodologies (such as A3, DMAIC, value stream mapping, changeover reduction, and standard work)
* Drive waste reduction, productivity improvement, and labor optimization initiatives
* Evaluate operational KPIs, including OEE, yield, labor productivity, and discards, and use data analytics to prioritize improvement opportunities
* Coach kitchen and production leaders and engineers in structured problem solving, and ensure improvements are standardized and sustained
* Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement across operations

Kitchen & Production Engineering

* Lead engineering efforts supporting highly automated meal production operations
* Drive equipment performance, uptime, and Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) improvements
* Identify ideal equipment required to produce Mom's Meals to specification at scale, including equipment that should be replaced or decommissioned and equipment that can deliver OEE improvements and a measurable return on investment
* Partner with Production leadership and Commercialization team to identify bottlenecks and improve throughput
* Lead facility expansion projects, line installations, equipment upgrades, and process redesign initiatives

Capital & Automation Projects

* Develop and manage the engineering capital plan, prioritizing projects by safety, quality, and measurable return
* Lead project prioritization, design, budgeting, vendor selection, implementation, and startup activities
* Ensure projects are completed safely, on time, and within budget
* Manage external engineering firms, contractors, equipment suppliers, and system integrators
* Build a practical, multi-year automation roadmap focused on productivity, yield, and labor efficiency
* Establish project governance, reporting, and post-implementation performance reviews

Maintenance & Reliability Partnership

* Partner with Maintenance leadership on standards for asset management, equipment lifecycle planning, and preventative, predictive, and reliability-centered maintenance practices
* Use maintenance KPIs, including downtime, PM completion rates, equipment failure rates, and maintenance costs, to prioritize engineering and improvement work

Leadership & Team Development

* Provide coaching, mentorship, and technical leadership to process engineering, continuous improvement, and engineering personnel
* Develop future engineering leaders, improvement practitioners, and technical subject matter experts
* Promote a culture focused on safety, engagement, accountability, and operational excellence

### **Required Skills and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or related technical field
* 10+ years of progressive engineering leadership experience within manufacturing, food production, and highly automated operations, including leading process engineering or continuous improvement teams
* Hands-on experience applying Lean and Six Sigma tools, with a demonstrated record of delivering quantified, sustained savings and performance gains
* Strong process engineering skills, including process design, root cause analysis, process capability, statistical analysis, and OEE and yield analytics
* Demonstrated success leading capital projects and automation implementations, including equipment installations and line upgrades
* Working knowledge of industrial automation, controls, packaging systems, and manufacturing technologies
* Knowledge of Sanitary Design Principles and Standards for food manufacturing.
* Experience leading teams in regulated manufacturing environments
* Proven ability to influence cross-functional leaders and drive enterprise-wide change

### **Preferred Skills and Experience**

* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification
* Food manufacturing, packaged goods, pharmaceutical, and automated distribution experience
* Experience with Industry 4.0 technologies, predictive maintenance, and digital manufacturing tools
* Experience managing and understanding facility utility controls, including HVAC, water, and steam systems
* Professional Engineer (PE) license or advanced technical degree

### **Physical Requirements**

* Regularly required to use hands to feel, grab, or operate objects, tools, and controls while reaching with hands and arms
* Frequently required to stand, communicate, and listen
* Occasionally required to walk, stoop, kneel or crouch
* Occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds
* Visual perception to perform job including peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus
* Able to perform repetitive movements
* Able to work in variable temperatures (cold/hot)

**Company Overview**

Mom’s Meals is a home-delivered meal service providing fully prepared, refrigerated meal solutions direct to homes nationwide since 1999. We provide seniors, patients recovering post-discharge and those managing a chronic condition with tailored nutrition solutions to manage their specific needs. If you are passionate about the well-being of others and have a strong sense of community, Mom’s Meals could be the place for you! We are a family operated business looking for fun, compassionate, and friendly people who want to make a difference in the lives of others.

 

**EEO**

Mom’s Meals complies with all applicable federal and state non-discrimination laws. Qualified applicants shall receive consideration for employment without regards to race, religion, national origin, ancestry, color, gender, age, disability, or veteran status.
